## Source: internal/plugins/host.go#*Manager.AllowNetworkHost

``````
// AllowNetworkHost reports whether pluginID is enabled, still holds its
// network grant, and declared hostName in permissions.network.
func (m *Manager) AllowNetworkHost(ctx context.Context, pluginID, hostName string) bool {
	h := &host{m: m, plugin: pluginID}
	r, g, err := h.record(ctx)
	if err != nil || r.Manifest.Ether == nil {
		return false
	}
	if g.revoked("network") {
		h.noteDenied("network")
		return false
	}
	if hostAllowed(r.Manifest.Ether.Permissions.Network, hostName) ||
		g.allowsLocalHostName(hostName) ||
		(DeclaresOperatorHosts(r.Manifest) && g.allowsOperatorHostName(hostName)) {
		return true
	}
	if DeclaresOperatorHosts(r.Manifest) {
		m.noteBlockedOperatorHost(ctx, pluginID, hostName)
		return false
	}
	if IsLocalNetworkHost(hostName) {
		m.noteBlockedLocalHost(ctx, pluginID, hostName)
		return false
	}
	h.noteDenied("network")
	return false
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host.go#hostAllowed

``````
// hostAllowed matches a host against the manifest network list.
func hostAllowed(patterns []string, host string) bool {
	host = strings.ToLower(host)
	for _, p := range patterns {
		p = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(p))
		if p == OperatorNetworkEntry {
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(p, "*.") {
			if strings.HasSuffix(host, p[1:]) && host != p[2:] {
				return true
			}
			continue
		}
		if p == host {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host.go#ErrFetchFailed

``````
// ErrFetchFailed is returned when a plugin's outbound request fails. Its
// message names only the host and a category: request URLs can carry
// plugin secrets (API keys in the query), and net/http errors include the
// full URL, so neither the URL nor the underlying error text is exposed.
var ErrFetchFailed = errors.New("plugins: request failed")
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host.go#fetchError

``````
func fetchError(host string, err error) error {
	var blocked *BlockedLocalHostError
	if errors.As(err, &blocked) {
		return blocked
	}
	var blockedOp *BlockedOperatorHostError
	if errors.As(err, &blockedOp) {
		return blockedOp
	}
	reason := "network error"
	var netErr net.Error
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) || (errors.As(err, &netErr) && netErr.Timeout()):
		reason = "timed out"
	case errors.Is(err, context.Canceled):
		reason = "canceled"
	case errors.Is(err, ErrPermissionDenied):
		// A redirect left the plugin's network grant.
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: a redirect from %s left the granted hosts", ErrPermissionDenied, host)
	case errors.Is(err, safefetch.ErrBlocked):
		if isNonPublicBlockError(err) {
			return &BlockedLocalHostError{Host: host}
		}
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s is not allowed (%w)", ErrFetchFailed, host, safefetch.ErrBlocked)
	}
	if reason == "timed out" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s: %w", ErrFetchFailed, host, context.DeadlineExceeded)
	}
	return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s: %s", ErrFetchFailed, host, reason)
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host.go#*host.openFetch

``````
func (h *host) openFetch(ctx context.Context, req FetchRequest) (*http.Response, error) {
	r, g, err := h.record(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	u, err := url.Parse(req.URL)
	if err != nil || u.Hostname() == "" || (u.Scheme != "https" && u.Scheme != "http") {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: bad url", ErrPermissionDenied)
	}
	if g.revoked("network") {
		h.noteDenied("network")
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: network", ErrPermissionDenied)
	}
	if !networkAllowedURL(r.Manifest.Ether.Permissions.Network, u) &&
		!g.allowsLocalURL(u) &&
		!(DeclaresOperatorHosts(r.Manifest) && g.allowsOperatorURL(u)) {
		if DeclaresOperatorHosts(r.Manifest) {
			blocked := urlHostPortDisplay(u)
			h.m.noteBlockedOperatorHost(ctx, h.plugin, blocked)
			return nil, &BlockedOperatorHostError{Host: blocked}
		}
		if IsLocalNetworkHost(u.Hostname()) {
			blocked := urlHostPortDisplay(u)
			h.m.noteBlockedLocalHost(ctx, h.plugin, blocked)
			return nil, &BlockedLocalHostError{Host: blocked}
		}
		h.noteDenied("network")
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: network", ErrPermissionDenied)
	}
	if trusted := trustedFetchHosts(r.Manifest, g); len(trusted) > 0 {
		ctx = safefetch.WithTrustedHosts(ctx, trusted)
	}
	method := req.Method
	if method == "" {
		method = http.MethodGet
	}
	hr, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, method, req.URL, bytes.NewReader(req.Body))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	for k, v := range req.Headers {
		hr.Header.Set(k, v)
	}
	// Recheck the current grant before every redirect, as well as the SSRF
	// guard's own redirect policy. A redirect is another network request.
	// When ctx already has a deadline, let Request.Context govern both headers
	// and body reads so timeouts always surface context.DeadlineExceeded rather
	// than net/http's non-unwrapping Client.Timeout error.
	client := *h.m.client
	if _, ok := ctx.Deadline(); ok {
		client.Timeout = 0
	}
	lastURL := u
	previousRedirect := client.CheckRedirect
	client.CheckRedirect = func(next *http.Request, via []*http.Request) error {
		lastURL = next.URL
		current, grants, err := h.record(next.Context())
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if grants.revoked("network") {
			h.noteDenied("network")
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: network", ErrPermissionDenied)
		}
		if !networkAllowedURL(current.Manifest.Ether.Permissions.Network, next.URL) &&
			!grants.allowsLocalURL(next.URL) &&
			!(DeclaresOperatorHosts(current.Manifest) && grants.allowsOperatorURL(next.URL)) {
			if DeclaresOperatorHosts(current.Manifest) {
				blocked := urlHostPortDisplay(next.URL)
				h.m.noteBlockedOperatorHost(next.Context(), h.plugin, blocked)
				return &BlockedOperatorHostError{Host: blocked}
			}
			if IsLocalNetworkHost(next.URL.Hostname()) {
				blocked := urlHostPortDisplay(next.URL)
				h.m.noteBlockedLocalHost(next.Context(), h.plugin, blocked)
				return &BlockedLocalHostError{Host: blocked}
			}
			h.noteDenied("network")
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: network", ErrPermissionDenied)
		}
		*next = *next.WithContext(safefetch.WithTrustedHosts(next.Context(), trustedFetchHosts(current.Manifest, grants)))
		if previousRedirect != nil {
			return previousRedirect(next, via)
		}
		if len(via) >= 10 {
			return errors.New("plugins: stopped after 10 redirects")
		}
		return nil
	}
	resp, err := client.Do(hr)
	if err != nil {
		if isNonPublicBlockError(err) {
			blocked := urlHostPortDisplay(lastURL)
			h.m.noteBlockedLocalHost(ctx, h.plugin, blocked)
			return nil, fetchError(blocked, err)
		}
		return nil, fetchError(u.Hostname(), err)
	}
	return resp, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host.go#*host.HTTPFetch

``````
func (h *host) HTTPFetch(ctx context.Context, req FetchRequest) (FetchResponse, error) {
	if req.TimeoutMS > 0 {
		var cancel context.CancelFunc
		ctx, cancel = context.WithTimeout(ctx, time.Duration(min(req.TimeoutMS, int64(86400000)))*time.Millisecond)
		defer cancel()
	}
	resp, err := h.openFetch(ctx, req)
	if err != nil {
		return FetchResponse{}, err
	}
	u, _ := url.Parse(req.URL)
	defer resp.Body.Close() //nolint:errcheck
	body, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(resp.Body, MaxFetchBytes+1))
	if err != nil {
		return FetchResponse{}, fetchError(u.Hostname(), err)
	}
	if len(body) > MaxFetchBytes {
		return FetchResponse{}, fmt.Errorf("plugins: response larger than %d bytes", MaxFetchBytes)
	}
	h.noteFetchTraffic(ctx, req, int64(len(body)))
	out := FetchResponse{Status: resp.StatusCode, Headers: map[string]string{}, Body: body}
	for k := range resp.Header {
		out.Headers[k] = resp.Header.Get(k)
	}
	return out, nil
}
``````

// journalWrite records a write (and, unless shadow, has already applied
// it; callers pass the inverse they obtained).
func (h *host) journal(ctx context.Context, r Record, op, detail string, inverse any) error {
	raw, err := json.Marshal(inverse)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, err = h.m.store.journal(ctx, JournalEntry{Plugin: h.plugin, Op: op, Detail: detail, Inverse: raw, Shadow: r.Shadow})
	return err
}

func (h *host) SetWatchState(ctx context.Context, viewerID int64, titleID string, watched bool) error {
	if err := h.requireWritableToolContext(ctx); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	r, g, err := h.record(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := h.deny(r, g, "viewers.write_watch_state", normLevel(r.Manifest.Ether.Permissions.Viewers.WriteWatchState),
		func(l string) bool { return viewerOK(g, l, viewerID) }); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if r.Shadow {
		return h.journal(ctx, r, "viewers.setWatchState", titleID, watchInverse{Op: "viewers.setWatchState", ViewerID: viewerID, TitleID: titleID, Watched: !watched})
	}
	if h.m.deps.Backends.SetWatchState == nil {
		return ErrUnavailable
	}
	prev, err := h.m.deps.Backends.SetWatchState(ctx, viewerID, titleID, watched)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return h.journal(ctx, r, "viewers.setWatchState", titleID, watchInverse{Op: "viewers.setWatchState", ViewerID: viewerID, TitleID: titleID, Watched: prev})
}

## Source: internal/plugins/host.go#*Manager.UndoSince

``````
// UndoSince reverses the plugin's changes back to and including entry
// since (0 means all of them), newest first, so an older change is never
// reversed underneath a later one.
func (m *Manager) UndoSince(ctx context.Context, pluginID string, since int64) (int, error) {
	entries, err := m.store.journalList(ctx, pluginID, 10000, true)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	undone := 0
	for _, e := range entries { // journalList is newest first
		if e.ID < since {
			break
		}
		if err := m.applyInverse(ctx, e); err != nil {
			return undone, err
		}
		if err := m.store.markUndone(ctx, e.ID); err != nil {
			return undone, err
		}
		undone++
	}
	return undone, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host.go#*Manager.applyInverse

``````
func (m *Manager) applyInverse(ctx context.Context, e JournalEntry) error {
	switch e.Op {
	case "viewers.setWatchState":
		var inv watchInverse
		if err := json.Unmarshal(e.Inverse, &inv); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if m.deps.Backends.SetWatchState == nil {
			return ErrUnavailable
		}
		_, err := m.deps.Backends.SetWatchState(ctx, inv.ViewerID, inv.TitleID, inv.Watched)
		return err
	case "collections.upsert":
		var inv collectionInverse
		if err := json.Unmarshal(e.Inverse, &inv); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if len(inv.Previous) > 0 {
			if m.deps.Backends.CollectionsUpsert == nil {
				return ErrUnavailable
			}
			_, err := m.deps.Backends.CollectionsUpsert(collectionContext(ctx, e.Plugin), inv.Previous)
			return err
		}
		if m.deps.Backends.CollectionsDelete == nil {
			return ErrUnavailable
		}
		return m.deps.Backends.CollectionsDelete(collectionContext(ctx, e.Plugin), inv.Doc)
	case "kinds.upsert":
		var inv kindInverse
		if err := json.Unmarshal(e.Inverse, &inv); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		b := m.kindBackends()
		if len(inv.Previous) > 0 {
			if b.KindUpsert == nil {
				return ErrUnavailable
			}
			if _, err := b.KindUpsert(ctx, e.Plugin, inv.Kind, inv.Previous); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		if len(inv.Items) > 0 {
			if b.KindDelete == nil {
				return ErrUnavailable
			}
			if err := b.KindDelete(ctx, e.Plugin, inv.Kind, inv.Items); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		return nil
	case "kinds.delete":
		var inv kindInverse
		if err := json.Unmarshal(e.Inverse, &inv); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		b := m.kindBackends()
		if b.KindUpsert == nil {
			return ErrUnavailable
		}
		if len(inv.Previous) > 0 {
			_, err := b.KindUpsert(ctx, e.Plugin, inv.Kind, inv.Previous)
			return err
		}
		return nil
	case "badges.set", "badges.clear":
		return nil
	default:
		return fmt.Errorf("plugins: no inverse for journal op %q", e.Op)
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host.go#*host.folderCheck

``````
func (h *host) folderCheck(ctx context.Context, root, path string) (string, error) {
	r, g, err := h.record(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if err := h.deny(r, g, "folders", normLevel(r.Manifest.Ether.Permissions.Folders),
		func(l string) bool { return l == "read" }); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	granted := false
	for _, f := range g.Folders {
		if f == root {
			granted = true
		}
	}
	if !granted {
		h.noteDenied("folders")
		return "", fmt.Errorf("%w: folder was not picked for this plugin", ErrPermissionDenied)
	}
	cleanRoot := filepath.Clean(root)
	joined := filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(cleanRoot, path))
	if joined != cleanRoot && !strings.HasPrefix(joined, cleanRoot+string(filepath.Separator)) {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("%w: path leaves the picked folder", ErrPermissionDenied)
	}
	return joined, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host.go#*host.FoldersList

``````
func (h *host) FoldersList(ctx context.Context, root, path string) ([]FolderEntry, error) {
	_, err := h.folderCheck(ctx, root, path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	fs, err := os.OpenRoot(root)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer fs.Close()
	name := path
	if name == "" {
		name = "."
	}
	dir, err := fs.Open(name)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer dir.Close()
	entries, err := dir.ReadDir(1000)
	if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return nil, err
	}
	out := make([]FolderEntry, 0, len(entries))
	for _, e := range entries {
		fe := FolderEntry{Name: e.Name(), Path: filepath.Join(path, e.Name()), Dir: e.IsDir()}
		if e.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
			// Follow a link only when its target stays inside the grant;
			// the rooted Stat fails for one that escapes.
			info, err := fs.Stat(filepath.Join(name, e.Name()))
			if err != nil {
				continue
			}
			fe.Dir, fe.Size, fe.Mtime = info.IsDir(), info.Size(), info.ModTime().Unix()
			out = append(out, fe)
			if len(out) >= 1000 {
				break
			}
			continue
		}
		if info, err := e.Info(); err == nil {
			fe.Size, fe.Mtime = info.Size(), info.ModTime().Unix()
		}
		out = append(out, fe)
		if len(out) >= 1000 {
			break
		}
	}
	return out, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host.go#*host.FoldersStat

``````
func (h *host) FoldersStat(ctx context.Context, root, path string) (FolderEntry, error) {
	_, err := h.folderCheck(ctx, root, path)
	if err != nil {
		return FolderEntry{}, err
	}
	fs, err := os.OpenRoot(root)
	if err != nil {
		return FolderEntry{}, err
	}
	defer fs.Close()
	name := path
	if name == "" {
		name = "."
	}
	info, err := fs.Stat(name)
	if err != nil {
		return FolderEntry{}, err
	}
	return FolderEntry{Name: info.Name(), Path: path, Dir: info.IsDir(), Size: info.Size(), Mtime: info.ModTime().Unix()}, nil
}

## Source: internal/plugins/host.go#*Manager.rateOK

``````
func (m *Manager) rateOK(bucket map[string][]time.Time, key string, limit int, window time.Duration) bool {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	now := m.now()
	kept := bucket[key][:0:0]
	for _, t := range bucket[key] {
		if now.Sub(t) < window {
			kept = append(kept, t)
		}
	}
	if len(kept) >= limit {
		bucket[key] = kept
		return false
	}
	bucket[key] = append(kept, now)
	return true
}
``````

// FoldersHash keeps small hashes synchronous; large files require an explicit job.

}

## Source: internal/plugins/host.go#*host.hashFile

``````
func (h *host) hashFile(ctx context.Context, root, path string, background bool, progress func(int64)) (FolderHash, error) {
	const capBytes = 256 << 20
	if _, err := h.folderCheck(ctx, root, path); err != nil {
		return FolderHash{}, err
	}
	for _, seg := range strings.FieldsFunc(path, func(r rune) bool { return r == '/' || r == '\\' }) {
		if seg == ".." {
			return FolderHash{}, ErrPermissionDenied
		}
	}
	realRoot, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(root)
	if err != nil {
		return FolderHash{}, err
	}
	target, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(filepath.Join(realRoot, path))
	if err != nil {
		return FolderHash{}, err
	}
	rel, err := filepath.Rel(realRoot, target)
	if err != nil || filepath.IsAbs(path) || rel == ".." || strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)) {
		return FolderHash{}, ErrPermissionDenied
	}
	fs, err := os.OpenRoot(root)
	if err != nil {
		return FolderHash{}, err
	}
	defer fs.Close()
	f, err := fs.Open(path)
	if err != nil {
		return FolderHash{}, err
	}
	defer f.Close()
	info, err := f.Stat()
	if err != nil {
		return FolderHash{}, err
	}
	if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
		return FolderHash{}, fmt.Errorf("folders.hash requires a regular file")
	}
	if !background && info.Size() > capBytes {
		return FolderHash{}, fmt.Errorf("folders.hash requires a regular file of at most 256 MiB")
	}
	key := fmt.Sprintf("host.hash.%x", sha256.Sum256([]byte(fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s:%d:%d", realRoot, rel, info.Size(), info.ModTime().UnixNano()))))
	if raw, ok, err := h.m.store.hashCacheGet(ctx, h.plugin, key); err != nil {
		return FolderHash{}, err
	} else if ok {
		var cached FolderHash
		if json.Unmarshal(raw, &cached) == nil {
			if _, err := h.folderCheck(ctx, root, path); err != nil {
				return FolderHash{}, err
			}
			return cached, nil
		}
	}
	crc, md, sha := crc32.NewIEEE(), md5.New(), sha1.New()
	w := io.MultiWriter(crc, md, sha)
	buf := make([]byte, 1<<20)
	var total int64
	for {
		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
			return FolderHash{}, err
		}
		if _, err := h.folderCheck(ctx, root, path); err != nil {
			return FolderHash{}, err
		}
		n, err := f.Read(buf)
		total += int64(n)
		if !background && total > capBytes {
			return FolderHash{}, fmt.Errorf("folders.hash size limit exceeded")
		}
		if n > 0 {
			_, _ = w.Write(buf[:n])
			if progress != nil {
				progress(total)
			}
			if background {
				timer := time.NewTimer(2 * time.Millisecond)
				select {
				case <-ctx.Done():
					timer.Stop()
					return FolderHash{}, ctx.Err()
				case <-timer.C:
				}
			}
		}
		if err == io.EOF {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			return FolderHash{}, err
		}
	}
	after, err := f.Stat()
	if err != nil {
		return FolderHash{}, err
	}
	if total != info.Size() || after.Size() != info.Size() || !after.ModTime().Equal(info.ModTime()) {
		return FolderHash{}, fmt.Errorf("folders.hash file changed while hashing")
	}
	result := FolderHash{Size: total, ModTime: info.ModTime().Unix(), CRC32: fmt.Sprintf("%08x", crc.Sum32()), MD5: fmt.Sprintf("%x", md.Sum(nil)), SHA1: fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha.Sum(nil))}
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(result)
	if err := h.m.store.hashCachePut(ctx, h.plugin, key, raw); err != nil {
		return FolderHash{}, err
	}
	return result, nil
}
``````

``````
// archiveIOBudget caps all metadata and compressed input reads cumulatively,
// including decoder read-ahead; seekReaderAt propagates the call deadline.
type archiveIOBudget struct {
	r    io.ReaderAt
	left int64
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_archive.go#*archiveIOBudget.ReadAt

``````
func (r *archiveIOBudget) ReadAt(p []byte, off int64) (int, error) {
	if int64(len(p)) > r.left {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("plugins: archive input exceeds byte grant")
	}
	n, err := r.r.ReadAt(p, off)
	r.left -= int64(n)
	return n, err
}

// archiveDirectoryCap scales with the grant like the other archive limits
// and matches the data parser's directory cap (host_data.go).
func archiveDirectoryCap(l RuntimeLimits) int64 {
	return min(int64(maxArchiveDirectory), int64(l.ArchiveMembers)*65536, archiveMemory(l)/8)
}

func archiveMemory(l RuntimeLimits) int64 {

		return 32 << 20
	}
	return int64(min(l.MemoryBytes, 2<<30))

## Source: internal/plugins/host_archive.go#archiveNameReason

``````
func archiveNameReason(name string) string {
	name = strings.TrimSuffix(name, "/")
	switch {
	case name == "":
		return "empty name"
	case len(name) > 1024:
		return "name exceeds 1024 bytes"
	case strings.ContainsRune(name, '\x00'):
		return "name contains NUL"
	case strings.ContainsRune(name, '\\'):
		return "name contains a backslash"
	case strings.HasPrefix(name, "/") || (len(name) >= 3 && ((name[0] >= 'a' && name[0] <= 'z') || (name[0] >= 'A' && name[0] <= 'Z')) && name[1:3] == ":/"):
		return "absolute path"
	case path.Clean(name) != name || name == ".." || strings.HasPrefix(name, "../"):
		return "name contains traversal or noncanonical path segments"
	}
	// Members are streamed by index; a colon is never used in a disk path.
	return ""
}
``````

func openDataArchive(ctx context.Context, rc io.ReadSeeker, l RuntimeLimits) (*dataArchive, error) {
	ra := &archiveIOBudget{r: seekReaderAt{ctx, rc}, left: l.FetchBytes}
	d, err := parseDataArchive(ctx, rc, ra, l)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &dataArchive{members: d.members, open: d.bind(ctx, ra, l)}, nil
}

## Source: internal/plugins/host_archive.go#parseDataArchive

``````
func parseDataArchive(ctx context.Context, rc io.ReadSeeker, ra *archiveIOBudget, l RuntimeLimits) (*dataArchiveDirectory, error) {
	size, err := rc.Seek(0, io.SeekEnd)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if size < 8 || size > l.FetchBytes {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: archive size outside grant")
	}
	memory := archiveMemory(l)
	if memory < 1<<20 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: archive memory grant too small")
	}
	var sig [8]byte
	if _, err = ra.ReadAt(sig[:], 0); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	format := container.Detect(sig[:])
	a := &dataArchiveDirectory{members: make([]ArchiveMember, 0)}
	switch format {
	case container.Format7z:
		files, e := container.List7zData(ctx, ra, size, container.Data7zLimits{MemoryBytes: memory, ExpandedBytes: l.ArchiveExpandedBytes, Members: l.ArchiveMembers})
		if e != nil {
			return nil, e
		}
		for i, f := range files {
			a.members = append(a.members, ArchiveMember{Index: i, Name: f.Name, Size: uint64(f.Size)})
		}
		a.bind = func(ctx context.Context, ra *archiveIOBudget, l RuntimeLimits) func(int) (io.ReadCloser, error) {
			return func(i int) (io.ReadCloser, error) {
				r, e := container.Open7zData(ctx, ra, files[i])
				if e != nil {
					return nil, e
				}
				return io.NopCloser(r), nil
			}
		}
	case container.FormatRAR4, container.FormatRAR5:
		// Header-only walk: listing a solid RAR never inflates earlier members.
		metadata := &archiveIOBudget{r: ra, left: min(int64(maxArchiveDirectory), memory/4)}
		v, e := container.ReadRARVolume(metadata, size, &container.RAROptions{Context: ctx, MaxHeaderBytes: memory / 16, MaxFiles: min(l.ArchiveMembers+1, int(memory/4096))})
		if e != nil {
			return nil, e
		}
		if v.MultiVolume || v.MoreVolumes || len(v.Files) > l.ArchiveMembers || len(v.Files) >= int(memory/4096) {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: split RAR or directory exceeds grant")
		}
		var solidPacked, solidExpanded int64
		for i, f := range v.Files {
			if f.SplitBefore || f.SplitAfter || f.Encrypted || f.NonRegular || f.UnpackedSize < 0 {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: split, encrypted or unsupported RAR member")
			}
			if !f.Solid {
				solidPacked, solidExpanded = 0, 0
			}
			solidPacked += f.PackedSize
			if f.UnpackedSize > l.ArchiveExpandedBytes-solidExpanded {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: RAR solid block exceeds byte grant")
			}
			solidExpanded += f.UnpackedSize
			if solidExpanded > 0 && (solidPacked == 0 || (solidPacked <= 1<<53 && solidExpanded > solidPacked*maxArchiveRatio)) {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: RAR member exceeds compression-ratio limit")
			}
			a.members = append(a.members, ArchiveMember{Index: i, Name: f.StoredName, Size: uint64(f.UnpackedSize)})
		}
		a.bind = func(ctx context.Context, ra *archiveIOBudget, l RuntimeLimits) func(int) (io.ReadCloser, error) {
			return func(i int) (io.ReadCloser, error) {
				if v.Files[i].Dir {
					return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: cannot open an archive directory")
				}
				r, e := rardecode.NewReader(io.NewSectionReader(ra, 0, size), rardecode.MaxDictionarySize(memory/8), rardecode.BufferSize(4096))
				if e != nil {
					return nil, e
				}
				// Explicitly consume dependencies under the expanded-byte grant. This also
				// keeps implicit solid skipping inside the decoder from doing uncounted work.
				left := l.ArchiveExpandedBytes
				start := i
				for start > 0 && v.Files[start].Solid {
					start--
				}
				for j := 0; j <= i; j++ {
					h, e := r.Next()
					if e != nil {
						return nil, e
					}
					normName := strings.ReplaceAll(h.Name, `\`, "/")
					if (normName != v.Files[j].Name && normName != strings.ReplaceAll(v.Files[j].StoredName, `\`, "/")) || h.UnPackedSize != v.Files[j].UnpackedSize || h.Encrypted || h.HeaderEncrypted {
						return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: inconsistent RAR member")
					}
					if j == i {
						return io.NopCloser(io.LimitReader(r, h.UnPackedSize)), nil
					}
					if j >= start || v.Solid {
						if h.UnPackedSize > left {
							return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: RAR decode exceeds byte grant")
						}
						if _, e = io.CopyN(io.Discard, &boundedDataReader{ctx: ctx, r: r, left: left}, h.UnPackedSize); e != nil {
							return nil, e
						}
						left -= h.UnPackedSize
					}
				}
				return nil, io.EOF
			}
		}
	default:
		z, e := parseDataZIP(rc, ra, l)
		if e != nil {
			return nil, e
		}
		files := make([]dataZIPMember, len(z.File))
		for i, f := range z.File {
			offset, e := f.DataOffset()
			if e != nil {
				return nil, e
			}
			if offset < 0 || offset > size || f.CompressedSize64 > uint64(size-offset) {
				return nil, zip.ErrFormat
			}
			// Descriptor metadata is immutable too; validate it once while
			// building the index, rather than retaining a zip.File's reader.
			if f.Flags&8 != 0 {
				at := offset + int64(f.CompressedSize64)
				var descriptor [12]byte
				if _, e := ra.ReadAt(descriptor[:], at); e != nil {
					return nil, e
				}
				crc := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(descriptor[:])
				if crc == 0x08074b50 {
					var rest [4]byte
					if _, e := ra.ReadAt(rest[:], at+12); e != nil {
						return nil, e
					}
					crc = binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(descriptor[4:])
				}
				if crc != f.CRC32 {
					return nil, zip.ErrChecksum
				}
			}
			files[i] = dataZIPMember{offset: offset, packed: int64(f.CompressedSize64), size: f.UncompressedSize64, crc: f.CRC32, method: f.Method, dir: f.FileInfo().IsDir(), verifyCRC: f.Flags&8 != 0 || f.CRC32 != 0}
			a.members = append(a.members, ArchiveMember{Index: i, Name: f.Name, Size: f.UncompressedSize64})
		}
		a.bind = func(_ context.Context, ra *archiveIOBudget, _ RuntimeLimits) func(int) (io.ReadCloser, error) {
			return func(i int) (io.ReadCloser, error) { return files[i].open(ra) }
		}
	}
	var total uint64
	var names int64
	for i := range a.members {
		m := &a.members[i]
		m.UnsafeReason = archiveNameReason(m.Name)
		m.Unsafe = m.UnsafeReason != ""
		names += int64(len(m.Name) + len(m.UnsafeReason))
		if names > memory/4 || m.Size > uint64(l.ArchiveMemberBytes) || m.Size > uint64(l.ArchiveExpandedBytes)-total {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: archive directory or member size exceeds grant")
		}
		total += m.Size
	}
	// Measure what the directory retains: each member's entry (including the
	// slice's spare capacity), a bounded per-member format table, and the name
	// bytes. ZIP comments/extras and raw directory buffers are not retained.
	a.bytes = 1024 + int64(cap(a.members))*(int64(unsafe.Sizeof(ArchiveMember{}))+archiveFormatEntryBytes) + names
	if a.bytes > archiveDirectoryCap(l) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: archive directory exceeds limit")
	}
	return a, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_archive.go#newPooledFlateReader

``````
func newPooledFlateReader(src io.Reader) io.ReadCloser {
	if p, ok := flateReaderPool.Get().(*pooledFlateReader); ok {
		p.br.Reset(src)
		if resetter, ok := p.zr.(flate.Resetter); ok && resetter.Reset(p.br, nil) == nil {
			p.done = false
			return p
		}
	}
	br := bufio.NewReaderSize(src, 4096)
	return &pooledFlateReader{zr: flate.NewReader(br), br: br}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_archive.go#*pooledFlateReader.Read

	return p.zr.Read(b)
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_archive.go#*pooledFlateReader.Close

``````
func (p *pooledFlateReader) Close() error {
	if p.done {
		return nil
	}
	p.done = true
	err := p.zr.Close()
	p.br.Reset(emptyFlateSource)
	if resetter, ok := p.zr.(flate.Resetter); ok {
		_ = resetter.Reset(emptyFlateSource, nil)
	}
	flateReaderPool.Put(p)
	return err
}
``````

// ZIP member offsets come from the validated immutable central directory. Each
// open creates a decoder and checksum state over this call's reader only.
type dataZIPMember struct {
	offset, packed int64
	size           uint64
	crc            uint32
	method         uint16
	dir            bool
	verifyCRC      bool
}

## Source: internal/plugins/host_archive.go#dataZIPMember.open

``````
func (f dataZIPMember) open(ra io.ReaderAt) (io.ReadCloser, error) {
	if f.dir {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: cannot open an archive directory")
	}
	section := io.NewSectionReader(ra, f.offset, f.packed)
	var r io.ReadCloser
	if f.method == zip.Deflate {
		r = newPooledFlateReader(section)
	} else {
		r = io.NopCloser(section)
	}
	return &dataZIPChecksum{ReadCloser: r, hash: crc32.NewIEEE(), size: f.size, crc: f.crc, verifyCRC: f.verifyCRC}, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_archive.go#dataZIPChecksum

``````
type dataZIPChecksum struct {
	io.ReadCloser
	hash       hash.Hash32
	read, size uint64
	crc        uint32
	verifyCRC  bool
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_archive.go#*dataZIPChecksum.Read

``````
func (r *dataZIPChecksum) Read(p []byte) (int, error) {
	n, err := r.ReadCloser.Read(p)
	r.read += uint64(n)
	r.hash.Write(p[:n])
	if r.read > r.size {
		return n, zip.ErrFormat
	}
	if err == io.EOF {
		if r.read != r.size {
			return n, io.ErrUnexpectedEOF
		}
		if r.verifyCRC && r.hash.Sum32() != r.crc {
			return n, zip.ErrChecksum
		}
	}
	return n, err
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_badges.go#NormalizeBadgeLabel

``````
// NormalizeBadgeLabel uppercases ASCII lowercase characters and validates that
// raw is 1..16 characters from [A-Z0-9 +&'./-] and not blank (#594).
func NormalizeBadgeLabel(raw string) (string, error) {
	if len(raw) < 1 || len(raw) > MaxBadgeLabelLen {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("must be 1 to %d characters", MaxBadgeLabelLen)
	}
	buf := make([]byte, len(raw))
	nonSpace := false
	for i := 0; i < len(raw); i++ {
		c := raw[i]
		if c >= 'a' && c <= 'z' {
			c = c - 'a' + 'A'
		}
		switch {
		case c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z',
			c >= '0' && c <= '9',
			c == '+', c == '&', c == '\'', c == '.', c == '/', c == '-':
			nonSpace = true
		case c == ' ':
		default:
			return "", fmt.Errorf("must contain only [A-Z0-9 +&'./-]")
		}
		buf[i] = c
	}
	if !nonSpace {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("must not be blank")
	}
	return string(buf), nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_badges.go#ExternalBadgeKeys

``````
// ExternalBadgeKeys returns the deterministic external-id fallback keys
// ("tmdb:<type>:<id>", "imdb:<type>:<id>") for a normalized BadgeTitleRef.
func ExternalBadgeKeys(ref BadgeTitleRef) (tmdbKey, imdbKey string) {
	if ref.TMDB > 0 && (ref.Type == "movie" || ref.Type == "show") {
		tmdbKey = fmt.Sprintf("tmdb:%s:%d", ref.Type, ref.TMDB)
	}
	if ref.IMDB != "" && (ref.Type == "movie" || ref.Type == "show") {
		imdbKey = fmt.Sprintf("imdb:%s:%s", ref.Type, strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(ref.IMDB)))
	}
	return tmdbKey, imdbKey
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_badges.go#*Manager.buildPosterBadgeSets

``````
func (m *Manager) buildPosterBadgeSets(ctx context.Context, r Record) []ActivePosterBadgeSet {
	if !r.Enabled || r.Shadow {
		return nil
	}
	man := r.Manifest
	man.Ether = man.EffectiveEther()
	if man.Ether == nil || !man.HasCapability(CapPosterBadges) {
		return nil
	}
	if g, err := m.store.grants(ctx, r.ID); err == nil && g.revoked(string(CapPosterBadges)) {
		return nil
	}
	decls := man.Ether.Contributes.PosterBadges
	if len(decls) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	out := make([]ActivePosterBadgeSet, 0, len(decls))
	for _, pb := range decls {
		lbl := pb.Label
		if strings.HasPrefix(lbl, "$t:") {
			if resolved, ok := m.ResolveText(ctx, r.ID, strings.TrimPrefix(lbl, "$t:"), "en"); ok && resolved != "" {
				lbl = resolved
			} else {
				lbl = pb.Key
			}
		}
		desc := pb.Description
		if strings.HasPrefix(desc, "$t:") {
			if resolved, ok := m.ResolveText(ctx, r.ID, strings.TrimPrefix(desc, "$t:"), "en"); ok {
				desc = resolved
			} else {
				desc = ""
			}
		}
		out = append(out, ActivePosterBadgeSet{
			PluginID:    r.ID,
			PluginName:  r.Name,
			Key:         pb.Key,
			LayerKey:    "plugin:" + r.ID + ":" + pb.Key,
			Label:       lbl,
			Description: desc,
		})
	}
	return out
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_badges.go#*Manager.syncPosterBadgeSets

``````
// syncPosterBadgeSets updates the in-memory active badge-set index when a
// plugin is installed, updated, enabled, disabled, shadowed or removed.
//
// Disabled and shadow plugins retain their stored rows in plugin_poster_badges
// and are filtered out at read time via ActivePosterBadgeSets, so re-enabling a
// plugin restores its badges immediately without drawing them while disabled.
func (m *Manager) syncPosterBadgeSets(ctx context.Context, r Record) {
	sets := m.buildPosterBadgeSets(ctx, r)
	m.mu.Lock()
	if m.posterBadgeSets == nil {
		m.posterBadgeSets = map[string][]ActivePosterBadgeSet{}
	}
	if len(sets) == 0 {
		delete(m.posterBadgeSets, r.ID)
	} else {
		m.posterBadgeSets[r.ID] = sets
	}
	m.mu.Unlock()
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_badges.go#*Manager.ActivePosterBadgeSets

``````
// ActivePosterBadgeSets returns declared poster badge sets for all currently
// enabled, non-shadow plugins in deterministic order without hitting SQLite
// once loaded.
func (m *Manager) ActivePosterBadgeSets(ctx context.Context) []ActivePosterBadgeSet {
	if m == nil {
		return nil
	}
	m.mu.Lock()
	loaded := m.posterBadgesLoaded
	m.mu.Unlock()
	if !loaded {
		if recs, err := m.store.list(ctx); err == nil {
			built := make(map[string][]ActivePosterBadgeSet, len(recs))
			for _, r := range recs {
				if sets := m.buildPosterBadgeSets(ctx, r); len(sets) > 0 {
					built[r.ID] = sets
				}
			}
			m.mu.Lock()
			m.posterBadgeSets = built
			m.posterBadgesLoaded = true
			m.mu.Unlock()
		}
	}
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	if len(m.posterBadgeSets) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	ids := make([]string, 0, len(m.posterBadgeSets))
	for id := range m.posterBadgeSets {
		ids = append(ids, id)
	}
	sort.Strings(ids)
	var out []ActivePosterBadgeSet
	for _, id := range ids {
		out = append(out, m.posterBadgeSets[id]...)
	}
	return out
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_badges.go#*host.badgeCheck

``````
func (h *host) badgeCheck(ctx context.Context, setKey string, needSet bool) (Record, PosterBadgeSetMeta, error) {
	r, g, err := h.record(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return Record{}, PosterBadgeSetMeta{}, err
	}
	man := r.Manifest
	man.Ether = man.EffectiveEther()
	if g.revoked(string(CapPosterBadges)) || man.Ether == nil || !man.HasCapability(CapPosterBadges) {
		h.noteDenied(string(CapPosterBadges))
		return Record{}, PosterBadgeSetMeta{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", ErrPermissionDenied, CapPosterBadges)
	}
	if !needSet {
		return r, PosterBadgeSetMeta{}, nil
	}
	if !posterBadgeKeyRe.MatchString(setKey) {
		return Record{}, PosterBadgeSetMeta{}, &ValidationError{Fields: []FieldError{{
			Field:   "setKey",
			Message: "must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$",
		}}}
	}
	for _, pb := range man.Ether.Contributes.PosterBadges {
		if pb.Key == setKey {
			return r, pb, nil
		}
	}
	return Record{}, PosterBadgeSetMeta{}, &ValidationError{Fields: []FieldError{{
		Field:   "setKey",
		Message: fmt.Sprintf("badge set %q is not declared in ether.contributes.posterBadges", setKey),
	}}}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_badges.go#*host.BadgesSet

``````
// BadgesSet pushes or deletes (empty Labels) poster badges for up to 500
// canonical titles in one declared badge set (#594).
//
// Title resolution runs once per batch against the local catalogue
// (TMDB first, then IMDb). Known titles store title_key = ratingKey.String();
// titles not yet in catalog_titles store title_key = "tmdb:<type>:<id>" (or
// "imdb:<type>:<id>"), and overlays queries both canonical and external keys
// in its per-page batch so pre-pushed badges light up as soon as a title
// enters the catalogue without any ingest hook.
func (h *host) BadgesSet(ctx context.Context, setKey string, entries []BadgeEntry) error {
	if err := h.requireWritableToolContext(ctx); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	r, _, err := h.badgeCheck(ctx, setKey, true)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if len(entries) > MaxBadgeEntriesPerCall {
		return &ValidationError{Fields: []FieldError{{
			Field:   "entries",
			Message: fmt.Sprintf("must contain at most %d entries per call", MaxBadgeEntriesPerCall),
		}}}
	}
	if len(entries) == 0 {
		return nil
	}

	writes := make([]normalizedBadgeWrite, len(entries))
	refs := make([]BadgeTitleRef, len(entries))
	hasUpsert := false
	for i, e := range entries {
		base := fmt.Sprintf("entries[%d]", i)
		typ := strings.TrimSpace(e.Title.Type)
		if typ != "movie" && typ != "show" {
			return &ValidationError{Fields: []FieldError{{
				Field:   base + ".title.type",
				Message: "must be movie or show",
			}}}
		}
		if e.Title.TMDB < 0 {
			return &ValidationError{Fields: []FieldError{{
				Field:   base + ".title.tmdb",
				Message: "must be a positive TMDB id",
			}}}
		}
		imdb := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(e.Title.IMDB))
		if imdb != "" && !imdbBadgeRe.MatchString(imdb) {
			return &ValidationError{Fields: []FieldError{{
				Field:   base + ".title.imdb",
				Message: "must match tt<digits>",
			}}}
		}
		if e.Title.TMDB == 0 && imdb == "" {
			return &ValidationError{Fields: []FieldError{{
				Field:   base + ".title",
				Message: "tmdb or imdb is required",
			}}}
		}
		if len(e.Labels) > MaxBadgeLabelsPerTitle {
			return &ValidationError{Fields: []FieldError{{
				Field:   base + ".labels",
				Message: fmt.Sprintf("at most %d labels per title per set", MaxBadgeLabelsPerTitle),
			}}}
		}
		var cleanLabels []string
		if len(e.Labels) > 0 {
			seenLabel := make(map[string]bool, len(e.Labels))
			cleanLabels = make([]string, 0, len(e.Labels))
			for j, raw := range e.Labels {
				norm, lerr := NormalizeBadgeLabel(raw)
				if lerr != nil {
					return &ValidationError{Fields: []FieldError{{
						Field:   fmt.Sprintf("%s.labels[%d]", base, j),
						Message: lerr.Error(),
					}}}
				}
				if !seenLabel[norm] {
					seenLabel[norm] = true
					cleanLabels = append(cleanLabels, norm)
				}
			}
			hasUpsert = true
		}
		ref := BadgeTitleRef{Type: typ, TMDB: e.Title.TMDB, IMDB: imdb}
		refs[i] = ref
		writes[i] = normalizedBadgeWrite{ref: ref, labels: cleanLabels}
	}

	if r.Shadow {
		return h.journal(ctx, r, "badges.set", setKey, map[string]any{
			"op":      "badges.set",
			"setKey":  setKey,
			"entries": len(entries),
		})
	}

	var resolved []string
	if resolveFn := h.m.resolveBadgeTitlesFn(); resolveFn != nil {
		resolved, err = resolveFn(ctx, refs)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	for i := range writes {
		tmdbKey, imdbKey := ExternalBadgeKeys(writes[i].ref)
		var primary string
		if i < len(resolved) && resolved[i] != "" {
			primary = resolved[i]
		} else if tmdbKey != "" {
			primary = tmdbKey
		} else {
			primary = imdbKey
		}
		writes[i].titleKey = primary
		for _, candidate := range []string{primary, tmdbKey, imdbKey} {
			if candidate == "" {
				continue
			}
			dup := false
			for _, existing := range writes[i].aliases {
				if existing == candidate {
					dup = true
					break
				}
			}
			if !dup {
				writes[i].aliases = append(writes[i].aliases, candidate)
			}
		}
	}

	quota := h.m.badgeTitleQuota()
	err = h.m.store.badgesSet(ctx, h.plugin, setKey, writes, hasUpsert, quota)
	if errors.Is(err, ErrQuotaExceeded) {
		used, _ := h.m.store.badgesTitleCount(ctx, h.plugin)
		h.m.emitBusEvent(events.EventPluginQuotaExceeded, h.plugin, events.PluginQuotaExceededPayload{
			PluginID:  h.plugin,
			Name:      r.Name,
			QuotaKind: "badges",
			Used:      used,
			Limit:     quota,
		}, false)
	}
	return err
}
``````

// BadgesClear removes every badge in one declared set for the calling plugin.
func (h *host) BadgesClear(ctx context.Context, setKey string) error {

	}

	}

		return h.journal(ctx, r, "badges.clear", setKey, map[string]any{

// BadgesUsage returns the calling plugin's distinct badged title count and quota.
func (h *host) BadgesUsage(ctx context.Context) (BadgeUsage, error) {
	if _, _, err := h.badgeCheck(ctx, "", false); err != nil {
		return BadgeUsage{}, err
	}
	titles, err := h.m.store.badgesTitleCount(ctx, h.plugin)
	if err != nil {
		return BadgeUsage{}, err
	}

		Titles:      titles,
		QuotaTitles: h.m.badgeTitleQuota(),
	}, nil

## Source: internal/plugins/host_badges.go#*storage.badgesSet

``````
func (s *storage) badgesSet(ctx context.Context, pluginID, setKey string, writes []normalizedBadgeWrite, hasUpsert bool, quota int64) error {
	tx, err := s.db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer tx.Rollback() //nolint:errcheck

	// Serialize concurrent badge writes for this plugin across connections so
	// the per-plugin distinct-title quota cannot be raced past.
	if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `UPDATE plugins_grants SET grants=grants WHERE plugin=?`, pluginID); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	var exists int
	if err := tx.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT 1 FROM plugins_installed WHERE id=?`, pluginID).Scan(&exists); errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
		return ErrPermissionDenied
	} else if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	now := s.now().Unix()
	for _, w := range writes {
		if len(w.labels) == 0 {
			for _, k := range w.aliases {
				if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `DELETE FROM plugin_poster_badges WHERE plugin_id=? AND set_key=? AND title_key=?`, pluginID, setKey, k); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
			continue
		}
		for _, k := range w.aliases {
			if k != w.titleKey {
				if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `DELETE FROM plugin_poster_badges WHERE plugin_id=? AND set_key=? AND title_key=?`, pluginID, setKey, k); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
		}
		raw, err := json.Marshal(w.labels)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `INSERT INTO plugin_poster_badges(plugin_id,set_key,title_key,labels_json,updated_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(plugin_id,set_key,title_key) DO UPDATE SET labels_json=excluded.labels_json,updated_at=excluded.updated_at`,
			pluginID, setKey, w.titleKey, string(raw), now); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}

	if hasUpsert {
		var titles int64
		if err := tx.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT title_key) FROM plugin_poster_badges WHERE plugin_id=?`, pluginID).Scan(&titles); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if titles > quota {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: poster badges are limited to %d titles per plugin", ErrQuotaExceeded, quota)
		}
	}

	return tx.Commit()
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_badges.go#ValidateBadgeSetCall

``````
// ValidateBadgeSetCall validates setKey and entries against manifest and label
// bounds, returning normalized entries for sandbox hosts (#594).
func ValidateBadgeSetCall(man Manifest, setKey string, entries []BadgeEntry) ([]BadgeEntry, error) {
	if err := ValidateBadgeClearCall(man, setKey); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if len(entries) > MaxBadgeEntriesPerCall {
		return nil, &ValidationError{Fields: []FieldError{{
			Field:   "entries",
			Message: fmt.Sprintf("must contain at most %d entries per call", MaxBadgeEntriesPerCall),
		}}}
	}
	out := make([]BadgeEntry, len(entries))
	for i, e := range entries {
		base := fmt.Sprintf("entries[%d]", i)
		typ := strings.TrimSpace(e.Title.Type)
		if typ != "movie" && typ != "show" {
			return nil, &ValidationError{Fields: []FieldError{{Field: base + ".title.type", Message: "must be movie or show"}}}
		}
		if e.Title.TMDB < 0 {
			return nil, &ValidationError{Fields: []FieldError{{Field: base + ".title.tmdb", Message: "must be a positive TMDB id"}}}
		}
		imdb := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(e.Title.IMDB))
		if imdb != "" && !imdbBadgeRe.MatchString(imdb) {
			return nil, &ValidationError{Fields: []FieldError{{Field: base + ".title.imdb", Message: "must match tt<digits>"}}}
		}
		if e.Title.TMDB == 0 && imdb == "" {
			return nil, &ValidationError{Fields: []FieldError{{Field: base + ".title", Message: "tmdb or imdb is required"}}}
		}
		if len(e.Labels) > MaxBadgeLabelsPerTitle {
			return nil, &ValidationError{Fields: []FieldError{{Field: base + ".labels", Message: fmt.Sprintf("at most %d labels per title per set", MaxBadgeLabelsPerTitle)}}}
		}
		var clean []string
		if len(e.Labels) > 0 {
			seen := make(map[string]bool, len(e.Labels))
			for j, raw := range e.Labels {
				norm, lerr := NormalizeBadgeLabel(raw)
				if lerr != nil {
					return nil, &ValidationError{Fields: []FieldError{{Field: fmt.Sprintf("%s.labels[%d]", base, j), Message: lerr.Error()}}}
				}
				if !seen[norm] {
					seen[norm] = true
					clean = append(clean, norm)
				}
			}
		}
		out[i] = BadgeEntry{Title: BadgeTitleRef{Type: typ, TMDB: e.Title.TMDB, IMDB: imdb}, Labels: clean}
	}
	return out, nil
}
``````

// and archive.read derived from the plugin's memory grant:

func dataReadLimit(limits RuntimeLimits) int64 {
	if limits.ReadBytes > 0 {
		return min(max(limits.ReadBytes, MinDataReadBytes), MaxDataReadBytes)
	}
	return DataReadBytes(limits.MemoryBytes)
}

## Source: internal/plugins/host_data.go#ArchiveReadItem

``````
// ArchiveReadItem selects one byte range inside one archive member for archive.read.
type ArchiveReadItem struct {
	Member int   `json:"member"`

## Source: internal/plugins/host_data.go#boundedDataReader

``````
// boundedDataReader propagates cancellation and rejects overflow instead of
// turning a truncated file into a successful content-addressed cache entry.
type boundedDataReader struct {
	ctx  context.Context
	r    io.Reader
	left int64
	size int64
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_data.go#*boundedDataReader.Read

``````
func (r *boundedDataReader) Read(p []byte) (int, error) {
	if err := r.ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	if r.left < 0 {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("plugins: data exceeds size limit")
	}
	if int64(len(p)) > r.left+1 {
		p = p[:r.left+1]
	}
	n, err := r.r.Read(p)
	r.left -= int64(n)
	r.size += int64(n)
	if r.left < 0 {
		return n, fmt.Errorf("plugins: data exceeds size limit")
	}
	return n, err
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_data.go#archiveExtractReader

``````
// archiveExtractReader bounds extracted bytes by both the archive member grant
// and the target library cache quota, charges per-MiB governance units, and
// refuses truncated streams before CachePut commits a partial blob.
type archiveExtractReader struct {
	ctx         context.Context
	r           io.Reader
	memberLimit int64
	cacheLimit  int64
	expected    int64
	size        int64
	chargedMiB  int64
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_data.go#*archiveExtractReader.Read

``````
func (r *archiveExtractReader) Read(p []byte) (int, error) {
	if err := r.ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	maxAllowed := min(r.memberLimit, r.cacheLimit)
	if r.size > maxAllowed {
		if r.size > r.cacheLimit {
			return 0, fmt.Errorf("%w: archive member exceeds library cache quota", ErrQuotaExceeded)
		}
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("plugins: archive member exceeds size grant")
	}
	if rem := maxAllowed - r.size; rem < int64(len(p))-1 {
		p = p[:rem+1]
	}
	n, err := r.r.Read(p)
	if n > 0 {
		r.size += int64(n)
		if r.size > r.memberLimit {
			return n, fmt.Errorf("plugins: archive member exceeds size grant")
		}
		if r.size > r.cacheLimit {
			return n, fmt.Errorf("%w: archive member exceeds library cache quota", ErrQuotaExceeded)
		}
		if wantMiB := (r.size + (1 << 20) - 1) >> 20; wantMiB > r.chargedMiB {
			if cerr := wasm.ChargeUnits(r.ctx, (wantMiB-r.chargedMiB)*wasm.ArchiveExtractUnitsPerMiB); cerr != nil {
				return n, cerr
			}
			r.chargedMiB = wantMiB
		}
	}
	if err == io.EOF && r.size != r.expected {
		return n, io.ErrUnexpectedEOF
	}
	return n, err
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_data.go#*host.HTTPFetchToCache

``````
func (h *host) HTTPFetchToCache(ctx context.Context, req FetchCacheRequest) (FetchCacheResult, error) {
	if req.Method != "" && req.Method != "GET" {
		return FetchCacheResult{}, fmt.Errorf("plugins: fetchToCache supports GET only")
	}
	if err := h.requireWritableToolContext(ctx); err != nil {
		return FetchCacheResult{}, err
	}
	decl, err := h.cacheWriteCheck(ctx, req.LibraryKey, req.Name)
	if err != nil {
		return FetchCacheResult{}, err
	}
	fetchCtx := ctx
	if req.TimeoutMS > 0 {
		var cancel context.CancelFunc
		fetchCtx, cancel = context.WithTimeout(ctx, time.Duration(min(req.TimeoutMS, int64(86400000)))*time.Millisecond)
		defer cancel()
	}
	resp, err := h.openFetch(fetchCtx, req.FetchRequest)
	if err != nil {
		return FetchCacheResult{}, err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	if resp.StatusCode < 200 || resp.StatusCode >= 300 {
		return FetchCacheResult{}, fmt.Errorf("plugins: fetchToCache HTTP %d", resp.StatusCode)
	}
	crc, m, s := crc32.NewIEEE(), md5.New(), sha1.New()
	reader := &boundedDataReader{ctx: fetchCtx, r: resp.Body, left: min(h.DataLimits(ctx).FetchBytes, decl.Cache.EffectiveMaxBytes())}
	ref, err := h.CachePut(fetchCtx, req.LibraryKey, req.Name, io.TeeReader(reader, io.MultiWriter(crc, m, s)))
	h.noteFetchTraffic(ctx, req.FetchRequest, reader.size)
	if err != nil {
		var netErr net.Error
		if errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) ||
			(errors.As(err, &netErr) && netErr.Timeout()) ||
			(errors.Is(fetchCtx.Err(), context.DeadlineExceeded) && !errors.Is(err, ErrPermissionDenied) && !errors.Is(err, ErrQuotaExceeded)) {
			u, _ := url.Parse(req.URL)
			return FetchCacheResult{}, fetchError(u.Hostname(), context.DeadlineExceeded)
		}
		return FetchCacheResult{}, err
	}
	return FetchCacheResult{Blob: ref, Size: reader.size, CRC32: fmt.Sprintf("%08x", crc.Sum32()), MD5: fmt.Sprintf("%x", m.Sum(nil)), SHA1: fmt.Sprintf("%x", s.Sum(nil)), Status: resp.StatusCode}, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_data.go#*host.CacheRasterize

``````
// CacheRasterize rasterises an SVG already in the plugin's own blob cache
// into a new cached bitmap blob, using Ether's bounded SVG rasteriser. The
// source read is capped at the rasteriser's SVG size limit, output sizes
// are bounded by its dimension limit, and artwork.ErrSVG is returned for
// documents the rasteriser refuses. Rendered variants are cached by the
// rasteriser (by source content and size) and the stored blob is
// content-addressed, so repeat calls return the same reference.
func (h *host) CacheRasterize(ctx context.Context, libraryKey, name, sourceBlobRef string, opts RasterizeOptions) (RasterizeResult, error) {
	if err := h.requireWritableToolContext(ctx); err != nil {
		return RasterizeResult{}, err
	}
	if _, err := h.cacheWriteCheck(ctx, libraryKey, name); err != nil {
		return RasterizeResult{}, err
	}
	format := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(opts.Format))
	if format == "" {
		format = "png"
	}
	if opts.Width < 0 || opts.Height < 0 || opts.Width > artwork.MaxRasterDimension || opts.Height > artwork.MaxRasterDimension || (format != "png" && format != "jpeg") {
		return RasterizeResult{}, artwork.ErrSVG
	}
	rc, err := h.CacheOpen(ctx, sourceBlobRef)
	if err != nil {
		return RasterizeResult{}, err
	}
	source, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(rc, artwork.MaxSVGBytes+1))
	_ = rc.Close()
	if err != nil {
		return RasterizeResult{}, err
	}
	raster := h.m.iconRaster
	if raster == nil {
		raster = artwork.NewSVGRasterizer()
	}
	data, contentType, err := raster.Rasterize(ctx, "plugin:"+h.plugin+":"+sourceBlobRef, source, artwork.RasterOptions{Width: opts.Width, Height: opts.Height, Format: format})
	if err != nil {
		return RasterizeResult{}, err
	}
	var dims struct{ Width, Height int }
	if format == "png" {
		cfg, derr := png.DecodeConfig(bytes.NewReader(data))
		if derr != nil {
			return RasterizeResult{}, derr
		}
		dims.Width, dims.Height = cfg.Width, cfg.Height
	} else {
		cfg, derr := jpeg.DecodeConfig(bytes.NewReader(data))
		if derr != nil {
			return RasterizeResult{}, derr
		}
		dims.Width, dims.Height = cfg.Width, cfg.Height
	}
	ref, err := h.CachePut(ctx, libraryKey, name, bytes.NewReader(data))
	if err != nil {
		return RasterizeResult{}, err
	}
	return RasterizeResult{Blob: ref, ContentType: contentType, Width: dims.Width, Height: dims.Height, Size: int64(len(data))}, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_data.go#validDataRange

``````
func validDataRange(r DataRange, maxBytes int64) error {
	if r.Offset < 0 || r.Length <= 0 || r.Length > maxBytes || r.Offset > 1<<60 {
		return fmt.Errorf("plugins: range needs nonnegative offset and length 1..%d", maxBytes)
	}
	return nil
}

## Source: internal/plugins/host_data.go#readAllSized

``````
func readAllSized(r io.Reader, sizeHint int64) ([]byte, error) {
	if sizeHint < 0 {
		sizeHint = 0
	}
	capHint := min(sizeHint+512, int64(8<<20))
	if capHint < 512 {
		capHint = 512
	}
	b := make([]byte, 0, capHint)
	for {
		if len(b) == cap(b) {
			next := max(cap(b)*2, 4096)
			if sizeHint > int64(next) {
				next = int(min(sizeHint+512, int64(MaxDataReadBytes)+512))
			}
			grown := make([]byte, len(b), next)
			copy(grown, b)
			b = grown
		}
		n, err := r.Read(b[len(b):cap(b)])
		b = b[:len(b)+n]
		if err != nil {
			if err == io.EOF {
				return b, nil
			}
			return b, err
		}
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_data.go#readDataRangeBytes

``````
func readDataRangeBytes(ctx context.Context, r io.Reader, opt DataRange, maxBytes, sizeHint int64) ([]byte, error) {
	if err := validDataRange(opt, maxBytes); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	cr := &boundedDataReader{ctx: ctx, r: r, left: opt.Offset + opt.Length}
	if opt.Offset > 0 {
		if _, err := io.CopyN(io.Discard, cr, opt.Offset); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	return readAllSized(io.LimitReader(cr, opt.Length), sizeHint)
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_data.go#readDataRange

``````
// Always return base64: arbitrary text/control bytes then have a predictable
// JSON envelope scaled with the plugin's per-call readBytes grant.
func readDataRange(ctx context.Context, r io.Reader, opt DataRange, maxBytes, sizeHint int64) (map[string]any, error) {
	data, err := readDataRangeBytes(ctx, r, opt, maxBytes, sizeHint)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return map[string]any{"bodyBase64": base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(data), "size": len(data)}, nil
}

## Source: internal/plugins/host_data.go#readArchiveMemberRange

``````
func readArchiveMemberRange(ctx context.Context, archive *dataArchive, member int, opt DataRange, maxBytes int64) ([]byte, error) {
	if member < 0 || member >= len(archive.members) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: archive member index outside range")
	}
	f := archive.members[member]
	if uint64(opt.Offset) > f.Size {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: archive member offset outside range")
	}
	stream, err := archive.open(member)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer stream.Close()
	rem := int64(min(f.Size-uint64(opt.Offset), uint64(maxBytes)))
	sizeHint := min(opt.Length, rem)
	return readDataRangeBytes(ctx, io.LimitReader(stream, int64(f.Size)), opt, maxBytes, sizeHint)
}

## Source: internal/plugins/host_data.go#seekReaderAt

``````
// seekReaderAt gives zip.Reader random access without materializing an archive.
// It is used by one synchronous host call, never shared between goroutines.
type seekReaderAt struct {
	ctx context.Context
	r   io.ReadSeeker
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_data.go#seekReaderAt.ReadAt

``````
func (r seekReaderAt) ReadAt(p []byte, off int64) (int, error) {
	if err := r.ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	if ra, ok := r.r.(io.ReaderAt); ok {
		n, err := ra.ReadAt(p, off)
		if err == io.EOF && n == len(p) {
			err = nil
		}
		return n, err
	}
	if _, err := r.r.Seek(off, io.SeekStart); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	n, err := io.ReadFull(r.r, p)
	if err == io.ErrUnexpectedEOF {
		err = io.EOF
	}
	return n, err
}
``````

func openDataZIP(ctx context.Context, rc io.ReadSeeker, grants ...RuntimeLimits) (*zip.Reader, error) {
	limits := defaultDataLimits()
	if len(grants) > 0 {
		limits = grants[0]

## Source: internal/plugins/host_data.go#parseDataZIP

``````
func parseDataZIP(rc io.ReadSeeker, ra *archiveIOBudget, limits RuntimeLimits) (*zip.Reader, error) {
	directoryCap := archiveDirectoryCap(limits)

	size, err := rc.Seek(0, io.SeekEnd)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if size < 22 || size > limits.FetchBytes {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: ZIP size outside limit")
	}
	tailSize := min(size, int64(65557))
	tail := make([]byte, tailSize)
	if _, err := ra.ReadAt(tail, size-tailSize); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	// Inspect classic/ZIP64 EOCD before zip.NewReader allocates the directory.
	// Split archives are refused; counts and bytes use owner ceilings.
	found := false
	for i := len(tail) - 22; i >= 0; i-- {
		if binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(tail[i:]) != 0x06054b50 || i+22+int(binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(tail[i+20:])) != len(tail) {
			continue
		}
		e := tail[i:]
		count := uint64(binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(e[10:]))
		directory := uint64(binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(e[12:]))
		offset := uint64(binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(e[16:]))
		directoryEnd := size - tailSize + int64(i)
		if binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(e[4:]) != 0 || binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(e[6:]) != 0 || uint64(binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(e[8:])) != count {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: split ZIP archives are unsupported")
		}
		if count == 65535 || directory == 0xffffffff || offset == 0xffffffff {
			locator := make([]byte, 20)
			if directoryEnd < 20 {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: invalid ZIP64 locator")
			}
			if _, err := ra.ReadAt(locator, directoryEnd-20); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			if binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(locator) != 0x07064b50 || binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(locator[4:]) != 0 || binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(locator[16:]) != 1 {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: invalid or split ZIP64 archive")
			}
			recordAt := binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(locator[8:])
			if recordAt > uint64(directoryEnd-20) || uint64(directoryEnd-20)-recordAt < 56 {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: invalid ZIP64 directory offset")
			}
			record := make([]byte, 56)
			if _, err := ra.ReadAt(record, int64(recordAt)); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			recordLength := binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(record[4:])
			if binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(record) != 0x06064b50 || recordLength < 44 || recordLength > 1<<20 || recordAt+12+recordLength != uint64(directoryEnd-20) || binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(record[16:]) != 0 || binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(record[20:]) != 0 || binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(record[24:]) != binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(record[32:]) {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: invalid ZIP64 directory")
			}
			count = binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(record[32:])
			directory = binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(record[40:])
			offset = binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(record[48:])
			directoryEnd = int64(recordAt)
		}
		if count > uint64(limits.ArchiveMembers) || count > uint64(archiveMemory(limits)/1024) || directory > uint64(directoryCap) || offset > uint64(directoryEnd) || directory > uint64(directoryEnd)-offset || offset+directory != uint64(directoryEnd) {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: ZIP directory exceeds owner limits or has unsupported layout")
		}
		raw := make([]byte, int(directory))
		if _, err := ra.ReadAt(raw, int64(offset)); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		pos := 0
		for n := 0; n < int(count); n++ {
			if pos+46 > len(raw) || binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(raw[pos:]) != 0x02014b50 {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: invalid ZIP directory")
			}
			header := raw[pos:]
			pos += 46 + int(binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(header[28:])) + int(binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(header[30:])) + int(binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(header[32:]))
			if pos > len(raw) {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: invalid ZIP directory length")
			}
		}
		if pos != len(raw) {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: ZIP directory count mismatch")
		}
		found = true
		break
	}
	if !found {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: ZIP directory not found")
	}
	z, err := zip.NewReader(ra, size)
	// With zipinsecurepath=0, Go still returns the directory alongside this
	// warning. Names are identifiers here; the per-member guard controls opens.
	if err != nil && err != zip.ErrInsecurePath {
		return nil, err
	}
	if len(z.File) > limits.ArchiveMembers {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: ZIP has too many members")
	}
	var total uint64
	names := 0
	for _, f := range z.File {
		names += len(f.Name)
		if int64(names) > directoryCap {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: ZIP member names exceed directory grant")
		}
		if !f.FileInfo().IsDir() && !f.Mode().IsRegular() {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: unsupported ZIP member type")
		}
		if f.Flags&1 != 0 || (f.Method != zip.Store && f.Method != zip.Deflate) {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: encrypted or unsupported ZIP member")
		}
		if f.CompressedSize64 > uint64(size) || f.UncompressedSize64 > uint64(limits.ArchiveMemberBytes) || (f.UncompressedSize64 > 0 && (f.CompressedSize64 == 0 || (f.CompressedSize64 <= ^uint64(0)/maxArchiveRatio && f.UncompressedSize64 > f.CompressedSize64*maxArchiveRatio))) {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: ZIP member exceeds size or compression-ratio limit")
		}
		if f.UncompressedSize64 > uint64(limits.ArchiveExpandedBytes)-total {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: ZIP expanded size exceeds limit")
		}
		total += f.UncompressedSize64
	}
	return z, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_data.go#CallDataHost

``````
// CallDataHost is the shared hosted/remote data-service funnel. Only named
// services are accepted; cache access rechecks plugin ownership each call.
func CallDataHost(ctx context.Context, h Host, name string, raw json.RawMessage) (json.RawMessage, error) {
	ctx = withCallRecord(ctx, h)
	// Remote callers receive the same maximum I/O deadline as hosted calls.
	limits := defaultDataLimits()
	if provider, ok := h.(interface {
		DataLimits(context.Context) RuntimeLimits
	}); ok {
		limits = provider.DataLimits(ctx)
	}
	if active, ok := wasm.CallLimits(ctx); ok {
		limits.MemoryBytes = active.MemoryBytes
		limits.Deadline = active.Deadline.String()
		limits.UnitBudget = active.UnitBudget
		limits.PoolSize = active.PoolSize
	}
	limits.ReadBytes = dataReadLimit(limits)
	readCap := limits.ReadBytes

	deadline, err := time.ParseDuration(limits.Deadline)
	if err != nil || deadline <= 0 {
		deadline = 12 * time.Hour
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, deadline)
	defer cancel()
	var args []json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &args); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var value any
	if name == "runtime.limits" {
		if len(args) != 0 {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: runtime.limits takes no arguments")
		}
		if ph, ok := h.(*host); ok {
			r, rerr := ph.callRecord(ctx)
			if rerr != nil {
				return nil, rerr
			}
			if !r.Enabled {
				return nil, ErrDisabled
			}
		}
		value = limits
	} else if name == "http.hash" {
		var req HashRequest
		if len(args) != 1 {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: hash takes one request")
		}
		if err = json.Unmarshal(args[0], &req); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		service, ok := h.(interface {
			HTTPHash(context.Context, HashRequest) (HashResult, error)
		})
		if !ok {
			return nil, ErrUnavailable
		}
		value, err = service.HTTPHash(ctx, req)
	} else if name == "http.fetchToCache" {
		var req struct {
			TimeoutMS  int64             `json:"timeoutMs"`
			Method     string            `json:"method"`
			URL        string            `json:"url"`
			Headers    map[string]string `json:"headers"`
			LibraryKey string            `json:"libraryKey"`
			Name       string            `json:"name"`
		}
		if len(args) != 1 {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: fetchToCache takes one request")
		}
		if err = json.Unmarshal(args[0], &req); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if req.Method != "" && req.Method != "GET" {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: fetchToCache supports GET only")
		}
		service, ok := h.(interface {
			HTTPFetchToCache(context.Context, FetchCacheRequest) (FetchCacheResult, error)
		})
		if !ok {
			return nil, ErrUnavailable
		}
		value, err = service.HTTPFetchToCache(ctx, FetchCacheRequest{
			FetchRequest: FetchRequest{TimeoutMS: req.TimeoutMS, Method: req.Method, URL: req.URL, Headers: req.Headers},
			LibraryKey:   req.LibraryKey,
			Name:         req.Name,
		})
	} else if name == "cache.rasterize" {
		if len(args) < 3 || len(args) > 4 {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: cache.rasterize takes (libraryKey, name, sourceBlob[, options])")
		}
		var libraryKey, entryName, sourceBlobRef string
		var opts RasterizeOptions
		if err = json.Unmarshal(args[0], &libraryKey); err == nil {
			err = json.Unmarshal(args[1], &entryName)
		}
		if err == nil {
			err = json.Unmarshal(args[2], &sourceBlobRef)
		}
		if err == nil && len(args) == 4 && string(args[3]) != "null" {
			err = json.Unmarshal(args[3], &opts)
		}
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		service, ok := h.(interface {
			CacheRasterize(context.Context, string, string, string, RasterizeOptions) (RasterizeResult, error)
		})
		if !ok {
			return nil, ErrUnavailable
		}
		value, err = service.CacheRasterize(ctx, libraryKey, entryName, sourceBlobRef, opts)
	} else {
		if name != "cache.read" && name != "archive.list" && name != "archive.open" && name != "archive.read" && name != "archive.extract" {
			return nil, ErrPermissionDenied
		}
		if len(args) == 0 {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: data service needs a blob reference")
		}
		var ref string
		if err = json.Unmarshal(args[0], &ref); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		var opt DataRange
		var reads []ArchiveReadItem
		var extractOpt ArchiveExtractOptions
		var member int
		switch name {
		case "archive.list":
			if len(args) != 1 {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: archive.list takes one blob reference")
			}
		case "cache.read":
			if len(args) != 2 {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: cache.read takes (blob, range)")
			}
			err = json.Unmarshal(args[1], &opt)
		case "archive.open":
			if len(args) != 3 {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: archive.open takes (blob, memberIndex, range)")
			}
			if err = json.Unmarshal(args[1], &member); err == nil {
				err = json.Unmarshal(args[2], &opt)
			}
		case "archive.read":
			if len(args) != 2 {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: archive.read takes (blob, reads)")
			}
			err = json.Unmarshal(args[1], &reads)
		case "archive.extract":
			if len(args) < 2 || len(args) > 3 {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: archive.extract takes (blob, memberIndex[, options])")
			}
			err = json.Unmarshal(args[1], &member)
			if err == nil && len(args) == 3 && string(args[2]) != "null" {
				err = json.Unmarshal(args[2], &extractOpt)
			}
		}
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if name == "cache.read" || name == "archive.open" {
			if err = validDataRange(opt, readCap); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
		}
		if name == "archive.read" {
			if len(reads) == 0 || len(reads) > MaxArchiveReadItems {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: archive.read takes 1..%d reads", MaxArchiveReadItems)
			}
			var totalRequested int64
			for _, item := range reads {
				if err = validDataRange(DataRange{Offset: item.Offset, Length: item.Length}, readCap); err != nil {
					return nil, err
				}
				if item.Length > readCap-totalRequested {
					return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: archive.read requested bytes exceed per-call readBytes limit (%d)", readCap)
				}
				totalRequested += item.Length
			}
			if err = wasm.ChargeUnits(ctx, int64(len(reads))*wasm.ArchiveReadUnitsPerMember); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
		}
		var defaultLibKey string
		if name == "archive.extract" {
			if checker, ok := h.(interface {
				archiveExtractCheck(context.Context, string) (string, error)
			}); ok {
				defaultLibKey, err = checker.archiveExtractCheck(ctx, extractOpt.LibraryKey)
				if err != nil {
					return nil, err
				}
			}
		}
		rc, e := h.CacheOpen(ctx, ref)
		if e != nil {
			return nil, e
		}
		defer rc.Close()
		if name == "cache.read" {
			if _, err = rc.Seek(opt.Offset, io.SeekStart); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			sizeHint := min(opt.Length, int64(64<<10))
			if sizer, ok := rc.(interface{ Size() int64 }); ok {
				if rem := sizer.Size() - opt.Offset; rem >= 0 {
					sizeHint = min(opt.Length, rem)
				}
			}
			opt.Offset = 0
			value, err = readDataRange(ctx, rc, opt, readCap, sizeHint)
		} else {
			var archive *dataArchive
			var e error
			if owner, ok := h.(interface{ archiveDirectoryCache() *archiveDirectoryCache }); ok {
				archive, e = owner.archiveDirectoryCache().open(ctx, ref, rc, limits)
			} else {
				archive, e = openDataArchive(ctx, rc, limits)
			}
			if e != nil {
				return nil, e
			}
			switch name {
			case "archive.list":
				value = archive.members
			case "archive.open":
				var data []byte
				data, err = readArchiveMemberRange(ctx, archive, member, opt, readCap)
				if err != nil {
					return nil, err
				}
				value = map[string]any{"bodyBase64": base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(data), "size": len(data)}
			case "archive.read":
				out := make([]ArchiveReadResult, len(reads))
				for i, item := range reads {
					var data []byte
					data, err = readArchiveMemberRange(ctx, archive, item.Member, DataRange{Offset: item.Offset, Length: item.Length}, readCap)
					if err != nil {
						return nil, err
					}
					out[i] = ArchiveReadResult{
						Index:      i,
						Member:     item.Member,
						Size:       len(data),
						BodyBase64: base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(data),
					}
				}
				value = out
			case "archive.extract":
				if member < 0 || member >= len(archive.members) {
					return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: archive member index outside range")
				}
				f := archive.members[member]
				entryName := strings.TrimSpace(extractOpt.Name)
				if entryName == "" && !f.Unsafe {
					entryName = path.Base(strings.TrimSuffix(f.Name, "/"))
				}
				if entryName == "" || entryName == "." || entryName == "/" {
					entryName = fmt.Sprintf("member-%d", member)
				}
				sourceLibKey := ""
				if src, ok := rc.(interface{ LibraryKey() string }); ok {
					sourceLibKey = src.LibraryKey()
				}
				libraryKey := extractOpt.LibraryKey
				cacheLimit := int64(MaxDataFetchBytes)
				if resolver, ok := h.(interface {
					resolveExtractTarget(context.Context, string, string, string) (string, int64, error)
				}); ok {
					libraryKey, cacheLimit, err = resolver.resolveExtractTarget(ctx, extractOpt.LibraryKey, sourceLibKey, entryName)
					if err != nil {
						return nil, err
					}
				} else if libraryKey == "" {
					if sourceLibKey != "" {
						libraryKey = sourceLibKey
					} else {
						libraryKey = defaultLibKey
					}
				}
				if f.Size > uint64(limits.ArchiveMemberBytes) {
					return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: archive member exceeds size grant")
				}
				if f.Size > uint64(cacheLimit) {
					return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: archive member (%d bytes) exceeds library cache quota (%d bytes)", ErrQuotaExceeded, f.Size, cacheLimit)
				}
				stream, e := archive.open(member)
				if e != nil {
					return nil, e
				}
				defer stream.Close()
				crc, md5Hash, sha1Hash := crc32.NewIEEE(), md5.New(), sha1.New()
				reader := &archiveExtractReader{
					ctx:         ctx,
					r:           stream,
					memberLimit: limits.ArchiveMemberBytes,
					cacheLimit:  cacheLimit,
					expected:    int64(f.Size),
				}
				cachedRef, e := h.CachePut(ctx, libraryKey, entryName, io.TeeReader(reader, io.MultiWriter(crc, md5Hash, sha1Hash)))
				if e != nil {
					return nil, e
				}
				value = ArchiveExtractResult{
					Ref:   cachedRef,
					Size:  reader.size,
					SHA1:  fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha1Hash.Sum(nil)),
					MD5:   fmt.Sprintf("%x", md5Hash.Sum(nil)),
					CRC32: fmt.Sprintf("%08x", crc.Sum32()),
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return json.Marshal(value)
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_flows.go#isSafePluginRoute

``````
func isSafePluginRoute(p string) bool {
	if p == "" || len(p) > 256 {
		return false
	}
	if !strings.HasPrefix(p, "/") || strings.HasPrefix(p, "//") {
		return false
	}
	if strings.ContainsAny(p, "\r\n\\") || strings.Contains(p, "://") {
		return false
	}
	for _, seg := range strings.Split(p, "/") {
		if seg == ".." {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_flows.go#*Manager.SetFlowsBackends

``````
// SetFlowsBackends wires the Events bus, Events schema registry, and Flows
// action registry after Manager construction and immediately registers all
// currently installed enabled plugins' events and actions.
func (m *Manager) SetFlowsBackends(bus *events.Bus, reg *events.Registry, actions flows.ActionRegistry) {
	m.mu.Lock()
	m.deps.EventBus = bus
	m.deps.EventRegistry = reg
	m.deps.FlowActions = actions
	m.mu.Unlock()

	if reg == nil && actions == nil {
		return
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	if recs, err := m.store.list(ctx); err == nil {
		for _, r := range recs {
			m.syncFlowsPlugin(ctx, r)
		}
	}
}
``````

func (m *Manager) resolvePluginCopy(ctx context.Context, pluginID, raw, fallback string) string {
	if strings.HasPrefix(raw, "$t:") {
		if resolved, ok := m.ResolveText(ctx, pluginID, strings.TrimPrefix(raw, "$t:"), "en"); ok && strings.TrimSpace(resolved) != "" {
			return resolved
		}
		if fallback != "" {
			return fallback
		}
		return strings.TrimPrefix(raw, "$t:")
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(raw) == "" {
		return fallback
	}
	return raw
}

## Source: internal/plugins/host_flows.go#convertEventEnums

``````
func convertEventEnums(opts []EventEnumOption, resolve func(raw, fallback string) string) []events.EnumOption {
	if len(opts) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	if resolve == nil {
		resolve = defaultCopyResolver
	}
	out := make([]events.EnumOption, len(opts))
	for i, opt := range opts {
		lbl := opt.Label
		if lbl != "" {
			lbl = resolve(lbl, opt.Value)
		}
		out[i] = events.EnumOption{
			Value: opt.Value,
			Label: lbl,
		}
	}
	return out
}

``````
func convertEventFields(fields []EventFieldMeta, resolve func(raw, fallback string) string) []events.FieldSchema {
	if len(fields) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	if resolve == nil {
		resolve = defaultCopyResolver
	}
	out := make([]events.FieldSchema, len(fields))
	for i, f := range fields {
		out[i] = events.FieldSchema{
			Name:        f.Name,
			Type:        events.FieldType(f.Type),
			Label:       resolve(f.Label, f.Name),
			Description: resolve(f.Description, ""),
			Unit:        f.Unit,
			Enum:        convertEventEnums(f.Enum, resolve),
			PII:         f.PII,
			Secret:      f.Secret,
			Filterable:  f.Filterable,
			Example:     f.Example,
		}
	}
	return out
}

## Source: internal/plugins/host_flows.go#BuildPluginEventSchemas

``````
// BuildPluginEventSchemas builds the events.EventSchema entries contributed by
// man for pluginID. resolve may be nil to keep literal labels.
func BuildPluginEventSchemas(pluginID string, man Manifest, resolve func(raw, fallback string) string) []events.EventSchema {
	man.Ether = man.EffectiveEther()
	if man.Ether == nil || !man.HasCapability(CapEvents) || man.Ether.Contributes.Events == nil {
		return nil
	}
	decls := man.Ether.Contributes.Events.Publish
	if len(decls) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	if resolve == nil {
		resolve = func(raw, fallback string) string {
			if strings.TrimSpace(raw) == "" {
				return fallback
			}
			return raw
		}
	}
	out := make([]events.EventSchema, 0, len(decls))
	for _, pe := range decls {
		ver := pe.Version
		if ver <= 0 {
			ver = 1
		}
		out = append(out, events.EventSchema{
			Type:        events.PluginEventType(pluginID, pe.Key),
			Version:     ver,
			Domain:      events.PluginPrefix + pluginID,
			Label:       resolve(pe.Label, pe.Key),
			Description: resolve(pe.Description, ""),
			Owner:       pluginID,
			Fields:      convertEventFields(pe.Fields, resolve),
		})
	}
	return out
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_flows.go#BuildPluginActionSpec

``````
// BuildPluginActionSpec builds the flows.ActionSpec for one manifest-declared
// plugin flow action.
func BuildPluginActionSpec(pluginID, group string, act FlowActionMeta, resolve func(raw, fallback string) string) flows.ActionSpec {
	if resolve == nil {
		resolve = func(raw, fallback string) string {
			if strings.TrimSpace(raw) == "" {
				return fallback
			}
			return raw
		}
	}
	params := make([]flows.ParamSchema, len(act.Params))
	for i, p := range act.Params {
		params[i] = flows.ParamSchema{
			Key:         p.Key,
			Type:        events.FieldType(p.Type),
			Label:       resolve(p.Label, p.Key),
			Description: resolve(p.Description, ""),
			Required:    p.Required,
			Secret:      p.Secret,
			Template:    p.Template,
			Default:     p.Default,
			Enum:        convertEventEnums(p.Enum, resolve),
			Unit:        p.Unit,
			Picker:      p.Picker,
		}
	}
	sideEffect := true
	if act.SideEffect != nil {
		sideEffect = *act.SideEffect
	}
	if group == "" {
		group = pluginID
	}
	return flows.ActionSpec{
		Type:        flows.PluginActionType(pluginID, act.Key),
		Owner:       pluginID,
		Group:       group,
		Label:       resolve(act.Label, act.Key),
		Description: resolve(act.Description, ""),
		Icon:        act.Icon,
		Idempotent:  act.Idempotent,
		SideEffect:  sideEffect,
		Params:      params,
		Outputs:     convertEventFields(act.Outputs, resolve),
	}
}
