## Source: internal/plugins/manifest.go#validateSettings

``````
// validateSettings checks the settings schema shape (SPEC §5.5). A $ref is
// validated again after resolution at install.
func validateSettings(raw json.RawMessage, add func(string, string)) {
	if len(raw) == 0 {
		return
	}
	var doc map[string]any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &doc); err != nil {
		add("ether.settings", "must be a JSON object")
		return
	}
	if ref, ok := doc["$ref"].(string); ok {
		if unsafePath(ref) || ref == "" {
			add("ether.settings.$ref", "must name a file inside the package")
		}
		return
	}
	lintSettingsNode(doc, "ether.settings", add)
}
``````

``````
var settingKinds = map[string]bool{
	"group": true, "text": true, "secret": true, "duration": true,
	"readonly": true, "number": true, "bool": true, "select": true,
	"list": true, "bytes": true, "hidden": true, "multiSelect": true,
``````

``````
// LintSettingsSchema validates a resolved settings schema document
// (SPEC §5.5 copy rules). Shared with the kit.
func LintSettingsSchema(raw json.RawMessage) error {
	var f []FieldError
	validateSettings(raw, func(field, msg string) { f = append(f, FieldError{field, msg}) })
	if len(f) > 0 {
		return &ValidationError{f}
	}
	return nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest.go#lintSettingsNode

``````
func lintSettingsNode(node any, path string, add func(string, string)) {
	switch n := node.(type) {
	case map[string]any:
		if k, ok := n["kind"].(string); ok {
			if k == "json" {
				add(path+".kind", "the json field kind is not allowed in plugin settings")
			} else if !settingKinds[k] {
				add(path+".kind", "unknown field kind "+strconv.Quote(k))
			}
		}
		if label, ok := n["label"].(string); ok && !strings.HasPrefix(label, "$t:") {
			if msg := LintCopy(label, 40); msg != "" {
				add(path+".label", msg)
			}
		}
		if hint, ok := n["hint"].(string); ok && !strings.HasPrefix(hint, "$t:") {
			if msg := LintCopy(hint, 120); msg != "" {
				add(path+".hint", msg)
			}
			if strings.Count(strings.TrimRight(hint, "."), ".") > 0 {
				add(path+".hint", "must be one sentence")
			}
		}
		for key, v := range n {
			lintSettingsNode(v, path+"."+key, add)
		}
	case []any:
		for i, v := range n {
			lintSettingsNode(v, fmt.Sprintf("%s[%d]", path, i), add)
		}
	}
}
``````

``````
func contributesUseT(c Contributes) bool {
	any := false
	check := func(s string) {
		if strings.HasPrefix(s, "$t:") {
			any = true
		}
	}
	for _, x := range c.ListSources {
		check(x.Label)
	}
	for _, x := range c.RankingSteps {
		check(x.Label)
	}
	for _, x := range c.RuleConditions {
		check(x.Label)
	}
	for _, x := range c.PosterBadges {
		check(x.Label)
		check(x.Description)
	}
	if c.Events != nil {
		for _, pe := range c.Events.Publish {
			check(pe.Label)
			check(pe.Description)
			for _, fld := range pe.Fields {
				check(fld.Label)
				check(fld.Description)
				for _, opt := range fld.Enum {
					check(opt.Label)
				}
			}
		}
	}
	for _, fa := range c.FlowActions {
		check(fa.Label)
		check(fa.Description)
		for _, p := range fa.Params {
			check(p.Label)
			check(p.Description)
			for _, opt := range p.Enum {
				check(opt.Label)
			}
		}
		for _, out := range fa.Outputs {
			check(out.Label)
			check(out.Description)
			for _, opt := range out.Enum {
				check(opt.Label)
			}
		}
	}
	for _, x := range c.Tools {
		check(x.Title)
	}
	for _, x := range c.Pages {
		check(x.Label)
	}
	for _, x := range c.Slots {
		check(x.Label)
	}
	for _, x := range c.Commands {
		check(x.Label)
	}
	if c.Integration != nil {
		for _, s := range c.Integration.Adds {
			check(s)
		}
	}
	for _, k := range c.MediaKinds {
		check(k.Label)
		check(k.Library.Name)
		for _, t := range k.Library.Tabs {
			check(t.Label)
			check(t.SearchPlaceholder)
		}
		for _, sh := range k.Library.Shelves {
			check(sh.Label)
		}
		for _, lv := range k.Levels {
			check(lv.Label)
		}
		for _, f := range k.Fields {
			check(f.Label)
		}
		for _, a := range k.Art {
			check(a.Label)
		}
	}
	for _, a := range c.FrontendAdapters {
		check(a.Label)
	}
	if c.Setup != nil {
		for _, s := range c.Setup.Steps {
			check(s.Label)
			check(s.Hint)
		}
	}
	return any
}
``````

``````
func validateContributes(m Manifest, add func(string, string)) {
	e := m.Ether
	c := e.Contributes
	hosted := e.Runtime.Kind == "hosted"
	label := func(field, s string, max int) {
		if strings.HasPrefix(s, "$t:") {
			if !keyRe.MatchString(strings.TrimPrefix(s, "$t:")) {
				add(field, "must name a string key after $t:")
			}
			return
		}
		if strings.TrimSpace(s) == "" {
			add(field, "is required")
		} else if msg := LintCopy(s, max); msg != "" && !e.Stremio {
			// Labels an add-on brings (its catalogue names) are its own
			// words; Ether shows them as the add-on wrote them.
			add(field, msg)
		}
	}
	if m.HasCapability(CapStreamSource) {
		if c.Source == nil {
			add("ether.contributes.source", "is required for stream_source")
		} else if !map[string]bool{"debrid": true, "usenet": true, "indexer": true, "direct": true}[c.Source.Class] {
			add("ether.contributes.source.class", "must be debrid, usenet, indexer or direct")
		}
	}
	if m.HasCapability(CapDebridProvider) && (c.Source == nil || c.Source.Class != "debrid") {
		add("ether.contributes.source.class", "must be debrid for debrid_provider")
	}
	if m.HasCapability(CapLiveTV) {
		if c.Channels == nil || !c.Channels.Test {
			add("ether.contributes.channels", "is required for livetv_channels, with test set")
		}
	}
	if m.HasCapability(CapPluginDirectory) && len(c.Directories) == 0 {
		add("ether.contributes.directories", "is required for plugin_directory")
	}
	seenDirectories := map[string]bool{}
	for i, d := range c.Directories {
		base := fmt.Sprintf("ether.contributes.directories[%d]", i)
		if !keyRe.MatchString(d.Key) || seenDirectories[d.Key] {
			add(base+".key", "must be a unique simple key")
		}
		seenDirectories[d.Key] = true
		label(base+".label", d.Label, 80)
	}
	if m.HasCapability(CapMetadata) {
		if c.Metadata == nil || len(c.Metadata.Types) == 0 {
			add("ether.contributes.metadata.types", "is required for metadata")
		} else {
			for _, typ := range c.Metadata.Types {
				if typ != "movie" && typ != "show" {
					add("ether.contributes.metadata.types", "must contain movie or show")
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if m.HasCapability(CapSubtitles) && c.Subtitles == nil {
		add("ether.contributes.subtitles", "is required for subtitles")
	}
	if m.HasCapability(CapMarkers) {
		if c.Markers == nil || len(c.Markers.Kinds) == 0 {
			add("ether.contributes.markers.kinds", "is required for markers")
		} else {
			for _, k := range c.Markers.Kinds {
				if !map[string]bool{"intro": true, "credits": true, "recap": true, "preview": true}[k] {
					add("ether.contributes.markers.kinds", "unknown marker kind "+strconv.Quote(k))
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if m.HasCapability(CapNotify) {
		if c.Notification == nil || !c.Notification.SendTest {
			add("ether.contributes.notification", "is required for notify, with sendTest set")
		}
	}
	optDesc := func(field, s string, max int) {
		if s == "" {
			return
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(s, "$t:") {
			if !keyRe.MatchString(strings.TrimPrefix(s, "$t:")) {
				add(field, "must name a string key after $t:")
			}
			return
		}
		if msg := LintCopy(s, max); msg != "" && !e.Stremio {
			add(field, msg)
		}
	}
	validateEventFields := func(prefix string, fields []EventFieldMeta) {
		if len(fields) > MaxEventFields {
			add(prefix, fmt.Sprintf("must declare at most %d fields", MaxEventFields))
		}
		seenFields := map[string]bool{}
		for j, fld := range fields {
			fbase := fmt.Sprintf("%s[%d]", prefix, j)
			if !eventFieldNameRe.MatchString(fld.Name) || seenFields[fld.Name] {
				add(fbase+".name", "must be a unique field name")
			}
			seenFields[fld.Name] = true
			ft := events.FieldType(fld.Type)
			if !ft.Valid() {
				add(fbase+".type", "unknown field type "+strconv.Quote(fld.Type))
			}
			label(fbase+".label", fld.Label, 60)
			optDesc(fbase+".description", fld.Description, 200)
			if ft == events.FieldEnum {
				if len(fld.Enum) == 0 {
					add(fbase+".enum", "is required for enum fields")
				}
			}
			seenEnum := map[string]bool{}
			for k, opt := range fld.Enum {
				ebase := fmt.Sprintf("%s.enum[%d]", fbase, k)
				if strings.TrimSpace(opt.Value) == "" || seenEnum[opt.Value] {
					add(ebase+".value", "must be a unique non-empty enum value")
				}
				seenEnum[opt.Value] = true
				optDesc(ebase+".label", opt.Label, 60)
			}
		}
	}
	if m.HasCapability(CapEvents) {
		if c.Events == nil || (len(c.Events.Subscribe) == 0 && len(c.Events.Publish) == 0) {
			add("ether.contributes.events", "must declare subscribe or publish for events")
		}
	}
	if c.Events != nil {
		if !m.HasCapability(CapEvents) && (len(c.Events.Subscribe) > 0 || len(c.Events.Publish) > 0) {
			add("ether.capabilities", "events is required for contributes.events")
		}
		for _, n := range c.Events.Subscribe {
			if !IsSubscribableEvent(n) {
				add("ether.contributes.events.subscribe", "unknown event "+strconv.Quote(n))
			}
		}
		if len(c.Events.Publish) > MaxPluginPublishedEvents {
			add("ether.contributes.events.publish", fmt.Sprintf("must declare at most %d published events", MaxPluginPublishedEvents))
		}
		seenPublished := map[string]bool{}
		for i, pe := range c.Events.Publish {
			base := fmt.Sprintf("ether.contributes.events.publish[%d]", i)
			if !pluginEventKeyRe.MatchString(pe.Key) || seenPublished[pe.Key] {
				add(base+".key", "must be a unique key matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*(\\.[a-z][a-z0-9_]*){0,2}$")
			} else if len(events.PluginEventType(m.ID, pe.Key)) > 128 {
				add(base+".key", "event type exceeds 128 characters")
			}
			seenPublished[pe.Key] = true
			label(base+".label", pe.Label, 60)
			optDesc(base+".description", pe.Description, 200)
			if pe.Version < 0 {
				add(base+".version", "must be >= 1")
			}
			validateEventFields(base+".fields", pe.Fields)
		}
	}
	if m.HasCapability(CapFlowActions) && len(c.FlowActions) == 0 {
		add("ether.contributes.flowActions", "is required for flow_actions")
	}
	if len(c.FlowActions) > 0 && !m.HasCapability(CapFlowActions) {
		add("ether.capabilities", "flow_actions is required for flowActions")
	}
	if len(c.FlowActions) > MaxPluginFlowActions {
		add("ether.contributes.flowActions", fmt.Sprintf("must declare at most %d flow actions", MaxPluginFlowActions))
	}
	validPickers := map[string]bool{
		"": true, "channel": true, "viewer": true, "library": true,
		"source": true, "event": true, "plugin": true,
	}
	seenActions := map[string]bool{}
	for i, fa := range c.FlowActions {
		base := fmt.Sprintf("ether.contributes.flowActions[%d]", i)
		if !flowActionKeyRe.MatchString(fa.Key) || seenActions[fa.Key] {
			add(base+".key", "must be a unique key matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$")
		} else if len(flows.PluginActionType(m.ID, fa.Key)) > 128 {
			add(base+".key", "action type exceeds 128 characters")
		}
		seenActions[fa.Key] = true
		label(base+".label", fa.Label, 60)
		optDesc(base+".description", fa.Description, 200)
		if !strings.HasPrefix(fa.Route, "/ether/") || !isSafePluginRoute(fa.Route) {
			add(base+".route", "must be a safe plugin route under /ether/")
		}
		if fa.Timeout != "" {
			d, err := time.ParseDuration(fa.Timeout)
			if err != nil || d <= 0 || d > MaxPluginFlowActionTimeout {
				add(base+".timeout", fmt.Sprintf("must be a positive duration of at most %s", MaxPluginFlowActionTimeout))
			}
		}
		if len(fa.Params) > MaxFlowActionParams {
			add(base+".params", fmt.Sprintf("must declare at most %d params", MaxFlowActionParams))
		}
		seenParams := map[string]bool{}
		for j, p := range fa.Params {
			pbase := fmt.Sprintf("%s.params[%d]", base, j)
			if !flowParamKeyRe.MatchString(p.Key) || seenParams[p.Key] {
				add(pbase+".key", "must be a unique param key")
			}
			seenParams[p.Key] = true
			pt := events.FieldType(p.Type)
			if !pt.Valid() {
				add(pbase+".type", "unknown param type "+strconv.Quote(p.Type))
			}
			label(pbase+".label", p.Label, 60)
			optDesc(pbase+".description", p.Description, 200)
			if pt == events.FieldEnum && len(p.Enum) == 0 {
				add(pbase+".enum", "is required for enum params")
			}
			seenEnum := map[string]bool{}
			for k, opt := range p.Enum {
				ebase := fmt.Sprintf("%s.enum[%d]", pbase, k)
				if strings.TrimSpace(opt.Value) == "" || seenEnum[opt.Value] {
					add(ebase+".value", "must be a unique non-empty enum value")
				}
				seenEnum[opt.Value] = true
				optDesc(ebase+".label", opt.Label, 60)
			}
			if !validPickers[p.Picker] {
				add(pbase+".picker", "unknown picker "+strconv.Quote(p.Picker))
			}
		}
		validateEventFields(base+".outputs", fa.Outputs)
	}
	if m.HasCapability(CapListSource) && len(c.ListSources) == 0 {
		add("ether.contributes.listSources", "is required for list_source")
	}
	for i, ls := range c.ListSources {
		base := fmt.Sprintf("ether.contributes.listSources[%d]", i)
		if !keyRe.MatchString(ls.Key) {
			add(base+".key", "must be a simple key")
		}
		label(base+".label", ls.Label, 40)
		if ls.Catalog == "" {
			add(base+".catalog", "is required")
		}
		if ls.MaxItems < 0 || ls.MaxItems > 2000 {
			add(base+".maxItems", "must be at most 2000")
		}
		if ls.Refresh != "" {
			if d, err := time.ParseDuration(ls.Refresh); err != nil || d < time.Hour {
				add(base+".refresh", "must be a duration of at least 1h")
			}
		}
	}
	if m.HasCapability(CapRankingStep) {
		if !hosted {
			add("ether.capabilities", "ranking_step needs the hosted runtime")
		}
		if len(c.RankingSteps) == 0 {
			add("ether.contributes.rankingSteps", "is required for ranking_step")
		}
	}
	for i, rs := range c.RankingSteps {
		base := fmt.Sprintf("ether.contributes.rankingSteps[%d]", i)
		if !keyRe.MatchString(rs.Key) {
			add(base+".key", "must be a simple key")
		}
		label(base+".label", rs.Label, 40)
	}

		add("ether.capabilities", "poster_badges is required for posterBadges")

	if m.HasCapability(CapTools) && len(c.Tools) == 0 {
		add("ether.contributes.tools", "is required for tools")

			add(base+".name", "must be snake_case")

			add(base+".inputSchema", "must be a JSON object schema")
		}
		if tl.ReadOnly && tl.Destructive {
			add(base, "a tool cannot be both read-only and destructive")
		}
	}
	for i, pg := range c.Pages {

		if !keyRe.MatchString(pg.Key) {
			add(base+".key", "must be a simple key")
		}
		label(base+".label", pg.Label, 40)
		if !strings.HasPrefix(pg.Route, "/") {
			add(base+".route", "must be a plugin route starting with /")
		}
	}
	for i, sl := range c.Slots {
		base := fmt.Sprintf("ether.contributes.slots[%d]", i)
		if !knownSlots[sl.Slot] {
			add(base+".slot", "unknown slot "+strconv.Quote(sl.Slot))
		}
		label(base+".label", sl.Label, 40)
		if !keyRe.MatchString(sl.Key) {
			add(base+".key", "must be a simple key")
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(sl.Slot, "actionMenu.") {
			if !keyRe.MatchString(sl.Action) {
				add(base+".action", "must be a simple action name")
			}
			if sl.Route != "" {
				add(base+".route", "action slots use an action instead of a route")
			}
		} else {
			if !strings.HasPrefix(sl.Route, "/") {
				add(base+".route", "must be a plugin route starting with /")
			}
			if sl.Action != "" {
				add(base+".action", "view slots use a route instead of an action")
			}
		}
	}
	for i, cm := range c.Commands {
		base := fmt.Sprintf("ether.contributes.commands[%d]", i)
		if !keyRe.MatchString(cm.Key) {
			add(base+".key", "must be a simple key")
		}
		label(base+".label", cm.Label, 40)
		if cm.Action == "" {
			add(base+".action", "is required")
		}
	}
	validateMediaKinds(m, add, label)
	validateFrontendAdapters(m, add, label)
	validateSetup(e, add, label)
	if e.Kind == KindIntegration {
		if c.Integration == nil {
			add("ether.contributes.integration", "is required for the integration kind")
		} else {
			if c.Integration.Category == "" {
				add("ether.contributes.integration.category", "is required")
			}
			if len(c.Integration.Adds) < 1 || len(c.Integration.Adds) > 4 {
				add("ether.contributes.integration.adds", "must list one to four things the plugin adds")
			}
			for i, s := range c.Integration.Adds {
				label(fmt.Sprintf("ether.contributes.integration.adds[%d]", i), s, 80)
			}
			if !map[string]bool{"fields": true, "device_code": true, "none": true}[c.Integration.Connect] {
				add("ether.contributes.integration.connect", "must be fields, device_code or none")
			}
		}
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest.go#ParseSemVer

``````
// ParseSemVer parses a plain major.minor.patch version.
func ParseSemVer(v string) ([3]int, bool) {
	var out [3]int
	v = strings.TrimPrefix(strings.TrimSpace(v), "v")
	if i := strings.IndexAny(v, "-+"); i >= 0 {
		v = v[:i]
	}
	parts := strings.Split(v, ".")
	if len(parts) != 3 {
		return out, false
	}
	for i, p := range parts {
		n, err := strconv.Atoi(p)
		if err != nil || n < 0 {
			return out, false
		}
		out[i] = n
	}
	return out, true
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest.go#CompareSemVer

``````
// CompareSemVer returns -1, 0 or 1. Unparseable versions compare equal to 0.
func CompareSemVer(a, b string) int {
	va, _ := ParseSemVer(a)
	vb, _ := ParseSemVer(b)
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		if va[i] != vb[i] {
			if va[i] < vb[i] {
				return -1
			}
			return 1
		}
	}
	// A release sorts after any prerelease of the same core version.
	pre := func(v string) string {
		v, _, _ = strings.Cut(v, "+")
		_, p, _ := strings.Cut(v, "-")
		return p
	}
	pa, pb := pre(a), pre(b)
	if pa == pb {
		return 0
	}
	if pa == "" {
		return 1
	}
	if pb == "" {
		return -1
	}
	as, bs := strings.Split(pa, "."), strings.Split(pb, ".")
	for i := 0; i < len(as) && i < len(bs); i++ {
		x, y := as[i], bs[i]
		if x == y {
			continue
		}
		isNumeric := func(s string) bool {
			if s == "" {
				return false
			}
			for _, c := range s {
				if c < '0' || c > '9' {
					return false
				}
			}
			return true
		}
		xn, yn := isNumeric(x), isNumeric(y)
		if xn != yn {
			if xn {
				return -1
			}
			return 1
		}
		if xn {
			x, y = strings.TrimLeft(x, "0"), strings.TrimLeft(y, "0")
			if len(x) < len(y) {
				return -1
			}
			if len(x) > len(y) {
				return 1
			}
		}
		if x < y {
			return -1
		}
		if x > y {
			return 1
		}
	}
	if len(as) < len(bs) {
		return -1
	}
	if len(as) > len(bs) {
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest_kinds.go#KindRuleFields

``````
// KindRuleFields maps built-in rule facts (genre, studio, runtime, ...) onto
// declared, indexed plugin field keys. Shared by manifest validation and
// pluginitems SQL compilation so both agree on which built-in facts exist.
func KindRuleFields(fields []KindField) map[string]string {
	out := map[string]string{}
	aliases := map[string][]string{
		"genre":      {"genre", "genres", "tags", "tag"},
		"studio":     {"studio", "studios"},
		"country":    {"country", "countries"},
		"keyword":    {"keyword", "keywords"},
		"language":   {"language"},
		"runtime":    {"runtime", "duration", "length"},
		"votes":      {"votes"},
		"popularity": {"popularity"},
	}
	for field, keys := range aliases {
		wantNumeric := field == "runtime" || field == "votes" || field == "popularity"
		for _, key := range keys {
			for _, f := range fields {
				text := f.Type == "string" || f.Type == "strings" || f.Type == "enum" || f.Type == "people"
				numeric := f.Type == "int" || f.Type == "float" || f.Type == "duration"
				if f.Key == key && f.Indexed && ((wantNumeric && numeric) || (!wantNumeric && text)) {
					out[field] = key
					break
				}
			}
			if out[field] != "" {
				break
			}
		}
	}
	return out
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest_kinds.go#validateMediaKinds

``````
func validateMediaKinds(m Manifest, add func(string, string), label func(string, string, int)) {
	e := m.Ether
	kinds := e.Contributes.MediaKinds
	hasProvider := m.HasCapability(CapCatalogProvider)
	hasResolver := m.HasCapability(CapKindResolver)
	if e.Kind == KindContent && !hasProvider && !hasResolver {
		add("ether.capabilities", "a content plugin needs catalog_provider or kind_resolver")
	}
	if (hasProvider || hasResolver) && len(kinds) == 0 {
		add("ether.contributes.mediaKinds", "is required for catalog_provider and kind_resolver")
	}
	if !hasProvider && !hasResolver && len(kinds) > 0 {
		add("ether.contributes.mediaKinds", "needs the catalog_provider or kind_resolver capability")
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for i, k := range kinds {
		base := fmt.Sprintf("ether.contributes.mediaKinds[%d]", i)
		validateMediaKind(m, k, base, hasProvider, add, label)
		if seen[k.Key] {
			add(base+".key", "is listed twice")
		}
		seen[k.Key] = true
	}
}
``````

``````
func validateMediaKind(m Manifest, k MediaKindMeta, base string, hasProvider bool, add func(string, string), label func(string, string, int)) {
	if !kindKeyRe.MatchString(k.Key) {
		add(base+".key", "must be lower case letters, digits and dashes, at most 32 characters")
	}
	label(base+".label", k.Label, 60)
	if !k.Library.IsZero() {
		label(base+".library.name", k.Library.Name, 60)
		if unsafePath(k.Library.Icon) {
			add(base+".library.icon", "must stay inside the package")
		}
		if k.Library.Card != "" && !kindLibraryCards[k.Library.Card] {
			add(base+".library.card", "must be poster, landscape or square")
		}
		if k.Library.DateDisplay != "" && !kindLibraryDateDisplays[k.Library.DateDisplay] {
			add(base+".library.dateDisplay", "must be year or date")
		}
		if len(k.Library.Tabs) > MaxKindLibraryTabs {
			add(base+".library.tabs", fmt.Sprintf("at most %d tabs may be declared", MaxKindLibraryTabs))
		}
		seenTab := map[string]bool{}
		for j, tab := range k.Library.Tabs {
			tbase := fmt.Sprintf("%s.library.tabs[%d]", base, j)
			switch {
			case !kindKeyRe.MatchString(tab.Key):
				add(tbase+".key", "must be lower case letters, digits and dashes, at most 32 characters")
			case seenTab[tab.Key]:
				add(tbase+".key", "is listed twice")
			}
			seenTab[tab.Key] = true
			label(tbase+".label", tab.Label, 40)
			if !kindLibraryTabKinds[tab.Kind] {
				add(tbase+".kind", "must be recommended, library, collections, people, view or live")
			}
		}
	}

	if len(k.Levels) < 1 || len(k.Levels) > 5 {
		add(base+".levels", "must declare one to five levels")
	}
	levelKeys := map[string]bool{}
	playable := false
	for j, lv := range k.Levels {
		lbase := fmt.Sprintf("%s.levels[%d]", base, j)
		if !kindKeyRe.MatchString(lv.Key) {
			add(lbase+".key", "must be lower case letters, digits and dashes, at most 32 characters")
		}
		if levelKeys[lv.Key] {
			add(lbase+".key", "is listed twice")
		}
		levelKeys[lv.Key] = true
		label(lbase+".label", lv.Label, 40)
		if lv.Playable {
			playable = true
		}
	}
	if len(k.Levels) > 0 && !playable {
		add(base+".levels", "at least one level must be playable")
	}

	fields := map[string]KindField{}
	for j, f := range k.Fields {
		fbase := fmt.Sprintf("%s.fields[%d]", base, j)
		switch {
		case !kindFieldRe.MatchString(f.Key):
			add(fbase+".key", "must start with a lower case letter and use letters, digits and underscores, at most 40 characters")
		case kindEnvelopeKeys[f.Key]:
			add(fbase+".key", "collides with an item envelope key")
		case fields[f.Key].Key != "":
			add(fbase+".key", "is listed twice")
		}
		fields[f.Key] = f
		if !kindFieldTypes[f.Type] {
			add(fbase+".type", "must be string, int, float, bool, date, duration, enum, strings or people")
		}
		label(fbase+".label", f.Label, 40)
		if f.Type == "enum" {
			if len(f.Enum) == 0 {
				add(fbase+".enum", "an enum field needs at least one value")
			}
			seenEnum := map[string]bool{}
			for _, v := range f.Enum {
				if strings.TrimSpace(v) == "" || seenEnum[v] {
					add(fbase+".enum", "values must be non-empty and listed once")
					break
				}
				seenEnum[v] = true
			}
		} else if len(f.Enum) > 0 {
			add(fbase+".enum", "only enum fields list values")
		}
	}

	seenArt := map[string]bool{}
	for j, a := range k.Art {
		abase := fmt.Sprintf("%s.art[%d]", base, j)
		switch {
		case !kindArtRe.MatchString(a.Role):
			add(abase+".role", "must be lower case letters, digits and dashes, at most 32 characters")
		case BuiltinKindArtRoles[a.Role]:
			add(abase+".role", "is a built-in role and needs no declaration")
		case seenArt[a.Role]:
			add(abase+".role", "is listed twice")
		}
		seenArt[a.Role] = true
		label(abase+".label", a.Label, 40)
	}

	validatePresentations(m, k, base+".present", levelKeys, add)

	seenSort := map[string]bool{}
	for j, s := range k.Browse.Sorts {
		if !kindSorts[s] || seenSort[s] {
			add(fmt.Sprintf("%s.browse.sorts[%d]", base, j), "must be title, added, released, year, rating, index or lastViewed, listed once")
		}
		seenSort[s] = true
	}
	seenFacet := map[string]bool{}
	for j, f := range k.Browse.Facets {
		if seenFacet[f] {
			add(fmt.Sprintf("%s.browse.facets[%d]", base, j), "is listed twice")
		}
		seenFacet[f] = true
		if f == "year" || f == "released" || f == "rating" {
			continue
		}
		field, ok := fields[f]
		if !ok {
			add(fmt.Sprintf("%s.browse.facets[%d]", base, j), "must name a declared field")
		} else if !field.Indexed && field.Type != "people" {
			add(fmt.Sprintf("%s.browse.facets[%d]", base, j), "a facet field must be indexed")
		}
	}
	if k.Browse.Expand != nil {
		ebase := base + ".browse.expand"
		if !hasProvider {
			add(ebase, "expand needs the catalog_provider capability")
		}
		if len(k.Browse.Expand.Facets) == 0 {
			add(ebase+".facets", "must list at least one browse facet")
		}
		seenExpand := map[string]bool{}
		for j, f := range k.Browse.Expand.Facets {
			fbase := fmt.Sprintf("%s.facets[%d]", ebase, j)
			if seenExpand[f] {
				add(fbase, "is listed twice")
			}
			seenExpand[f] = true
			if !seenFacet[f] {
				add(fbase, "must name a declared browse facet")
			}
		}
		if k.Browse.Expand.TTLHours < 0 {
			add(ebase+".ttlHours", "must be positive")
		}
	}
	if !k.Library.IsZero() {
		declaredIndexed := make(map[string]string, len(k.Fields))
		for _, f := range k.Fields {
			if f.Indexed {
				declaredIndexed[f.Key] = f.Type
			}
		}
		ruleFields := KindRuleFields(k.Fields)
		for j, tab := range k.Library.Tabs {
			tbase := fmt.Sprintf("%s.library.tabs[%d]", base, j)
			switch tab.Kind {
			case "collections":
				if tab.Facet != "" && !seenFacet[tab.Facet] {
					add(tbase+".facet", "must name a declared browse facet")
				}
				if tab.Sort != "" {
					if tab.Facet == "" {
						add(tbase+".sort", "requires facet to be set")
					} else if !seenSort[tab.Sort] && !core.IsLastViewedSort(tab.Sort) {
						add(tbase+".sort", "must name a declared browse sort")
					}
				}
				if tab.Direction != "" {
					if tab.Facet == "" {
						add(tbase+".direction", "requires facet to be set")
					} else if tab.Direction != "asc" && tab.Direction != "desc" {
						add(tbase+".direction", "must be asc or desc")
					}
				}
				if tab.Order != "" {
					if tab.Facet == "" {
						add(tbase+".order", "requires facet to be set")
					} else if tab.Order != "count" && tab.Order != "name" {
						add(tbase+".order", "must be count or name")
					}
				}
				if tab.SearchPlaceholder != "" {
					label(tbase+".searchPlaceholder", tab.SearchPlaceholder, 60)
					if tab.Search != nil && !*tab.Search {
						add(tbase+".searchPlaceholder", "requires search to be enabled")
					}
				}
				if tab.Card != "" {
					add(tbase+".card", "only live tabs may set card")
				}
				if tab.Layout != "" {
					add(tbase+".layout", "only view tabs may set layout")
				}
				if tab.Filters != nil && !tab.Filters.IsEmpty() {
					add(tbase+".filters", "only view tabs may set filters")
				}
			case "people":
				if tab.Facet == "" || !seenFacet[tab.Facet] {
					add(tbase+".facet", "must name a declared browse facet")
				} else if fields[tab.Facet].Type != "people" {
					add(tbase+".facet", "must name a people field")
				}
				if tab.Sort != "" {
					add(tbase+".sort", "only collections or view tabs may set sort")
				}
				if tab.Direction != "" {
					add(tbase+".direction", "only collections or view tabs may set direction")
				}
				if tab.Order != "" && tab.Order != "count" && tab.Order != "name" {
					add(tbase+".order", "must be count or name")
				}
				if tab.SearchPlaceholder != "" {
					label(tbase+".searchPlaceholder", tab.SearchPlaceholder, 60)
					if tab.Search != nil && !*tab.Search {
						add(tbase+".searchPlaceholder", "requires search to be enabled")
					}
				}
				if tab.Card != "" {
					add(tbase+".card", "only live tabs may set card")
				}
				if tab.Layout != "" {
					add(tbase+".layout", "only view tabs may set layout")
				}
				if tab.Filters != nil && !tab.Filters.IsEmpty() {
					add(tbase+".filters", "only view tabs may set filters")
				}
			case "view":
				if tab.Facet != "" {
					add(tbase+".facet", "only collections or people tabs may set facet")
				}
				if tab.Order != "" {
					add(tbase+".order", "only collections or people tabs may set order")
				}
				if tab.Card != "" {
					add(tbase+".card", "only live tabs may set card")
				}
				if tab.Layout != "" && !kindLibraryTabLayouts[tab.Layout] {
					add(tbase+".layout", "must be grid, list or timeline")
				}
				if tab.Sort != "" && !seenSort[tab.Sort] && !core.IsLastViewedSort(tab.Sort) {
					add(tbase+".sort", "must name a declared browse sort or lastViewed")
				}
				if tab.Direction != "" && tab.Direction != "asc" && tab.Direction != "desc" {
					add(tbase+".direction", "must be asc or desc")
				}
				if tab.SearchPlaceholder != "" {
					label(tbase+".searchPlaceholder", tab.SearchPlaceholder, 60)
					if tab.Search != nil && !*tab.Search {
						add(tbase+".searchPlaceholder", "requires search to be enabled")
					}
				}
				if tab.Filters != nil {
					if tab.Filters.Match != "" && tab.Filters.Match != "all" && tab.Filters.Match != "any" {
						add(tbase+".filters.match", "must be all or any")
					}
					if tab.Filters.VisibilityDefault != "" && tab.Filters.VisibilityDefault != "show" && tab.Filters.VisibilityDefault != "hide" {
						add(tbase+".filters.visibilityDefault", "must be show or hide")
					}
					if !tab.Filters.IsEmpty() {
						specs, fallback := tab.Filters.ToPolicy("")
						if err := libraryfilter.ValidatePluginManifestPolicy(specs, fallback, declaredIndexed, ruleFields); err != nil {
							add(tbase+".filters", err.Error())
						}
					}
				}
			case "live":
				if tab.Facet != "" {
					add(tbase+".facet", "only collections or people tabs may set facet")
				}
				if tab.Sort != "" {
					add(tbase+".sort", "only collections or view tabs may set sort")
				}
				if tab.Direction != "" {
					add(tbase+".direction", "only collections or view tabs may set direction")
				}
				if tab.Order != "" {
					add(tbase+".order", "only collections or people tabs may set order")
				}
				if tab.Card != "" && !kindLibraryCards[tab.Card] {
					add(tbase+".card", "must be poster, landscape or square")
				}
				if tab.Layout != "" {
					add(tbase+".layout", "only view tabs may set layout")
				}
				if tab.Filters != nil && !tab.Filters.IsEmpty() {
					add(tbase+".filters", "only view tabs may set filters")
				}
				if tab.SearchPlaceholder != "" {
					label(tbase+".searchPlaceholder", tab.SearchPlaceholder, 60)
					if tab.Search != nil && !*tab.Search {
						add(tbase+".searchPlaceholder", "requires search to be enabled")
					}
				}
			default:
				if tab.Facet != "" {
					add(tbase+".facet", "only collections or people tabs may set facet")
				}
				if tab.Sort != "" {
					add(tbase+".sort", "only collections or view tabs may set sort")
				}
				if tab.Direction != "" {
					add(tbase+".direction", "only collections or view tabs may set direction")
				}
				if tab.Order != "" {
					add(tbase+".order", "only collections or people tabs may set order")
				}
				if tab.Card != "" {
					add(tbase+".card", "only live tabs may set card")
				}
				if tab.Layout != "" {
					add(tbase+".layout", "only view tabs may set layout")
				}
				if tab.Filters != nil && !tab.Filters.IsEmpty() {
					add(tbase+".filters", "only view tabs may set filters")
				}
				if tab.Search != nil {
					add(tbase+".search", "only collections, people, view or live tabs may set search")
				}
				if tab.SearchPlaceholder != "" {
					add(tbase+".searchPlaceholder", "only collections, people, view or live tabs may set searchPlaceholder")
				}
			}
		}
	}
	validateKindLibraryShelves(base, k.Library.Shelves, fields, add, label)
	for j, f := range k.Browse.SearchFields {
		field, ok := fields[f]
		if !ok {
			add(fmt.Sprintf("%s.browse.searchFields[%d]", base, j), "must name a declared field")
		} else if field.Type != "string" && field.Type != "strings" && field.Type != "people" {
			add(fmt.Sprintf("%s.browse.searchFields[%d]", base, j), "a search field must hold text")
		}
	}
	if len(k.Browse.SearchFields) > 0 && !k.Browse.Search {
		add(base+".browse.search", "searchFields need search to be set")
	}
	if k.Browse.LiveSearch && !hasProvider {
		add(base+".browse.liveSearch", "live search needs the catalog_provider capability")
	}

	switch k.Sync.Mode {
	case "":
		if hasProvider && k.HasLibrary() {
			add(base+".sync.mode", "a catalog provider kind must be pull or push")
		}
	case KindSyncPull, KindSyncPush:
		if !hasProvider {
			add(base+".sync.mode", "sync needs the catalog_provider capability")
		}
	case "ondemand":
		add(base+".sync.mode", "ondemand is not supported; kinds sync with pull or push")
	default:
		add(base+".sync.mode", "must be pull or push")
	}
	if k.Sync.Refresh != "" {
		if k.Sync.Mode != KindSyncPull {
			add(base+".sync.refresh", "only pull kinds refresh on a schedule")
		} else if d, err := time.ParseDuration(k.Sync.Refresh); err != nil || d < 15*time.Minute {
			add(base+".sync.refresh", "must be a duration of at least 15m")
		}
	}
	if k.Cache.MaxBytes < 0 {
		add(base+".cache.maxBytes", "must not be negative")
	}
	if k.Cache.TTL != "" {
		if d, err := time.ParseDuration(k.Cache.TTL); err != nil || d <= 0 {
			add(base+".cache.ttl", "must be a positive duration")
		}
	}
	if k.Match.ThresholdDefault < 0 || k.Match.ThresholdDefault > 1 {
		add(base+".match.thresholdDefault", "must be between 0 and 1")
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest_kinds.go#validatePresentations

``````
func validatePresentations(m Manifest, k MediaKindMeta, base string, levelKeys map[string]bool, add func(string, string)) {
	p := k.Present
	protocols := 0
	if p.Vela != nil {
		protocols++
	}
	if p.Plex != nil {
		protocols++
	}
	if p.MediaBrowser != nil {
		protocols++
	}
	if p.Stremio != nil {
		protocols++
	}
	if p.Xtream != nil {
		protocols++
	}
	if p.Silo != nil {
		protocols++
	}
	if p.AdapterOnly {
		if protocols > 0 {
			add(base, "adapterOnly cannot be combined with a protocol presentation")
		}
		if !m.HasCapability(CapFrontendAdapter) {
			add(base+".adapterOnly", "needs a frontend adapter")
		}
		return
	}
	if protocols == 0 {
		if k.HasLibrary() {
			add(base, "declare at least one protocol presentation, or adapterOnly with a frontend adapter")
		}
		return
	}
	levels := len(k.Levels)
	if p.Vela != nil {
		switch p.Vela.Type {
		case "movies":
		case "shows":
			if levels < 2 {
				add(base+".vela.type", "shows needs at least two levels")
			}
		default:
			add(base+".vela.type", "must be movies or shows")
		}
	}
	if p.Plex != nil {
		switch p.Plex.Base {
		case "movie", "photo", "artist":
			// A single-level artist kind is a flat album list: its items
			// present as albums (a level named artist/track presents as
			// that instead), never as artists.
		case "show":
			if levels < 2 {
				add(base+".plex.base", p.Plex.Base+" needs at least two levels")
			}
		default:
			add(base+".plex.base", "must be movie, show, artist or photo")
		}
	}
	if p.MediaBrowser != nil {
		if !mediaBrowserCollectionTypes[p.MediaBrowser.CollectionType] {
			add(base+".mediaBrowser.collectionType", "must be movies, tvshows, music, audiobooks, books, photos or homevideos")
		}
		for level, itemType := range p.MediaBrowser.ItemTypes {
			if !levelKeys[level] {
				add(base+".mediaBrowser.itemTypes", "unknown level "+level)
			}
			if !mediaBrowserItemTypes[itemType] {
				add(base+".mediaBrowser.itemTypes", "unknown item type "+itemType+" for level "+level+" (must be "+mediaBrowserItemTypeList+")")
			}
		}
	}
	if p.Stremio != nil {
		switch p.Stremio.Type {
		case "movie", "channel", "tv":
		case "series":
			if levels < 2 {
				add(base+".stremio.type", "series needs at least two levels")
			}
		default:
			add(base+".stremio.type", "must be movie, series, channel or tv")
		}
	}
	if p.Xtream != nil {
		switch p.Xtream.Category {
		case "movie", "live":
		case "series":
			if levels < 2 {
				add(base+".xtream.category", "series needs at least two levels")
			}
		default:
			add(base+".xtream.category", "must be movie, series or live")
		}
	}
	if p.Silo != nil && !mediaBrowserItemTypes[p.Silo.Type] {
		add(base+".silo.type", "must be a MediaBrowser item type such as Movie or Series")
	}
}
``````

``````
func validateFrontendAdapters(m Manifest, add func(string, string), label func(string, string, int)) {
	adapters := m.Ether.Contributes.FrontendAdapters
	if m.HasCapability(CapFrontendAdapter) && len(adapters) == 0 {

		}

			add(base+".pathPrefix", "must be a path below the shared listener root, such as /opds")
		}

			add(base+".defaultPort", "must be a port number")
		}

			if _, ok := m.MediaKindByKey(key); !ok {
				add(fmt.Sprintf("%s.libraries[%d]", base, j), "must name a media kind declared by this plugin")
			}
		}
	}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest_kinds.go#MediaKindMeta.DeclHash

``````
// DeclHash is the upgrade gate for an installed kind (spec §2.3/§2.5):
// the SHA-256 of the declaration's canonical JSON. Go marshals struct
// fields in declaration order and map keys sorted, so equal
// declarations always hash equal.
func (k MediaKindMeta) DeclHash() string {
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(k)
	sum := sha256.Sum256(raw)
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest_kinds.go#ValidateMediaKindsUpgrade

``````
// ValidateMediaKindsUpgrade applies the additive-only upgrade rule
// (spec §2.5): a new manifest may add kinds, fields, trailing levels
// and art roles, and may change labels, presentations, browse, cache
// and match defaults, but it may not drop or rename a kind, drop or
// retype a field, shrink an enum, drop a field's index, or remove,
// reorder or re-flag a level. A caller that gets an error refuses the
// upgrade unless the owner chose to replace the library contents.
func ValidateMediaKindsUpgrade(prev, next []MediaKindMeta) error {
	var f []FieldError
	add := func(field, msg string) { f = append(f, FieldError{field, msg}) }
	nextByKey := map[string]MediaKindMeta{}
	for _, k := range next {
		nextByKey[k.Key] = k
	}
	for _, old := range prev {
		base := "ether.contributes.mediaKinds." + old.Key
		nk, ok := nextByKey[old.Key]
		if !ok {
			add(base, "kind was removed; removing a kind needs the owner to replace its library")
			continue
		}
		for i, lv := range old.Levels {
			lbase := fmt.Sprintf("%s.levels[%d]", base, i)
			if i >= len(nk.Levels) {
				add(lbase, "level "+lv.Key+" was removed")
				continue
			}
			nl := nk.Levels[i]
			if nl.Key != lv.Key {
				add(lbase+".key", "levels cannot be removed or reordered; add new levels at the end")
			}
			if nl.Playable != lv.Playable || nl.Container != lv.Container {
				add(lbase, "level "+lv.Key+" changed its playable or container flag")
			}
		}
		nextFields := map[string]KindField{}
		for _, nf := range nk.Fields {
			nextFields[nf.Key] = nf
		}
		for _, of := range old.Fields {
			fbase := base + ".fields." + of.Key
			nf, ok := nextFields[of.Key]
			if !ok {
				add(fbase, "field was removed")
				continue
			}
			if nf.Type != of.Type {
				add(fbase+".type", "field changed type from "+of.Type+" to "+nf.Type)
			}
			if of.Indexed && !nf.Indexed {
				add(fbase+".indexed", "field lost its index")
			}
			if of.Type == "enum" && nf.Type == "enum" {
				have := map[string]bool{}
				for _, v := range nf.Enum {
					have[v] = true
				}
				for _, v := range of.Enum {
					if !have[v] {
						add(fbase+".enum", "enum value "+v+" was removed")
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if len(f) > 0 {
		return &ValidationError{f}
	}
	return nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest_kinds.go#validateKindLibraryShelves

``````
func validateKindLibraryShelves(base string, shelves []KindLibraryShelf, fields map[string]KindField, add func(string, string), label func(string, string, int)) {
	if len(shelves) == 0 {
		return
	}
	if len(shelves) > MaxKindLibraryShelves {
		add(base+".library.shelves", fmt.Sprintf("at most %d shelves are allowed", MaxKindLibraryShelves))
	}
	checkFacet := func(fieldPath, fk string) {
		if fk == "year" || fk == "released" || fk == "rating" {
			return
		}
		field, ok := fields[fk]
		if !ok {
			add(fieldPath, "must name a declared field")
		} else if !field.Indexed && field.Type != "people" {
			add(fieldPath, "a shelf facet field must be indexed")
		}
	}
	seenKey := map[string]bool{}
	for j, sh := range shelves {
		sbase := fmt.Sprintf("%s.library.shelves[%d]", base, j)
		if !kindShelfKeyRe.MatchString(sh.Key) {
			add(sbase+".key", "must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,39}$")
		} else if seenKey[sh.Key] {
			add(sbase+".key", "is listed twice")
		}
		seenKey[sh.Key] = true
		label(sbase+".label", sh.Label, 60)
		if sh.Sort != "" && !kindSorts[sh.Sort] {
			add(sbase+".sort", "must be title, added, released, year, rating or index")
		}
		if sh.Direction != "" && sh.Direction != "asc" && sh.Direction != "desc" {
			add(sbase+".direction", "must be asc or desc")
		}
		if sh.Facet != "" && len(sh.Filters) > 0 {
			add(sbase+".filters", "cannot be combined with facet")
		}
		if sh.Facet != "" {
			checkFacet(sbase+".facet", sh.Facet)
			switch {
			case sh.Value != "" && len(sh.Values) > 0:
				add(sbase+".values", "cannot be combined with value")
			case sh.Value != "":
				if strings.TrimSpace(sh.Value) == "" {
					add(sbase+".value", "must not be empty")
				}
			case len(sh.Values) > 0:
				for vi, v := range sh.Values {
					if strings.TrimSpace(v) == "" {
						add(fmt.Sprintf("%s.values[%d]", sbase, vi), "must not be empty")
					}
				}
			default:
				add(sbase+".value", "facet requires value or values")
			}
		} else {
			if sh.Value != "" {
				add(sbase+".value", "requires facet to be set")
			}
			if len(sh.Values) > 0 {
				add(sbase+".values", "requires facet to be set")
			}
		}
		if len(sh.Filters) > 0 {
			fkeys := make([]string, 0, len(sh.Filters))
			for fk := range sh.Filters {
				fkeys = append(fkeys, fk)
			}
			sort.Strings(fkeys)
			for _, fk := range fkeys {
				if strings.TrimSpace(fk) == "" {
					add(sbase+".filters", "filter facet key must not be empty")
					continue
				}
				fbase := sbase + ".filters." + fk
				checkFacet(fbase, fk)
				vals := sh.Filters[fk]
				if len(vals) == 0 {
					add(fbase, "must list at least one value")
					continue
				}
				for vi, v := range vals {
					if strings.TrimSpace(v) == "" {
						add(fmt.Sprintf("%s[%d]", fbase, vi), "must not be empty")
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/operator_hosts.go#DeclaresOperatorHosts

``````
// DeclaresOperatorHosts reports whether man declares "operator" in
// ether.permissions.network for an executable plugin.
func DeclaresOperatorHosts(man Manifest) bool {
	if man.Ether == nil || man.Ether.Runtime.Kind == "data" {
		return false
	}
	for _, entry := range man.Ether.Permissions.Network {
		if strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(entry), OperatorNetworkEntry) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/operator_hosts.go#NormalizeOperatorHost

``````
// NormalizeOperatorHost validates a single owner-approved host grant ("host"
// or "host:port", or a single IP literal with optional port, without schemes,
// wildcards, or CIDRs) and returns its canonical lowercase form. Wildcards
// (including bare "*") and the manifest token "operator" are rejected.
func NormalizeOperatorHost(raw string) (string, error) {
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
	if strings.Contains(trimmed, "*") {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("wildcards are not allowed; enter a specific host name or IP address")
	}
	if strings.EqualFold(trimmed, OperatorNetworkEntry) {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("must be a specific host name or IP address")
	}
	norm, ok := safefetch.NormalizeTrustedHost(trimmed)
	if !ok {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("must be a host name or single IP address (with optional :port), without wildcards or CIDRs")
	}
	return norm, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/operator_hosts.go#normalizeOperatorHosts

``````
func normalizeOperatorHosts(in []string) ([]string, error) {
	if in == nil {
		return nil, nil
	}
	out := make([]string, 0, len(in))
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, raw := range in {
		if strings.TrimSpace(raw) == "" {
			continue
		}
		norm, err := NormalizeOperatorHost(raw)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if !seen[norm] {
			seen[norm] = true
			out = append(out, norm)
		}
	}
	return out, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/operator_hosts.go#isExplicitLoopbackEntry

``````
func isExplicitLoopbackEntry(raw string) bool {
	norm, ok := safefetch.NormalizeTrustedHost(raw)
	if !ok {
		return false
	}
	host := norm
	if h, _, err := net.SplitHostPort(norm); err == nil {
		host = h
	}
	host = strings.Trim(host, "[]")
	if host == "localhost" || strings.HasSuffix(host, ".localhost") {
		return true
	}
	ip, err := netip.ParseAddr(host)
	return err == nil && ip.Unmap().IsLoopback()
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/operator_hosts.go#trustedFetchHosts

``````
// trustedFetchHosts returns the exact destinations allowed to resolve to
// non-public addresses during safefetch: Grants.LocalHosts plus, for plugins
// declaring "operator", any explicitly approved LAN or loopback literal in
// Grants.OperatorHosts. Public DNS names in OperatorHosts stay on the public
// pool so DNS-rebinding SSRF protection remains enforced.
func trustedFetchHosts(man Manifest, g Grants) []string {
	if !DeclaresOperatorHosts(man) || len(g.OperatorHosts) == 0 {
		return g.LocalHosts
	}
	var extra []string
	for _, entry := range g.OperatorHosts {
		if IsLocalNetworkHost(entry) || isExplicitLoopbackEntry(entry) {
			extra = append(extra, entry)
		}
	}
	if len(extra) == 0 {
		return g.LocalHosts
	}
	out := make([]string, 0, len(g.LocalHosts)+len(extra))
	out = append(out, g.LocalHosts...)
	out = append(out, extra...)
	return out
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/operator_hosts.go#isOperatorHostField

``````
func isOperatorHostField(key string, field map[string]any) bool {
	if field != nil {
		for _, prop := range []string{"kind", "type", "format"} {
			if s, _ := field[prop].(string); s == "url" || s == "uri" {
				return true
			}
		}
	}
	lower := strings.ToLower(key)
	for _, token := range []string{"url", "host", "endpoint", "server", "origin", "address"} {
		if strings.Contains(lower, token) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/operator_hosts.go#extractSettingHost

``````
func extractSettingHost(raw string, hostField bool) (string, bool) {
	s := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
	if s == "" {
		return "", false
	}
	if strings.Contains(s, "://") {
		u, err := url.Parse(s)
		if err != nil || u.Hostname() == "" {
			return "", false
		}
		switch strings.ToLower(u.Scheme) {
		case "http", "https", "stremio", "ws", "wss":
		default:
			return "", false
		}
		norm, err := NormalizeOperatorHost(urlHostPortDisplay(u))
		if err != nil {
			return "", false
		}
		return norm, true
	}
	if !hostField || strings.ContainsAny(s, " /\\?#@%") {
		return "", false
	}
	norm, err := NormalizeOperatorHost(s)
	if err != nil {
		return "", false
	}
	return norm, true
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/operator_hosts.go#SettingsCandidateHosts

``````
// SettingsCandidateHosts extracts normalized host or host:port candidates from
// a plugin's non-secret settings (including schema defaults when settings omit
// a field). Secret fields are never inspected.
func SettingsCandidateHosts(settings map[string]any, schema json.RawMessage, declaredSecrets []string, excludeLoopback bool) []string {
	public := NonSecretSettings(settings, schema, declaredSecrets)
	if len(public) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	hostFields := map[string]bool{}
	var doc map[string]any
	if len(schema) > 0 && json.Unmarshal(schema, &doc) == nil {
		visitSettingsFields(doc, func(key string, field map[string]any) {
			if isOperatorHostField(key, field) {
				hostFields[key] = true
			}
		})
	}
	keys := make([]string, 0, len(public))
	for key := range public {
		keys = append(keys, key)
	}
	slices.Sort(keys)

	var out []string
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	add := func(raw string, hostField bool) {
		norm, ok := extractSettingHost(raw, hostField)
		if !ok || seen[norm] {
			return
		}
		if excludeLoopback && isExplicitLoopbackEntry(norm) {
			return
		}
		seen[norm] = true
		out = append(out, norm)
	}
	for _, key := range keys {
		val := public[key]
		hf := hostFields[key] || isOperatorHostField(key, nil)
		switch v := val.(type) {
		case string:
			add(v, hf)
		case []string:
			for _, item := range v {
				add(item, hf)
			}
		case []any:
			for _, item := range v {
				if s, ok := item.(string); ok {
					add(s, hf)
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return out
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/operator_hosts.go#operatorCandidateCovered

``````
func operatorCandidateCovered(man Manifest, g Grants, cand string) bool {
	norm, err := NormalizeOperatorHost(cand)
	if err != nil {
		return true
	}
	hostSpec := norm
	if ip, ipErr := netip.ParseAddr(norm); ipErr == nil && ip.Is6() {
		hostSpec = "[" + ip.String() + "]"
	}
	u, parseErr := url.Parse("https://" + hostSpec)
	if parseErr != nil || u.Hostname() == "" {
		return true
	}
	var declared []string
	if man.Ether != nil {
		for _, entry := range man.Ether.Permissions.Network {
			if !strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(entry), OperatorNetworkEntry) {
				declared = append(declared, entry)
			}
		}
	}
	if u.Port() != "" {
		return networkAllowedURL(declared, u) || g.allowsLocalURL(u) || g.allowsOperatorURL(u)
	}
	return hostAllowed(declared, u.Hostname()) ||
		localGrantCoversBlockedEntry(declared, norm) ||
		localGrantCoversBlockedEntry(g.LocalHosts, norm) ||
		localGrantCoversBlockedEntry(g.OperatorHosts, norm)
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/operator_hosts.go#PendingOperatorHosts

``````
// PendingOperatorHosts returns distinct unapproved host or host:port entries
// referenced by a plugin's non-secret settings or recently blocked at runtime
// for a plugin declaring "operator" in permissions.network.
func PendingOperatorHosts(man Manifest, g Grants, settings map[string]any, schema json.RawMessage, blocked []string, excludeLoopback bool) []string {
	if !DeclaresOperatorHosts(man) {
		return nil
	}
	var secrets []string
	if man.Ether != nil {
		secrets = man.Ether.Permissions.Secrets
	}
	candidates := SettingsCandidateHosts(settings, schema, secrets, excludeLoopback)
	out := make([]string, 0, len(candidates)+len(blocked))
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, cand := range append(candidates, blocked...) {
		norm, err := NormalizeOperatorHost(cand)
		if err != nil || seen[norm] {
			continue
		}
		if excludeLoopback && isExplicitLoopbackEntry(norm) {
			continue
		}
		if operatorCandidateCovered(man, g, norm) {
			continue
		}
		seen[norm] = true
		out = append(out, norm)
	}
	if len(out) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	return out
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/operator_hosts.go#operatorGrantCoversBlockedEntry

``````
func operatorGrantCoversBlockedEntry(granted []string, blocked string) bool {
	hostSpec := blocked
	if ip, err := netip.ParseAddr(blocked); err == nil && ip.Is6() {
		hostSpec = "[" + ip.String() + "]"
	}
	u, err := url.Parse("https://" + hostSpec)
	if err != nil || u.Hostname() == "" {
		return false
	}
	if u.Port() != "" {
		return safefetch.TrustedHostMatchesURL(granted, u)
	}
	for _, g := range granted {
		norm, err := NormalizeOperatorHost(g)
		if err != nil {
			continue
		}
		if norm == blocked {
			return true
		}
		if h, _, splitErr := net.SplitHostPort(norm); splitErr == nil && strings.Trim(h, "[]") == blocked {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/operator_hosts.go#*Manager.noteBlockedOperatorHost

``````
func (m *Manager) noteBlockedOperatorHost(ctx context.Context, pluginID, blocked string) {
	norm, err := NormalizeOperatorHost(blocked)
	if err != nil || pluginID == "" {
		return
	}
	if g, gErr := m.store.grants(ctx, pluginID); gErr == nil {
		if operatorGrantCoversBlockedEntry(g.OperatorHosts, norm) || localGrantCoversBlockedEntry(g.LocalHosts, norm) {
			return
		}
	}
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	if m.blockedOperator == nil {
		m.blockedOperator = map[string][]string{}
	}
	cur := m.blockedOperator[pluginID]
	next := make([]string, 0, min(len(cur)+1, maxBlockedOperatorHosts))
	for _, existing := range cur {
		if existing != norm {
			next = append(next, existing)
		}
	}
	next = append(next, norm)
	if len(next) > maxBlockedOperatorHosts {
		next = next[len(next)-maxBlockedOperatorHosts:]
	}
	m.blockedOperator[pluginID] = next
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/operator_hosts.go#*Manager.BlockedOperatorHosts

``````
// BlockedOperatorHosts returns recently blocked operator-configurable hosts
// (up to 10 distinct entries) for one plugin, oldest to newest.
func (m *Manager) BlockedOperatorHosts(pluginID string) []string {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	src := m.blockedOperator[pluginID]
	if len(src) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	out := make([]string, len(src))
	copy(out, src)
	return out
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/operator_hosts.go#*Manager.pruneBlockedOperatorHosts

``````
func (m *Manager) pruneBlockedOperatorHosts(pluginID string, granted []string) {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	cur := m.blockedOperator[pluginID]
	if len(cur) == 0 {
		return
	}
	kept := cur[:0]
	for _, b := range cur {
		if !operatorGrantCoversBlockedEntry(granted, b) {
			kept = append(kept, b)
		}
	}
	if len(kept) == 0 {
		delete(m.blockedOperator, pluginID)
		return
	}
	m.blockedOperator[pluginID] = kept
}
``````

``````
	m.mu.Unlock()
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/pending.go#PendingReply

``````
// PendingReply defers a kind resolve or match without recording a failure.
// RetryInMS is clamped to 250..5000. Job is an optional /ether/job/ route;
// the host passes the original request body and drives job continuations.
type PendingReply struct {
	Pending   bool   `json:"pending"`
	RetryInMS int64  `json:"retryInMs,omitempty"`
	Job       string `json:"job,omitempty"`
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/pending.go#pendingBudgetBody

``````
func pendingBudgetBody(retryInMS int64) json.RawMessage {
	if retryInMS > 0 {
		if b, err := json.Marshal(PendingReply{Pending: true, RetryInMS: retryInMS}); err == nil {
			return b
		}
	}
	return json.RawMessage(`{"pending":true}`)
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/pending.go#*Manager.Call

``````
// Call applies the total pending budget to kind resolvers and matchers.
func (m *Manager) Call(ctx context.Context, pluginID string, req Request) (Response, error) {
	if !strings.HasPrefix(req.Path, "/ether/v1/kinds/") || strings.HasSuffix(req.Path, "/live/resolve") || (!strings.HasSuffix(req.Path, "/resolve") && !strings.HasSuffix(req.Path, "/match")) {
		return m.callOnce(ctx, pluginID, req)
	}
	parent := ctx
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, ResolverTotal)
	defer cancel()
	// One job per plugin/kind/item (and part index when set), even across
	// simultaneous Plays. Include the request body when older callers do not
	// supply an item reference.
	var identity struct {
		PartIndex *int `json:"partIndex"`
		Item      struct {
			Ref        string `json:"ref"`
			ExternalID string `json:"id"`
		} `json:"item"`
	}
	_ = json.Unmarshal(req.Body, &identity)
	item := identity.Item.Ref
	if item == "" {
		item = identity.Item.ExternalID
	}
	if item == "" {
		item = string(req.Body)
	} else if identity.PartIndex != nil {
		item = fmt.Sprintf("%s#part:%d", item, *identity.PartIndex)
	}
	suffix := fmt.Sprintf("|%x", sha256.Sum256([]byte(strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimSuffix(req.Path, "/resolve"), "/match")+"|"+item)))
	started := false
	var lastRetryMS int64
	var job *actionJob
	for {
		resp, err := m.callOnce(ctx, pluginID, req)
		if err != nil {
			if parent.Err() != nil {
				return Response{}, parent.Err()
			}
			if ctx.Err() != nil {
				return Response{Status: 202, Body: pendingBudgetBody(lastRetryMS)}, nil
			}
			return resp, err
		}
		var pending PendingReply
		if resp.Status >= 400 || json.Unmarshal(resp.Body, &pending) != nil || !pending.Pending {
			return resp, nil
		}
		if pending.RetryInMS > 0 {
			lastRetryMS = pending.RetryInMS
		}
		if !started && strings.HasPrefix(pending.Job, "/ether/job/") {
			job, err = m.startResolverJob(pluginID, resp.Body, req.Body, suffix)
			if err != nil {
				busyErr := core.JobsBusyFromPending(err.Error(), lastRetryMS)
				sec := core.JobsBusyRetrySeconds(busyErr, 5)
				return Response{
					Status: http.StatusServiceUnavailable,
					Headers: map[string]string{
						"Retry-After":         strconv.Itoa(sec),
						"X-Ether-Media-Error": "jobs_busy",
					},
					Body: core.JobsBusyErrorBody(busyErr),
				}, busyErr
			}
			started = true
		}
		var done <-chan struct{}
		if job != nil {
			done = job.done
		}
		timer := time.NewTimer(time.Duration(max(int64(250), min(int64(5000), pending.RetryInMS))) * time.Millisecond)
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			timer.Stop()
			if parent.Err() != nil {
				return Response{}, parent.Err()
			}
			return Response{Status: 202, Body: pendingBudgetBody(lastRetryMS)}, nil
		case <-done:
			timer.Stop()
			job = nil
		case <-timer.C:
		}
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/remote/host.go#Host

``````
// Host is the set of Ether services a remote plugin may call back
// into (SPEC §5.1.5). It mirrors plugins.Host method for method for
// the services remote plugins may use; secret.get is hosted-only and
// deliberately absent (remote plugins receive secrets in
// /ether/configure). Every method is expected to re-check the
// plugin's live grants and return ErrPermissionDenied when a grant
// is missing or revoked.
type Host interface {
	KVGet(ctx context.Context, pluginID, key string) ([]byte, bool, error)
	KVPut(ctx context.Context, pluginID, key string, value []byte) error
	KVDelete(ctx context.Context, pluginID, key string) error
	KVList(ctx context.Context, pluginID, prefix string) ([]string, error)
	KVUsage(ctx context.Context, pluginID string) (plugins.KVUsage, error)

	BadgesSet(ctx context.Context, pluginID, setKey string, entries []plugins.BadgeEntry) error
	BadgesClear(ctx context.Context, pluginID, setKey string) error
	BadgesUsage(ctx context.Context, pluginID string) (plugins.BadgeUsage, error)

	CatalogSearch(ctx context.Context, pluginID, query string, limit, offset int) (json.RawMessage, error)
	CatalogGet(ctx context.Context, pluginID, id string) (json.RawMessage, error)

	ViewerGranted(ctx context.Context, pluginID string) (json.RawMessage, error)
	ViewerHistory(ctx context.Context, pluginID string, viewerID int64, limit, offset int) (json.RawMessage, error)
	SetWatchState(ctx context.Context, pluginID string, viewerID int64, titleID string, watched bool) error

	CollectionsUpsert(ctx context.Context, pluginID string, collection json.RawMessage) error

	KindUpsert(ctx context.Context, pluginID, kindKey string, items []core.KindItem) (int, error)
	KindDelete(ctx context.Context, pluginID, kindKey string, externalIDs []string) error
	KindItems(ctx context.Context, pluginID, kindKey, cursor string, limit int) (core.KindPage, error)
	// KindVisible and KindBrowse evaluate a plugin library's Rules and viewer
	// access policy for the requesting frontend-adapter viewer (#615). The
	// viewer is resolved solely from the host-minted X-Ether-Viewer-Token.
	KindVisible(ctx context.Context, pluginID, viewerToken, kindKey string, ids []string) ([]string, error)
	KindBrowse(ctx context.Context, pluginID, viewerToken, kindKey string, q core.KindBrowseRequest) (core.KindPage, error)
	ResolveSources(ctx context.Context, pluginID string, q core.SourceQuery) ([]core.SourceCandidate, error)
	CachePut(ctx context.Context, pluginID, libraryKey, name string, r io.Reader) (string, error)
	CacheOpen(ctx context.Context, pluginID, blobRef string) (io.ReadSeekCloser, error)
	CacheDelete(ctx context.Context, pluginID, blobRef string) error

	// StreamURL mints a scoped stream ticket for one of the plugin's own
	// kind items for viewerID and returns the Ether stream URL (spec §6.5).
	StreamURL(ctx context.Context, pluginID string, viewerID int64, itemRef string) (string, error)

	Settings(ctx context.Context, pluginID string) (map[string]any, error)

	PublishEvent(ctx context.Context, pluginID, key string, payload json.RawMessage, corr events.Correlation) error

	NotifyOwner(ctx context.Context, pluginID, text string) error
	Log(ctx context.Context, pluginID, level, msg string, attrs map[string]any) error
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/remote/host.go#HostHandler

``````
// HostHandler serves /ether/plugin-host/* for remote plugins. Every
// request is authenticated with a plugin credential; the resolved
// plugin id is the only identity a call can act as, so a plugin can
// never name another plugin in a request body and be believed.
type HostHandler struct {
	host Host
	auth CredentialResolver
	log  *slog.Logger
	mux  *http.ServeMux
}
``````

``````
// NewHostHandler builds the plugin-host API. Mount the result at
// HostPath (or use Mount to register it on a mux).
func NewHostHandler(opts HostOptions) *HostHandler {
	h := &HostHandler{host: opts.Host, auth: opts.Auth, log: opts.Logger}
	if h.log == nil {
		h.log = slog.Default()
	}
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /ether/plugin-host/data/{service}", h.dataCall)
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /ether/plugin-host/kv", h.kvList)
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /ether/plugin-host/kv-usage", h.kvUsage)
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /ether/plugin-host/kv/{key...}", h.kvGet)
	mux.HandleFunc("PUT /ether/plugin-host/kv/{key...}", h.kvPut)
	mux.HandleFunc("DELETE /ether/plugin-host/kv/{key...}", h.kvDelete)
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /ether/plugin-host/badges/usage", h.badgesUsage)
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /ether/plugin-host/badges-usage", h.badgesUsage)
	mux.HandleFunc("PUT /ether/plugin-host/badges/{setKey}", h.badgesSet)
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /ether/plugin-host/badges/{setKey}", h.badgesPost)
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /ether/plugin-host/badges/{setKey}/set", h.badgesSet)
	mux.HandleFunc("DELETE /ether/plugin-host/badges/{setKey}", h.badgesClear)
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /ether/plugin-host/badges/{setKey}/clear", h.badgesClear)
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /ether/plugin-host/catalog/search", h.catalogSearch)
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /ether/plugin-host/catalog/{id...}", h.catalogGet)
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /ether/plugin-host/viewers/{viewerId}/history", h.viewerHistory)
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /ether/plugin-host/viewers/granted", h.viewerGranted)
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /ether/plugin-host/viewers/watch-state", h.setWatchState)
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /ether/plugin-host/collections/upsert", h.collectionsUpsert)
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /ether/plugin-host/kinds/{kind}/items", h.kindItems)
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /ether/plugin-host/kinds/{kind}/upsert", h.kindUpsert)
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /ether/plugin-host/kinds/{kind}/delete", h.kindDelete)
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /ether/plugin-host/kinds/{kind}/visible", h.kindVisible)
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /ether/plugin-host/kinds/{kind}/browse", h.kindBrowse)
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /ether/plugin-host/sources/resolve", h.resolveSources)

	mux.HandleFunc("POST /ether/plugin-host/notify", h.notify)
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /ether/plugin-host/log", h.logLine)
	h.mux = mux
	return h
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/remote/host.go#*HostHandler.ServeHTTP

``````
func (h *HostHandler) ServeHTTP(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if h.auth == nil || h.host == nil {
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "unavailable", "Plugin host API is not configured")
		return
	}
	pluginID, err := h.auth.ResolvePluginCredential(r.Context(), credentialFromRequest(r))
	if err != nil || pluginID == "" {
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized", "Plugin credential rejected")
		return
	}
	r = r.WithContext(context.WithValue(r.Context(), pluginIDContextKey{}, pluginID))
	h.mux.ServeHTTP(w, r)
}
``````

``````
func (h *HostHandler) kvGet(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	key := r.PathValue("key")
	value, ok, err := h.host.KVGet(r.Context(), pluginIDOf(r), key)
	if !h.finishErr(w, err) {
		return
	}
	if !ok {
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "not_found", "No value for this key")
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"key": key, "value": string(value)})
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/remote/host.go#*HostHandler.kvPut

``````
func (h *HostHandler) kvPut(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	key := r.PathValue("key")
	var body struct {
		Value *string `json:"value"`
	}
	// Accept either {"value": "..."} or a raw text body: the SDKs send
	// JSON, hand-rolled sidecars often send the bare value.
	raw, err := readBody(w, r, maxKVValueBytes)
	if err != nil {
		h.finishErr(w, err)
		return
	}
	value := raw
	if strings.HasPrefix(r.Header.Get("Content-Type"), "application/json") {
		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &body); err != nil || body.Value == nil {
			writeHostError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid", `Body must be {"value": "..."}`)
			return
		}
		value = []byte(*body.Value)
	}
	if !h.finishErr(w, h.host.KVPut(r.Context(), pluginIDOf(r), key, value)) {
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"ok": true})
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/remote/host.go#decodeBadgeEntries

``````
func decodeBadgeEntries(raw []byte) ([]plugins.BadgeEntry, string, bool) {
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(string(raw))
	if strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "[") {
		var entries []plugins.BadgeEntry
		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &entries); err != nil {
			return nil, "", false
		}
		return entries, "", true
	}
	var body struct {
		SetKey  string               `json:"setKey"`
		Entries []plugins.BadgeEntry `json:"entries"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &body); err != nil {
		return nil, "", false
	}
	return body.Entries, body.SetKey, true
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/remote/host.go#*HostHandler.badgesSet

``````
func (h *HostHandler) badgesSet(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	raw, err := readBody(w, r, maxHostBodyBytes)
	if err != nil {
		h.finishErr(w, err)
		return
	}
	entries, _, ok := decodeBadgeEntries(raw)
	if !ok {
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid", `Body must be {"entries": [...]}`)
		return
	}
	if !h.finishErr(w, h.host.BadgesSet(r.Context(), pluginIDOf(r), r.PathValue("setKey"), entries)) {
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"ok": true})
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/remote/host.go#*HostHandler.badgesPost

``````
func (h *HostHandler) badgesPost(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	raw, err := readBody(w, r, maxHostBodyBytes)
	if err != nil {
		h.finishErr(w, err)
		return
	}
	pathKey := r.PathValue("setKey")
	entries, bodySetKey, ok := decodeBadgeEntries(raw)
	if !ok {
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid", `Body must be {"entries": [...]}`)
		return
	}
	if pathKey == "clear" && bodySetKey != "" {
		if !h.finishErr(w, h.host.BadgesClear(r.Context(), pluginIDOf(r), bodySetKey)) {
			return
		}
		writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"ok": true})
		return
	}
	if pathKey == "set" && bodySetKey != "" {
		pathKey = bodySetKey
	}
	if !h.finishErr(w, h.host.BadgesSet(r.Context(), pluginIDOf(r), pathKey, entries)) {
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"ok": true})
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/remote/host.go#*HostHandler.kindUpsert

``````
func (h *HostHandler) kindUpsert(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	raw, err := readBody(w, r, maxKindUpsertBytes)
	if err != nil {
		h.finishErr(w, err)
		return
	}
	var items []core.KindItem
	var envelope struct {
		Items []core.KindItem `json:"items"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &envelope); err == nil && envelope.Items != nil {
		items = envelope.Items
	} else if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &items); err != nil {
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid", `Body must be {"items": [...]} or a JSON array of KindItem`)
		return
	}
	result := plugins.KindUpsertResult{}
	if wh, ok := h.host.(interface {
		KindUpsertWithResult(context.Context, string, string, []core.KindItem) (plugins.KindUpsertResult, error)
	}); ok {
		result, err = wh.KindUpsertWithResult(r.Context(), pluginIDOf(r), r.PathValue("kind"), items)
	} else {
		var accepted int
		accepted, err = h.host.KindUpsert(r.Context(), pluginIDOf(r), r.PathValue("kind"), items)
		result.Accepted = accepted
	}
	if !h.finishErr(w, err) {
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"ok": true, "accepted": result.Accepted, "added": result.Added,
		"updated": result.Updated, "unchanged": result.Unchanged,
	})
}
``````

``````
		IDs         []string `json:"ids"`
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/remote/host.go#*HostHandler.kindVisible

``````
// kindVisible returns the subset of external IDs in {kind} allowed by the
// library's Rules and viewer access policy (#615). The viewer identity comes
// exclusively from the host-minted X-Ether-Viewer-Token header on active
// frontend adapter requests, never from guest-supplied viewer IDs.
func (h *HostHandler) kindVisible(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	raw, err := readBody(w, r, maxHostBodyBytes)
	if err != nil {
		h.finishErr(w, err)
		return
	}
	var ids []string
	var envelope struct {
		IDs []string `json:"ids"`
	}
	if len(strings.TrimSpace(string(raw))) == 0 {
		ids = nil
	} else if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &envelope); err == nil && envelope.IDs != nil {
		ids = envelope.IDs
	} else if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &ids); err != nil {
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid", `Body must be {"ids": [...]} or a JSON array of item ids`)
		return
	}
	viewerToken := strings.TrimSpace(r.Header.Get(HeaderViewerToken))
	visible, err := h.host.KindVisible(r.Context(), pluginIDOf(r), viewerToken, r.PathValue("kind"), ids)
	if !h.finishErr(w, err) {
		return
	}
	if visible == nil {
		visible = []string{}
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"ids": visible})
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/remote/host.go#*HostHandler.frontendStreamURL

``````
// frontendStreamURL mints a scoped stream ticket for one of the plugin's
// own kind items and returns the Ether stream URL (spec §6.5). The viewer
// id is the one the adapter proxied the request for.
func (h *HostHandler) frontendStreamURL(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var body struct {
		ViewerID  int64  `json:"viewerId"`
		ItemRef   string `json:"itemRef"`
		PartIndex *int   `json:"partIndex,omitempty"`
	}
	if !h.decode(w, r, maxHostBodyBytes, &body) {
		return
	}
	if body.PartIndex != nil && *body.PartIndex < 0 {
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "bad_arguments", "partIndex must be non-negative")
		return
	}
	var (
		u   string
		err error
	)
	if body.PartIndex != nil {
		if ph, ok := h.host.(interface {
			StreamPartURL(ctx context.Context, pluginID string, viewerID int64, itemRef string, partIndex *int) (string, error)
		}); ok {
			u, err = ph.StreamPartURL(r.Context(), pluginIDOf(r), body.ViewerID, body.ItemRef, body.PartIndex)
		} else {
			u, err = h.host.StreamURL(r.Context(), pluginIDOf(r), body.ViewerID, body.ItemRef)
			if err == nil {
				sep := "?"
				if strings.Contains(u, "?") {
					sep = "&"
				}
				u = u + sep + "part=" + strconv.Itoa(*body.PartIndex)
			}
		}
	} else {
		u, err = h.host.StreamURL(r.Context(), pluginIDOf(r), body.ViewerID, body.ItemRef)
	}
	if !h.finishErr(w, err) {
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"url": u})
}
``````

``````
func (h *HostHandler) writeRaw(w http.ResponseWriter, out json.RawMessage, err error) {
	if !h.finishErr(w, err) {
		return
	}
	if len(out) == 0 {
		out = json.RawMessage("null")
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	_, _ = w.Write(out)
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/remote/host.go#*HostHandler.decode

``````
func (h *HostHandler) decode(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, max int64, into any) bool {
	raw, err := readBody(w, r, max)
	if err != nil {
		h.finishErr(w, err)
		return false
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, into); err != nil {
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid", "Body is not valid JSON")
		return false
	}
	return true
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/remote/host.go#*HostHandler.finishErr

``````
// finishErr maps a host error onto the EPP error shape and reports
// whether the handler may continue. Host errors are mapped, never
// echoed raw: a storage error must not leak SQL or paths to a
// plugin.
func (h *HostHandler) finishErr(w http.ResponseWriter, err error) bool {
	if err == nil {
		return true
	}
	var blockedLocal *plugins.BlockedLocalHostError
	if errors.As(err, &blockedLocal) {
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "permission_denied", blockedLocal.PluginMessage())
		return false
	}
	var blockedOp *plugins.BlockedOperatorHostError
	if errors.As(err, &blockedOp) {
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "permission_denied", blockedOp.PluginMessage())
		return false
	}
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, ErrPermissionDenied):
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "permission_denied", "This plugin does not have the grant this call needs")
	case errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound):
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "not_found", "Not found")
	case errors.Is(err, plugins.ErrQuotaExceeded):
		msg := strings.TrimPrefix(err.Error(), "remote: response body too large: ")
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusRequestEntityTooLarge, "quota_exceeded", msg)
	case errors.Is(err, ErrTooLarge):
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusRequestEntityTooLarge, "too_large", "Request body is too large")
	case errors.Is(err, ErrInvalid):
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid", cleanMessage(err))
	case errors.Is(err, ErrRateLimited):
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusTooManyRequests, "rate_limited", strings.TrimPrefix(err.Error(), "remote: rate limit exceeded: "))
	case errors.Is(err, ErrUnavailable):
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "unavailable", "This host service is not available")
	case errors.Is(err, ErrUnauthorized):
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized", "Plugin credential rejected")
	case errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded):
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusGatewayTimeout, "deadline", "The call ran past its deadline")
	default:
		h.log.Warn("plugin host call failed", "err", err)
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "error", "The host call failed")
	}
	return false
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/remote/host.go#cleanMessage

``````
// cleanMessage strips the sentinel prefix from an ErrInvalid so the
// plugin sees the specific reason ("path escapes...") only.
func cleanMessage(err error) string {
	msg := err.Error()
	msg = strings.TrimPrefix(msg, "remote: invalid request: ")
	msg = strings.TrimPrefix(msg, "remote: invalid request")
	if msg == "" {
		return "The request is not valid"
	}
	return msg
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/remote/host.go#pageParams

``````
// pageParams reads limit/offset, or page/pageSize, clamped.
func pageParams(r *http.Request) (limit, offset int) {
	q := r.URL.Query()
	limit = defaultPageLimit
	if v, err := strconv.Atoi(q.Get("limit")); err == nil && v > 0 {
		limit = v
	}
	if v, err := paging.ParseOffset(q.Get("offset"), limit); err == nil && v >= 0 {
		offset = v
	}
	if q.Get("page") != "" {
		pageSize := limit
		if v, err := strconv.Atoi(q.Get("pageSize")); err == nil && v > 0 {
			pageSize = v
		}
		if v, err := strconv.Atoi(q.Get("page")); err == nil && v >= 1 {
			limit = pageSize
			offset = paging.PageOffset(v, pageSize)
		}
	}
	if limit > maxPageLimit {
		limit = maxPageLimit
	}
	return limit, offset
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/remote/host.go#readBody

``````
func readBody(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, max int64) ([]byte, error) {
	if r.Body == nil {
		return nil, nil
	}
	raw, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(r.Body, max+1))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if int64(len(raw)) > max {
		return nil, ErrTooLarge
	}
	return raw, nil
}
``````

``````
// dataCall exposes only bounded blob/archive services, authenticated like all
// other plugin-host calls. HostAdapter performs the live grant checks.
func (h *HostHandler) dataCall(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var args json.RawMessage
	if !h.decode(w, r, maxHostBodyBytes, &args) {
		return
	}
	service, ok := h.host.(interface {
		CallDataHost(context.Context, string, string, json.RawMessage) (json.RawMessage, error)
	})
	if !ok {
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "unavailable", "Data services unavailable")
		return
	}
	out, err := service.CallDataHost(r.Context(), pluginIDOf(r), r.PathValue("service"), args)
	if !h.finishErr(w, err) {
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, out)
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/remote_hash.go#*host.hashPermission

``````
func (h *host) hashPermission(ctx context.Context, req HashRequest) error {
	if req.Algo != "sha256" && req.Algo != "sha1" && req.Algo != "md5" {
		return fmt.Errorf("plugins: hash algo must be sha256, sha1 or md5")
	}
	if req.ExpectSize != nil && (*req.ExpectSize < 0 || *req.ExpectSize > RemoteHashMaxBytes) {
		return fmt.Errorf("plugins: hash size outside limit")
	}
	u, err := url.Parse(req.URL)
	if err != nil || (u.Scheme != "http" && u.Scheme != "https") || u.Hostname() == "" {
		return ErrPermissionDenied
	}
	if err := h.allowNetworkURL(ctx, u); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return nil
}
``````

``````
func (h *host) cachedRemoteHash(ctx context.Context, key string) (remoteHashEntry, error) {
	var e remoteHashEntry
	var data []byte
	err := h.m.store.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT etag,modified,value,checked FROM plugins_remote_hashes WHERE plugin=? AND urlkey=?`, h.plugin, key).Scan(&e.etag, &e.modified, &data, &e.checked)
	if err == nil {
		err = json.Unmarshal(data, &e.HashResult)
	}
	return e, err
}
``````
