## Source: sdk/examples/english-dubs/src/plugin.ts

``````
// English dubbed anime list source plugin for Ether.
//
// Fetches the community MAL-Dubs index (AGPL-3.0) and Fribb/anime-lists
// MyAnimeList-to-TMDB mapping at runtime, caches compacted data in KV with
// ETag / If-Modified-Since revalidation, and exposes Ether list sources for
// confirmed English dubs and in-progress dubs.

export const MAL_DUBS_URL =
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MAL-Dubs/MAL-Dubs/main/data/dubInfo.json";
export const FRIBB_MAP_URL =
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Fribb/anime-lists/master/anime-list-mini.json";

export const CACHE_TTL_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
export const PAGE_SIZE = 200;

const KV_DUBS_META = "dubs:meta";
const KV_DUBS_DATA = "dubs:data";
const KV_MAP_META = "map:meta";
const KV_MAP_DATA = "map:data";
const KV_INDEX_STATS = "index:stats";
const KV_INDEX_DUBBED_SERIES = "index:dubbed:series";
const KV_INDEX_DUBBED_MOVIE = "index:dubbed:movie";
const KV_INDEX_INCOMPLETE_SERIES = "index:incomplete:series";
const KV_INDEX_INCOMPLETE_MOVIE = "index:incomplete:movie";

const KIND_UNKNOWN = 0;
const KIND_TV = 1;
const KIND_MOVIE = 2;
const KIND_OVA = 3;
const KIND_ONA = 4;
const KIND_SPECIAL = 5;

export type TypeFilter = "both" | "series" | "movies";
export type CatalogMediaType = "series" | "movie";
export type CatalogId = "dubbed" | "incomplete";

export interface PluginSettings {
  includeIncomplete: boolean;
  typeFilter: TypeFilter;
}

export interface PluginRequest {
  method?: string;
  path: string;
  query?: Record<string, string | string[]>;
  headers?: Record<string, string>;
  body?: unknown;
}

export interface PluginResponse {
  status: number;
  headers?: Record<string, string>;
  body: unknown;
}

interface HttpFetchRequest {
  url: string;
  method?: string;
  headers?: Record<string, string>;
  body?: string;
  timeoutMs?: number;
}

interface HttpFetchResponse {
  status: number;
  headers?: Record<string, string>;
  body?: string;
}

export interface HostedEtherGlobal {
  kv: {
    get(key: string): string | null;
    put(key: string, value: string): void;
    delete(key: string): void;
    list(prefix?: string): string[];
  };
  settings: {
    get(): Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined;
  };
  http: {
    fetch(req: HttpFetchRequest): HttpFetchResponse;
  };
  log?(...args: unknown[]): void;
}

interface CacheMeta {
  etag: string;
  lastModified: string;
  fetchedAt: number;
}

export interface DubInfo {
  dubbed: number[];
  incomplete: number[];
}

// Compact tuple persisted in KV: [kindCode, tmdbTv, tmdbMovie, imdb, tvdb]
export type CompactFribbEntry = [
  number,
  number | number[],
  number | number[],
  string,
  number,
];

export type CompactFribbMap = Record<string, CompactFribbEntry>;

// Compact catalog tuple persisted in KV: [id, malId, tmdbId, imdbId, tvdbId]
export type CompactCatalogItem = [string, number, number, string, number];

export interface IndexStats {
  builtAt: number;
  checkedAt: number;
  dubbedRawCount: number;
  incompleteRawCount: number;
  dubbedSeriesCount: number;
  dubbedMovieCount: number;
  incompleteSeriesCount: number;
  incompleteMovieCount: number;
  dubbedUnmapped: number;
  incompleteUnmapped: number;
  lastError?: string;
}

export interface MetaPreview {
  id: string;
  type: CatalogMediaType;
  name: string;
  tmdb_id?: number;
  imdb_id?: string;
  tvdb_id?: number;
}

function getEther(): HostedEtherGlobal {
  const g = (globalThis as unknown as { ether?: HostedEtherGlobal }).ether;
  if (!g) {
    throw new Error("Ether host global is unavailable");
  }
  return g;
}

function ok(body: unknown): PluginResponse {
  return { status: 200, body };
}

function errorResponse(status: number, code: string, message: string): PluginResponse {
  return { status, body: { error: { code, message } } };
}

function logWarn(msg: string): void {
  try {
    getEther().log?.("warn", msg);
  } catch {
    // Logging must never break request handling.
  }
}

function parseBody(raw: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {
  if (raw == null) return {};
  if (typeof raw === "string") {
    const trimmed = raw.trim();
    if (!trimmed) return {};
    const parsed = JSON.parse(trimmed);
    return parsed && typeof parsed === "object" && !Array.isArray(parsed)
      ? (parsed as Record<string, unknown>)
      : {};
  }
  if (typeof raw === "object" && !Array.isArray(raw)) {
    return raw as Record<string, unknown>;
  }
  return {};
}

function getHeader(headers: Record<string, string> | undefined, name: string): string {
  if (!headers) return "";
  const want = name.toLowerCase();
  for (const key of Object.keys(headers)) {
    if (key.toLowerCase() === want) {
      return String(headers[key] ?? "").trim();
    }
  }
  return "";
}

function getQueryValue(
  query: Record<string, string | string[]> | undefined,
  key: string,
): string {
  if (!query) return "";
  const val = query[key];
  if (Array.isArray(val)) return String(val[0] ?? "");
  if (typeof val === "string") return val;
  return "";
}

function isFatalHostError(err: unknown): boolean {
  const code = (err as { code?: string } | null)?.code;
  if (
    code === "check_dependency" ||
    code === "forbidden" ||
    code === "governance" ||
    code === "aborted"
  ) {
    return true;
  }
  const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
  return (
    msg.includes("check_dependency") ||
    msg.includes("forbidden") ||
    msg.includes("governance")
  );
}

export function normalizeSettings(raw: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined): PluginSettings {
  const obj = raw && typeof raw === "object" ? raw : {};
  const includeIncomplete = Boolean(obj.includeIncomplete);
  const tf = typeof obj.typeFilter === "string" ? obj.typeFilter.trim().toLowerCase() : "both";
  const typeFilter: TypeFilter =
    tf === "series" || tf === "movies" || tf === "both" ? tf : "both";
  return { includeIncomplete, typeFilter };
}

export function validateSettings(raw: Record<string, unknown>): Record<string, string> {
  const errors: Record<string, string> = {};
  if (
    raw.includeIncomplete !== undefined &&
    typeof raw.includeIncomplete !== "boolean"
  ) {
    errors.includeIncomplete = "Include incomplete dubs must be true or false.";
  }
  if (raw.typeFilter !== undefined) {
    const tf =
      typeof raw.typeFilter === "string" ? raw.typeFilter.trim().toLowerCase() : "";
    if (tf !== "both" && tf !== "series" && tf !== "movies") {
      errors.typeFilter = "Type filter must be both, series, or movies.";
    }
  }
  return errors;
}

function readKVJson<T>(key: string): T | null {
  const raw = getEther().kv.get(key);
  if (!raw) return null;
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw) as T;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function writeKVJson(key: string, value: unknown): void {
  getEther().kv.put(key, JSON.stringify(value));
}

function toPositiveInt(v: unknown): number {
  if (typeof v === "number") {
    return Number.isFinite(v) && v > 0 && Math.floor(v) === v ? v : 0;
  }
  if (typeof v === "string") {
    const s = v.trim();
    if (!/^[0-9]+$/.test(s)) return 0;
    const n = Number(s);
    return Number.isSafeInteger(n) && n > 0 ? n : 0;
  }
  return 0;
}

function toPositiveIntList(v: unknown): number[] {
  if (Array.isArray(v)) {
    const out: number[] = [];
    for (const item of v) {
      const n = toPositiveInt(item);
      if (n > 0 && !out.includes(n)) out.push(n);
    }
    return out;
  }
  const single = toPositiveInt(v);
  return single > 0 ? [single] : [];
}

function compactIntOrList(nums: number[]): number | number[] {
  if (nums.length === 0) return 0;
  if (nums.length === 1) return nums[0];
  return nums;
}

function expandIntOrList(v: number | number[]): number[] {
  if (Array.isArray(v)) return v;
  return v > 0 ? [v] : [];
}

function normalizeImdb(v: unknown): string {
  const check = (s: unknown): string => {
    if (typeof s !== "string") return "";
    const norm = s.trim().toLowerCase();
    return /^tt[0-9]+$/.test(norm) ? norm : "";
  };
  if (Array.isArray(v)) {
    for (const item of v) {
      const ok = check(item);
      if (ok) return ok;
    }
    return "";
  }
  return check(v);
}

function encodeKind(raw: unknown): number {
  if (typeof raw !== "string") return KIND_UNKNOWN;
  switch (raw.trim().toUpperCase()) {
    case "TV":
      return KIND_TV;
    case "MOVIE":
      return KIND_MOVIE;
    case "OVA":
      return KIND_OVA;
    case "ONA":
      return KIND_ONA;
    case "SPECIAL":
      return KIND_SPECIAL;
    default:
      return KIND_UNKNOWN;
  }
}

export function parseDubInfoJson(raw: string): DubInfo {
  let doc: unknown;
  try {
    doc = JSON.parse(raw);
  } catch (err) {
    throw new Error(
      `Invalid MAL-Dubs JSON: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)}`,
    );
  }
  if (!doc || typeof doc !== "object" || Array.isArray(doc)) {
    throw new Error("MAL-Dubs payload must be a JSON object");
  }
  const rec = doc as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (!Array.isArray(rec.dubbed)) {
    throw new Error("MAL-Dubs payload is missing the dubbed array");
  }
  const collect = (arr: unknown): number[] => {
    if (!Array.isArray(arr)) return [];
    const seen = new Set<number>();
    const out: number[] = [];
    for (const item of arr) {
      const n = toPositiveInt(item);
      if (n > 0 && !seen.has(n)) {
        seen.add(n);
        out.push(n);
      }
    }
    return out;
  };
  return {
    dubbed: collect(rec.dubbed),
    incomplete: collect(rec.incomplete),
  };
}

function mergeCompactEntry(
  existing: CompactFribbEntry | undefined,
  incoming: CompactFribbEntry,
): CompactFribbEntry {
  if (!existing) return incoming;
  const kind = existing[0] !== KIND_UNKNOWN ? existing[0] : incoming[0];
  const tv = expandIntOrList(existing[1]);
  for (const id of expandIntOrList(incoming[1])) {
    if (!tv.includes(id)) tv.push(id);
  }
  const mv = expandIntOrList(existing[2]);
  for (const id of expandIntOrList(incoming[2])) {
    if (!mv.includes(id)) mv.push(id);
  }
  const imdb = existing[3] || incoming[3];
  const tvdb = existing[4] || incoming[4];
  return [kind, compactIntOrList(tv), compactIntOrList(mv), imdb, tvdb];
}

// Parse Fribb/anime-lists anime-list-mini.json and compact it to only entries
// with a MyAnimeList ID and at least one TMDB, IMDb, or TVDB identifier.
// Uses native JSON.parse (compiled C in QuickJS) rather than a JS character
// scanner so the ~5.9 MB upstream file parses in milliseconds.
export function parseFribbMiniJson(raw: string): CompactFribbMap {
  let arr: unknown;
  try {
    arr = JSON.parse(raw);
  } catch (err) {
    throw new Error(
      `Invalid Fribb anime-lists JSON: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)}`,
    );
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(arr)) {
    throw new Error("Fribb anime-lists payload must be a JSON array");
  }

  const out: CompactFribbMap = {};
  for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
    const item = arr[i];
    if (!item || typeof item !== "object" || Array.isArray(item)) continue;
    const entry = item as Record<string, unknown>;

    const malId = toPositiveInt(entry.mal_id);
    if (malId <= 0) continue;

    let tmdbTv: number[] = [];
    let tmdbMovie: number[] = [];
    const rawTmdb = entry.themoviedb_id;
    if (rawTmdb && typeof rawTmdb === "object" && !Array.isArray(rawTmdb)) {
      const t = rawTmdb as Record<string, unknown>;
      tmdbTv = toPositiveIntList(t.tv);
      tmdbMovie = toPositiveIntList(t.movie);
    }

    const imdb = normalizeImdb(entry.imdb_id);
    const tvdbList = toPositiveIntList(entry.tvdb_id);
    const tvdb = tvdbList.length > 0 ? tvdbList[0] : 0;

    if (tmdbTv.length === 0 && tmdbMovie.length === 0 && !imdb && tvdb === 0) {
      continue;
    }

    const key = String(malId);
    const compact: CompactFribbEntry = [
      encodeKind(entry.type),
      compactIntOrList(tmdbTv),
      compactIntOrList(tmdbMovie),
      imdb,
      tvdb,
    ];
    out[key] = mergeCompactEntry(out[key], compact);
  }

  return out;
}

function buildListForMalIds(
  malIds: number[],
  fribbMap: CompactFribbMap,
): { series: CompactCatalogItem[]; movie: CompactCatalogItem[]; unmapped: number } {
  const series: CompactCatalogItem[] = [];
  const movie: CompactCatalogItem[] = [];
  const seenSeriesId = new Set<string>();
  const seenSeriesImdb = new Set<string>();
  const seenSeriesTvdb = new Set<number>();
  const seenMovieId = new Set<string>();
  const seenMovieImdb = new Set<string>();
  let unmapped = 0;

  const pushSeries = (item: CompactCatalogItem, isFallback: boolean): void => {
    const [id, , , imdb, tvdb] = item;
    if (seenSeriesId.has(id)) return;
    if (isFallback) {
      if (tvdb > 0 && seenSeriesTvdb.has(tvdb)) return;
      if (imdb && seenSeriesImdb.has(imdb)) return;
    }
    seenSeriesId.add(id);
    if (imdb) seenSeriesImdb.add(imdb);
    if (tvdb > 0) seenSeriesTvdb.add(tvdb);
    series.push(item);
  };

  const pushMovie = (item: CompactCatalogItem, isFallback: boolean): void => {
    const [id, , , imdb] = item;
    if (seenMovieId.has(id)) return;
    if (isFallback && imdb && seenMovieImdb.has(imdb)) return;
    seenMovieId.add(id);
    if (imdb) seenMovieImdb.add(imdb);
    movie.push(item);
  };

  for (const malId of malIds) {
    const entry = fribbMap[String(malId)];
    if (!entry) {
      unmapped++;
      continue;
    }
    const [kind, rawTv, rawMovie, imdb, tvdb] = entry;
    const tmdbTv = expandIntOrList(rawTv);
    const tmdbMovie = expandIntOrList(rawMovie);

    let mapped = false;
    if (tmdbTv.length > 0) {
      mapped = true;
      for (const tvId of tmdbTv) {
        pushSeries([`tmdb:${tvId}`, malId, tvId, imdb, tvdb], false);
      }
    }
    if (tmdbMovie.length > 0) {
      mapped = true;
      for (const mvId of tmdbMovie) {
        pushMovie([`tmdb:${mvId}`, malId, mvId, imdb, 0], false);
      }
    }

    if (!mapped) {
      if (kind === KIND_MOVIE) {
        if (imdb) {
          mapped = true;
          pushMovie([imdb, malId, 0, imdb, 0], true);
        }
      } else {
        if (tvdb > 0) {
          mapped = true;
          pushSeries([`tvdb:${tvdb}`, malId, 0, imdb, tvdb], true);
        } else if (imdb) {
          mapped = true;
          pushSeries([imdb, malId, 0, imdb, 0], true);
        }
      }
    }

    if (!mapped) {
      unmapped++;
    }
  }

  return { series, movie, unmapped };
}

export function mergeCatalogLists(
  primary: CompactCatalogItem[],
  secondary: CompactCatalogItem[],
): CompactCatalogItem[] {
  if (secondary.length === 0) return primary;
  const out = primary.slice();
  const seenId = new Set<string>();
  const seenImdb = new Set<string>();
  const seenTvdb = new Set<number>();
  for (const item of primary) {
    seenId.add(item[0]);
    if (item[3]) seenImdb.add(item[3]);
    if (item[4] > 0) seenTvdb.add(item[4]);
  }
  for (const item of secondary) {
    const [id, , tmdb, imdb, tvdb] = item;
    if (seenId.has(id)) continue;
    const isFallback = tmdb === 0;
    if (isFallback) {
      if (tvdb > 0 && seenTvdb.has(tvdb)) continue;
      if (imdb && seenImdb.has(imdb)) continue;
    }
    seenId.add(id);
    if (imdb) seenImdb.add(imdb);
    if (tvdb > 0) seenTvdb.add(tvdb);
    out.push(item);
  }
  return out;
}

interface FetchResourceResult<T> {
  changed: boolean;
  data: T;
  meta: CacheMeta;
  staleError?: string;
}

function fetchCachedResource<T>(
  url: string,
  metaKey: string,
  dataKey: string,
  parse: (body: string) => T,
  force: boolean,
  now: number,
): FetchResourceResult<T> {
  const existingMeta = readKVJson<CacheMeta>(metaKey);
  const existingData = readKVJson<T>(dataKey);
  const hasCache = existingData !== null;

  if (
    !force &&
    hasCache &&
    existingMeta &&
    existingMeta.fetchedAt > 0 &&
    now - existingMeta.fetchedAt < CACHE_TTL_MS
  ) {
    return { changed: false, data: existingData, meta: existingMeta };
  }

  const headers: Record<string, string> = { Accept: "application/json" };
  if (hasCache && existingMeta) {
    if (existingMeta.etag) headers["If-None-Match"] = existingMeta.etag;
    if (existingMeta.lastModified) {
      headers["If-Modified-Since"] = existingMeta.lastModified;
    }
  }

  let resp: HttpFetchResponse;
  try {
    resp = getEther().http.fetch({
      url,
      method: "GET",
      headers,
      timeoutMs: 25000,
    });
  } catch (err) {
    if (isFatalHostError(err)) throw err;
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    if (hasCache && existingMeta) {
      logWarn(`Using cached data for ${url} after fetch error: ${msg}`);
      return {
        changed: false,
        data: existingData,
        meta: existingMeta,
        staleError: msg,
      };
    }
    throw new Error(`Failed to fetch ${url}: ${msg}`);
  }

  if (resp.status === 304 && hasCache) {
    const nextMeta: CacheMeta = {
      etag: getHeader(resp.headers, "etag") || existingMeta?.etag || "",
      lastModified:
        getHeader(resp.headers, "last-modified") ||
        existingMeta?.lastModified ||
        "",
      fetchedAt: now,
    };
    writeKVJson(metaKey, nextMeta);
    return { changed: false, data: existingData, meta: nextMeta };
  }

  if (resp.status !== 200) {
    const msg = `HTTP ${resp.status} from ${url}`;
    if (hasCache && existingMeta) {
      logWarn(`Using cached data for ${url} after ${msg}`);
      return {
        changed: false,
        data: existingData,
        meta: existingMeta,
        staleError: msg,
      };
    }
    throw new Error(msg);
  }

  const body =
    typeof resp.body === "string"
      ? resp.body
      : resp.body == null
        ? ""
        : JSON.stringify(resp.body);

  let parsed: T;
  try {
    parsed = parse(body);
  } catch (err) {
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    if (hasCache && existingMeta) {
      logWarn(`Using cached data for ${url} after parse error: ${msg}`);
      return {
        changed: false,
        data: existingData,
        meta: existingMeta,
        staleError: msg,
      };
    }
    throw err;
  }

  const nextMeta: CacheMeta = {
    etag: getHeader(resp.headers, "etag"),
    lastModified: getHeader(resp.headers, "last-modified"),
    fetchedAt: now,
  };
  writeKVJson(dataKey, parsed);
  writeKVJson(metaKey, nextMeta);
  return { changed: true, data: parsed, meta: nextMeta };
}

export function refreshCache(force: boolean): {
  changed: boolean;
  stats: IndexStats;
} {
  const now = Date.now();
  const dubsRes = fetchCachedResource<DubInfo>(
    MAL_DUBS_URL,
    KV_DUBS_META,
    KV_DUBS_DATA,
    parseDubInfoJson,
    force,
    now,
  );
  const mapRes = fetchCachedResource<CompactFribbMap>(
    FRIBB_MAP_URL,
    KV_MAP_META,
    KV_MAP_DATA,
    parseFribbMiniJson,
    force,
    now,
  );

  const existingStats = readKVJson<IndexStats>(KV_INDEX_STATS);
  const hasLists =
    existingStats !== null &&
    getEther().kv.get(KV_INDEX_DUBBED_SERIES) !== null &&
    getEther().kv.get(KV_INDEX_DUBBED_MOVIE) !== null &&
    getEther().kv.get(KV_INDEX_INCOMPLETE_SERIES) !== null &&
    getEther().kv.get(KV_INDEX_INCOMPLETE_MOVIE) !== null;

  const errors: string[] = [];
  if (dubsRes.staleError) errors.push(dubsRes.staleError);
  if (mapRes.staleError) errors.push(mapRes.staleError);
  const lastError = errors.length > 0 ? errors.join("; ") : undefined;

  if (!dubsRes.changed && !mapRes.changed && hasLists && existingStats) {
    const updatedStats: IndexStats = {
      ...existingStats,
      checkedAt: now,
      lastError,
    };
    writeKVJson(KV_INDEX_STATS, updatedStats);
    return { changed: false, stats: updatedStats };
  }

  const dubbedBuilt = buildListForMalIds(dubsRes.data.dubbed, mapRes.data);
  const incompleteBuilt = buildListForMalIds(
    dubsRes.data.incomplete,
    mapRes.data,
  );

  writeKVJson(KV_INDEX_DUBBED_SERIES, dubbedBuilt.series);
  writeKVJson(KV_INDEX_DUBBED_MOVIE, dubbedBuilt.movie);
  writeKVJson(KV_INDEX_INCOMPLETE_SERIES, incompleteBuilt.series);
  writeKVJson(KV_INDEX_INCOMPLETE_MOVIE, incompleteBuilt.movie);

  const stats: IndexStats = {
    builtAt: now,
    checkedAt: now,
    dubbedRawCount: dubsRes.data.dubbed.length,
    incompleteRawCount: dubsRes.data.incomplete.length,
    dubbedSeriesCount: dubbedBuilt.series.length,
    dubbedMovieCount: dubbedBuilt.movie.length,
    incompleteSeriesCount: incompleteBuilt.series.length,
    incompleteMovieCount: incompleteBuilt.movie.length,
    dubbedUnmapped: dubbedBuilt.unmapped,
    incompleteUnmapped: incompleteBuilt.unmapped,
    lastError,
  };
  writeKVJson(KV_INDEX_STATS, stats);
  return { changed: true, stats };
}

function ensureFreshIndex(): IndexStats {
  const now = Date.now();
  const stats = readKVJson<IndexStats>(KV_INDEX_STATS);
  const dubsMeta = readKVJson<CacheMeta>(KV_DUBS_META);
  const mapMeta = readKVJson<CacheMeta>(KV_MAP_META);
  if (
    stats &&
    dubsMeta &&
    mapMeta &&
    dubsMeta.fetchedAt > 0 &&
    mapMeta.fetchedAt > 0 &&
    now - dubsMeta.fetchedAt < CACHE_TTL_MS &&
    now - mapMeta.fetchedAt < CACHE_TTL_MS &&
    getEther().kv.get(KV_INDEX_DUBBED_SERIES) !== null
  ) {
    return stats;
  }
  return refreshCache(false).stats;
}

export function parseCatalogRoute(
  path: string,
  query?: Record<string, string | string[]>,
): { type: CatalogMediaType; id: CatalogId; skip: number } | null {
  const cleanPath = path.split("?")[0];
  if (!cleanPath.startsWith("/catalog/") || !cleanPath.endsWith(".json")) {
    return null;
  }
  const inner = cleanPath.slice("/catalog/".length, -".json".length);
  const parts = inner.split("/");
  if (parts.length < 2 || parts.length > 3) return null;

  let rawType: string;
  let rawId: string;
  try {
    rawType = decodeURIComponent(parts[0]).toLowerCase();
    rawId = decodeURIComponent(parts[1]).toLowerCase();
  } catch {
    return null;
  }

  let type: CatalogMediaType;
  if (rawType === "series" || rawType === "show" || rawType === "tv") {
    type = "series";
  } else if (rawType === "movie") {
    type = "movie";
  } else {
    return null;
  }

  if (rawId !== "dubbed" && rawId !== "incomplete") {
    return null;
  }

  let skip = 0;
  if (parts.length === 3 && parts[2]) {
    for (const pair of parts[2].split("&")) {
      const eq = pair.indexOf("=");
      if (eq <= 0) continue;
      const k = decodeURIComponent(pair.slice(0, eq));
      const v = decodeURIComponent(pair.slice(eq + 1));
      if (k === "skip") {
        const n = Number.parseInt(v, 10);
        if (Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0) skip = n;
      }
    }
  }
  if (skip === 0) {
    const qSkip = getQueryValue(query, "skip");
    if (qSkip) {
      const n = Number.parseInt(qSkip, 10);
      if (Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0) skip = n;
    }
  }

  return { type, id: rawId, skip };
}

function itemToMeta(item: CompactCatalogItem, type: CatalogMediaType): MetaPreview {
  const [id, malId, tmdbId, imdbId, tvdbId] = item;
  const meta: MetaPreview = {
    id,
    type,
    name: `MAL ${malId}`,
  };
  if (tmdbId > 0) meta.tmdb_id = tmdbId;
  if (imdbId) meta.imdb_id = imdbId;
  if (tvdbId > 0) meta.tvdb_id = tvdbId;
  return meta;
}

function handleCatalog(req: PluginRequest): PluginResponse {
  const parsed = parseCatalogRoute(req.path, req.query);
  if (!parsed) {
    return errorResponse(404, "not_found", "Catalog not found.");
  }

  const settings = normalizeSettings(getEther().settings.get());
  if (
    (parsed.type === "movie" && settings.typeFilter === "series") ||
    (parsed.type === "series" && settings.typeFilter === "movies")
  ) {
    return ok({ metas: [], hasMore: false });
  }

  ensureFreshIndex();

  let list: CompactCatalogItem[];
  if (parsed.id === "dubbed") {
    const primaryKey =
      parsed.type === "series" ? KV_INDEX_DUBBED_SERIES : KV_INDEX_DUBBED_MOVIE;
    const primary = readKVJson<CompactCatalogItem[]>(primaryKey) ?? [];
    if (settings.includeIncomplete) {
      const incKey =
        parsed.type === "series"
          ? KV_INDEX_INCOMPLETE_SERIES
          : KV_INDEX_INCOMPLETE_MOVIE;
      const secondary = readKVJson<CompactCatalogItem[]>(incKey) ?? [];
      list = mergeCatalogLists(primary, secondary);
    } else {
      list = primary;
    }
  } else {
    const incKey =
      parsed.type === "series"
        ? KV_INDEX_INCOMPLETE_SERIES
        : KV_INDEX_INCOMPLETE_MOVIE;
    list = readKVJson<CompactCatalogItem[]>(incKey) ?? [];
  }

  if (parsed.skip >= list.length) {
    return ok({ metas: [], hasMore: false });
  }

  const page = list.slice(parsed.skip, parsed.skip + PAGE_SIZE);
  const hasMore = parsed.skip + page.length < list.length;
  return ok({
    metas: page.map((item) => itemToMeta(item, parsed.type)),
    hasMore,
  });
}

function formatTypeFilter(tf: TypeFilter): string {
  if (tf === "series") return "series only";
  if (tf === "movies") return "movies only";
  return "series and movies";
}

function handleStatusView(): PluginResponse {
  const settings = normalizeSettings(getEther().settings.get());
  const stats = readKVJson<IndexStats>(KV_INDEX_STATS);

  const mappedSeries = stats ? String(stats.dubbedSeriesCount) : "0";
  const mappedMovies = stats ? String(stats.dubbedMovieCount) : "0";
  const mappedIncomplete = stats
    ? String(stats.incompleteSeriesCount + stats.incompleteMovieCount)
    : "0";

  const filterSummary = `Active settings: ${formatTypeFilter(settings.typeFilter)}, incomplete dubs ${
    settings.includeIncomplete ? "included in the main list" : "kept separate"
  }.`;

  let cacheStatus: string;
  if (!stats) {
    cacheStatus = `Cache not populated yet. ${filterSummary} Run Refresh cache or wait for the daily schedule.`;
  } else {
    const checkedIso = new Date(stats.checkedAt || stats.builtAt).toISOString();
    const gapNote =
      stats.dubbedUnmapped > 0
        ? ` ${stats.dubbedUnmapped} of ${stats.dubbedRawCount} MAL-Dubs entries had no TMDB, IMDb, or TVDB mapping.`
        : "";
    const errNote = stats.lastError
      ? ` Serving cached data after last refresh error: ${stats.lastError}.`
      : "";
    cacheStatus = `Last checked ${checkedIso}. ${filterSummary}${gapNote}${errNote}`;
  }

  return ok({
    title: "English dubbed anime",
    spec: {
      specVersion: 1,
      layout: "detail",
      header: [
        {
          kind: "page-header",
          title: "$t:page_title",
          description: { $: "subtitle" },
        },
      ],
      body: [
        {
          kind: "stat-tile",
          iconKey: "tv",
          accent: "primary",
          label: "$t:stat_mapped_series",
          value: { $: "mappedSeries" },
        },
        {
          kind: "stat-tile",
          iconKey: "film",
          accent: "primary",
          label: "$t:stat_mapped_movies",
          value: { $: "mappedMovies" },
        },
        {
          kind: "stat-tile",
          iconKey: "clock",
          accent: "primary",
          label: "$t:stat_incomplete",
          value: { $: "mappedIncomplete" },
        },
        {
          kind: "panel",
          title: "$t:panel_cache",
          blocks: [
            { kind: "text", content: { $: "cacheStatus" } },
            {
              kind: "widget",
              widget: "ether.actionButton",
              props: {
                label: "$t:action_refresh",
                action: "refresh",
              },
            },
          ],
        },
        {
          kind: "panel",
          title: "$t:panel_source",
          blocks: [{ kind: "text", content: "$t:source_credit" }],
        },
      ],
    },
    data: {
      subtitle:
        "Provides English-dubbed anime list sources for Home rows, collections, and library rules.",
      mappedSeries,
      mappedMovies,
      mappedIncomplete,
      cacheStatus,
    },
  });
}

function handleTest(): PluginResponse {
  try {
    const res = refreshCache(true);
    const total = res.stats.dubbedSeriesCount + res.stats.dubbedMovieCount;
    return ok({
      ok: total > 0 && !res.stats.lastError,
      message: res.stats.lastError
        ? `Connected with cached fallback: ${res.stats.lastError}`
        : `Mapped ${res.stats.dubbedSeriesCount} series and ${res.stats.dubbedMovieCount} movies from ${res.stats.dubbedRawCount} MAL-Dubs entries.`,
    });
  } catch (err) {
    if (isFatalHostError(err)) throw err;
    return ok({
      ok: false,
      message: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err),
    });
  }
}

export function handle(req: PluginRequest): PluginResponse {
  const path = (req.path || "").split("?")[0];

  if (path === "/ether/health") {
    return ok({ status: "ok" });
  }

  if (path === "/ether/configure") {
    return ok({ errors: validateSettings(parseBody(req.body)) });
  }

  if (path === "/ether/test") {
    return handleTest();
  }

  if (path === "/ether/job/refresh") {
    const body = parseBody(req.body);
    const force = body.force === false ? false : true;
    const res = refreshCache(force);
    return ok({
      done: true,
      changed: res.changed,
      stats: res.stats,
    });
  }

  if (path === "/ether/action/refresh") {
    const res = refreshCache(true);
    const total = res.stats.dubbedSeriesCount + res.stats.dubbedMovieCount;
    const toast = res.stats.lastError
      ? `Kept cached ${total} titles after refresh error.`
      : `English dubbed anime cache ready (${res.stats.dubbedSeriesCount} series, ${res.stats.dubbedMovieCount} movies).`;
    return ok({ toast, refresh: true });
  }

  if (path === "/ether/view/status") {
    return handleStatusView();
  }

  if (path.startsWith("/catalog/")) {
    return handleCatalog(req);
  }

  return errorResponse(404, "not_found", "Route not found.");
}

(globalThis as unknown as { handle?: typeof handle }).handle = handle;

``````

# Ether Wrapped

Explore a granted viewer's completed titles for the current year, with a monthly chart, top genres and a poster grid. Choose viewers at installation and select one on the page. Add “Your year in titles” in a collection and choose a viewer and optional year.

Screenshot placeholder: Wrapped page with viewer buttons, two stat tiles, posters, genres and a monthly chart in light and dark themes.

## Limits

The page reads the most recent 200 history entries, so older activity can be omitted. The chart counts completed history entries and does not estimate viewing time. Collections include only titles with an IMDb identifier. A viewer grant is required and can be revoked at any time.

import { plugin, type Manifest } from '../../typescript/src/index.ts';
import manifest from './manifest.json' with { type: 'json' };
import en from './i18n/en.json' with { type: 'json' };
import fr from './i18n/fr.json' with { type: 'json' };

type History = { titleId: string; type: string; watchedAt: string; completed?: boolean };
type Title = { id: string; title: string; type: string; tmdbId?: number; imdbId?: string; year?: number; genres?: string[]; posterPath?: string; summary?: string };
async function yearData(ctx: any, viewer: number, year: number) {
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(viewer) || viewer <= 0 || year < 1900 || year > 9999) return { titles: [], plays: 0, genres: [], months: Array(12).fill(0) };
  const viewers = await ctx.ether.viewers.granted();
  if (!viewers.some((v: any) => v.id === viewer)) return { titles: [], plays: 0, genres: [], months: Array(12).fill(0) };
  const history: History[] = await ctx.ether.viewers.history(viewer, 200, 0);
  const counts = new Map<string, number>();
  const months = Array(12).fill(0);
  for (const entry of history) {
    const date = new Date(entry.watchedAt);
    if (!entry.completed || date.getUTCFullYear() !== year) continue;
    let titleId = entry.titleId;
    if (entry.type === 'episode') { const key = Number(titleId); if (Number.isSafeInteger(key) && key >= 4e15 && key < 5e15) titleId = String(2e15 + Math.floor((key - 4e15) / 1e7)); }
    counts.set(titleId, (counts.get(titleId) || 0) + 1);
    months[date.getUTCMonth()]++;
  }
  const titles: Array<Title & {count: number}> = [];
  for (const [id, count] of counts) {
    try {
      const title = await ctx.ether.catalog.get(id) as Title | null;
      if (title) titles.push({ ...title, count });
    } catch { /* A removed title should not hide the rest of the year. */ }
  }
  titles.sort((a,b) => b.count-a.count || a.title.localeCompare(b.title));
  const genreCounts = new Map<string,number>();
  for (const title of titles) for (const genre of title.genres || []) genreCounts.set(genre, (genreCounts.get(genre) || 0) + title.count);
  const genres = [...genreCounts].sort((a,b) => b[1]-a[1] || a[0].localeCompare(b[0])).slice(0,5);
  return { titles, plays: months.reduce((a,b) => a+b,0), genres, months };
}
export const wrappedDefinition = { manifest: manifest as Manifest, strings: { en, fr }, routes: {
  async view(req, ctx) {
    const viewers = await ctx.ether.viewers.granted();
    const viewer = Number(req.query.viewer || viewers[0]?.id || 0);
    const year = Number(req.query.year || new Date().getUTCFullYear());
    const result = await yearData(ctx, viewer, year);
    const data: Record<string,unknown> = { year: String(year), plays: String(result.plays), titleCount: String(result.titles.length), genres: result.genres.map(([g,n]) => `${g} (${n})`).join(', '), titles: result.titles.map(t => ({ ratingKey:t.id, title:t.title, type:t.type, poster:t.posterPath ? `https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/w300${t.posterPath}` : undefined })), series: [{ key:'plays', label:ctx.t('plays'), values:result.months }], times: result.months.map((_,i) => `${year}-${String(i+1).padStart(2,'0')}-01T00:00:00Z`) };
    const page = Math.max(0, Math.min(Math.ceil(viewers.length / 6) - 1, Number(req.query.viewerPage) || 0));
    const links = viewers.slice(page * 6, page * 6 + 6).map((v,i) => { data[`viewer${i}`] = v.name; data[`active${i}`] = v.id === viewer; return { href:`?viewer=${v.id}&viewerPage=${page}`, label:{$:`viewer${i}`}, activeWhen:{$:`active${i}`} }; });
    data.neverActive = false;
    if (page > 0) links.unshift({href:`?viewerPage=${page-1}`, label:'$t:previous' as any, activeWhen:{$:'neverActive'}});
    if ((page + 1) * 6 < viewers.length) links.push({href:`?viewerPage=${page+1}`, label:'$t:next' as any, activeWhen:{$:'neverActive'}});
    return { spec: { specVersion:1, layout:'list', header:[{kind:'page-header',title:'$t:page',description:'$t:description'}], body:[{kind:'filter-bar',controls:{},leading:{kind:'toggle-links',links}}, {kind:'stat-tile',iconKey:'calendar',accent:'violet',label:'$t:year',value:{$:'year'}},{kind:'stat-tile',iconKey:'play',accent:'teal',label:'$t:plays',value:{$:'plays'}},{kind:'stat-tile',iconKey:'film',accent:'blue',label:'$t:titles',value:{$:'titleCount'}},{kind:'heading',level:2,content:'$t:top_titles'},{kind:'widget',widget:'ether.posterGrid',props:{items:{$:'titles'},empty:'$t:empty'}},{kind:'panel',title:'$t:genres',blocks:[{kind:'text',content:{$:'genres'}}]},{kind:'heading',level:2,content:'$t:activity'},{kind:'widget',widget:'ether.liveChart',props:{series:{$:'series'},times:{$:'times'},label:'$t:plays'}}] }, data };
  },
  async catalog(req,ctx) {
    const viewer = Number(req.extra.viewerId || 0), year = Number(req.extra.year || new Date().getUTCFullYear());
    const data = await yearData(ctx, viewer, year);
    return { metas: data.titles.filter(t => (req.type === 'series' ? t.type === 'show' : t.type === req.type) && t.imdbId).slice(req.skip,req.skip+100).map(t => ({id:t.imdbId!,type:req.type,name:t.title,releaseInfo:String(t.year || ''),description:t.summary})) };
  }
}};
export const wrappedPlugin = plugin(wrappedDefinition);
export const handle = wrappedPlugin.handle;

## Source: sdk/examples/hello/go/README.md

# Hello plugin (Go)

Run the sidecar from the repository root:

```sh
ETHER_PLUGIN_PORT=8080 go run ./sdk/examples/hello/go/cmd
```

For a tunnel, set `ETHER_TUNNEL_URL` and `ETHER_PLUGIN_CREDENTIAL` instead.
Use a credential obtained by pairing with Ether. The HTTP mode defaults to a
random free port when `ETHER_PLUGIN_PORT` is not set.

Run its tests with `go test ./sdk/examples/hello/go`.

func main() {
	ctx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), syscall.SIGINT, syscall.SIGTERM)
	defer stop()
	if err := hello.NewHelloPlugin().Serve(ctx, sdk.ServeOptions{}); err != nil && ctx.Err() == nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
}

## Source: sdk/examples/hello/go/plugin.go#NewHelloPlugin

``````
// NewHelloPlugin constructs the reference Go hello plugin with identical routes
// and payloads to the TypeScript and Python hello plugins.
func NewHelloPlugin() *etherplugin.Plugin {
	return etherplugin.New(etherplugin.Definition{
		Manifest: etherplugin.Manifest{
			ID:          "org.ether.examples.hello",
			Version:     "0.1.0",
			Name:        "Hello plugin",
			Description: "Minimal greeting plugin for Ether.",
			Types:       []string{"movie"},
			IDPrefixes:  []string{"tt"},
			Catalogs: []etherplugin.StremioCatalogDecl{{
				Type:  "movie",
				ID:    "hello",
				Name:  "Hello movies",
				Extra: []etherplugin.StremioExtraField{{Name: "search"}},
			}},
			Resources: []any{"catalog", "meta", "subtitles"},
			Ether: &etherplugin.EtherManifestBlock{
				Protocol: 1,
				Kind:     etherplugin.KindExtension,
				Capabilities: []etherplugin.Capability{
					etherplugin.CapListSource,
					etherplugin.CapSubtitles,
					etherplugin.CapUI,
				},
				Summary:     "Minimal greeting plugin for Ether.",
				Runtime:     etherplugin.RuntimeDecl{Kind: "remote"},
				Permissions: &etherplugin.Permissions{Catalog: "none"},
				Settings: &etherplugin.SettingsSchema{
					Fields: []etherplugin.SettingField{{
						Key:     "greeting",
						Kind:    "text",
						Label:   "Greeting word",
						Hint:    "Word used to greet viewers in the catalog and view",
						Default: "Hello",
					}},
				},
				Contributes: &etherplugin.Contributes{
					ListSources: []etherplugin.ListSourceMeta{{
						Key:     "hello",
						Label:   "Hello movies",
						Hint:    "Sample movie list from the hello plugin",
						Catalog: "hello",
						Refresh: "1h",
					}},
					Subtitles: &etherplugin.SubtitlesMeta{
						Languages: []string{"en"},
						Formats:   []string{"vtt"},
					},
					Pages: []etherplugin.PageMeta{{
						Key:   "home",
						Label: "Hello overview",
						Route: "/ether/view/home",
					}},
				},
			},
		},
		DefaultSettings: map[string]any{"greeting": "Hello"},
		Routes: etherplugin.Routes{
			Test: func(_ *etherplugin.Context) (etherplugin.TestResponse, error) {
				return etherplugin.TestResponse{
					OK:      true,
					Message: "Hello plugin is healthy.",
				}, nil
			},
			Catalog: func(ctx *etherplugin.Context, req etherplugin.CatalogRequest) (etherplugin.CatalogResponse, error) {
				greeting, _ := ctx.Settings["greeting"].(string)
				if greeting == "" {
					greeting = "Hello"
				}
				target := req.Search
				if target == "" {
					target = "from Ether"
				}
				return etherplugin.CatalogResponse{
					Metas: []etherplugin.CatalogItem{{
						ID:          "tt0133093",
						Type:        req.Type,
						Name:        greeting + " " + target,
						ReleaseInfo: "1999",
						Description: "A computer hacker learns about the true nature of reality.",
					}},
				}, nil
			},
			Meta: func(_ *etherplugin.Context, req etherplugin.MetaRequest) (etherplugin.MetaResponse, error) {
				return etherplugin.MetaResponse{
					Meta: etherplugin.MetaItem{
						CatalogItem: etherplugin.CatalogItem{
							ID:          req.ID,
							Type:        req.Type,
							Name:        "The Matrix",
							ReleaseInfo: "1999",
							Description: "A computer hacker learns about the true nature of reality.",
						},
					},
				}, nil
			},
			Subtitles: func(_ *etherplugin.Context, req etherplugin.SubtitlesRequest) (etherplugin.SubtitlesResponse, error) {
				return etherplugin.SubtitlesResponse{
					Subtitles: []etherplugin.SubtitleItem{{
						ID:     req.ID + ":en",
						URL:    fmt.Sprintf("https://subtitles.example.invalid/%s/en.vtt", url.PathEscape(req.ID)),
						Lang:   "en",
						Label:  "English",
						Format: "vtt",
					}},
				}, nil
			},
			View: func(ctx *etherplugin.Context, _ etherplugin.ViewRequest) (etherplugin.ViewResponse, error) {
				greeting, _ := ctx.Settings["greeting"].(string)
				if greeting == "" {
					greeting = "Hello"
				}
				return etherplugin.ViewResponse{
					Spec: etherplugin.ViewSpecDocument{
						SpecVersion: 1,
						Layout:      "list",
						Header: []map[string]any{{
							"kind":        "page-header",
							"title":       map[string]any{"$": "title"},
							"description": map[string]any{"$": "subtitle"},
						}},
						Body: []map[string]any{{
							"kind":  "panel",
							"title": map[string]any{"$": "panelTitle"},
							"blocks": []map[string]any{{
								"kind":    "text",
								"content": map[string]any{"$": "greetingText"},
							}},
						}},
					},
					Data: map[string]any{
						"title":        "Hello plugin",
						"subtitle":     "Greeting view",
						"panelTitle":   "Greeting",
						"greetingText": greeting + " from Ether",
					},
				}, nil
			},
			Action: func(ctx *etherplugin.Context, _ etherplugin.ActionRequest) (etherplugin.ActionResponse, error) {
				greeting, _ := ctx.Settings["greeting"].(string)
				if greeting == "" {
					greeting = "Hello"
				}
				return etherplugin.ActionResponse{
					Toast:   greeting + " from Ether",
					Refresh: true,
				}, nil
			},
			RankKey: func(candidate etherplugin.CandidateFacts, _ map[string]any) int64 {
				if candidate.Cached {
					return 1000
				}
				return 100
			},
			CondMatch: func(candidate etherplugin.CandidateFacts, _ string, value any) bool {
				want := true
				if b, ok := value.(bool); ok {
					want = b
				}
				return candidate.Cached == want
			},
		},
	})
}
``````

## Source: sdk/examples/hello/python/plugin.py

``````
from __future__ import annotations

import os
import sys
import urllib.parse
from typing import Any, Dict

_SDK_DIR = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "..", "..", "python"))
if _SDK_DIR not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, _SDK_DIR)

from ether_plugin import PluginContext, plugin, serve  # noqa: E402

HELLO_MANIFEST: Dict[str, Any] = {
    "id": "org.ether.examples.hello",
    "version": "0.1.0",
    "name": "Hello plugin",
    "description": "Minimal greeting plugin for Ether.",
    "types": ["movie"],
    "idPrefixes": ["tt"],
    "catalogs": [
        {
            "type": "movie",
            "id": "hello",
            "name": "Hello movies",
            "extra": [{"name": "search", "isRequired": False}],
        }
    ],
    "resources": ["catalog", "meta", "subtitles"],
    "ether": {
        "protocol": 1,
        "kind": "extension",
        "capabilities": [
            "list_source",
            "subtitles",
            "ui",
        ],
        "summary": "Minimal greeting plugin for Ether.",
        "runtime": {"kind": "remote"},
        "permissions": {"catalog": "none"},
        "settings": {
            "fields": [
                {
                    "key": "greeting",
                    "kind": "text",
                    "label": "Greeting word",
                    "hint": "Word used to greet viewers in the catalog and view",
                    "default": "Hello",
                }
            ]
        },
        "contributes": {
            "listSources": [
                {
                    "key": "hello",
                    "label": "Hello movies",
                    "hint": "Sample movie list from the hello plugin",
                    "catalog": "hello",
                    "refresh": "1h",
                }
            ],
            "subtitles": {"languages": ["en"], "formats": ["vtt"]},
            "pages": [
                {
                    "key": "home",
                    "label": "Hello overview",
                    "route": "/ether/view/home",
                }
            ],
        },
    },
}


def _catalog(req: Dict[str, Any], ctx: PluginContext) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    greeting = str(ctx.settings.get("greeting") or "Hello")
    target = str(req.get("search") or "from Ether")
    return {
        "metas": [
            {
                "id": "tt0133093",
                "type": req["type"],
                "name": f"{greeting} {target}",
                "releaseInfo": "1999",
                "description": "A computer hacker learns about the true nature of reality.",
            }
        ]
    }


def _meta(req: Dict[str, Any], _ctx: PluginContext) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "meta": {
            "id": req["id"],
            "type": req["type"],
            "name": "The Matrix",
            "releaseInfo": "1999",
            "description": "A computer hacker learns about the true nature of reality.",
        }
    }


def _subtitles(req: Dict[str, Any], _ctx: PluginContext) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    encoded = urllib.parse.quote(req["id"], safe="")
    return {
        "subtitles": [
            {
                "id": f"{req['id']}:en",
                "url": f"https://subtitles.example.invalid/{encoded}/en.vtt",
                "lang": "en",
                "label": "English",
                "format": "vtt",
            }
        ]
    }


def _view(_req: Dict[str, Any], ctx: PluginContext) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    greeting = str(ctx.settings.get("greeting") or "Hello")
    return {
        "spec": {
            "specVersion": 1,
            "layout": "list",
            "header": [
                {
                    "kind": "page-header",
                    "title": {"$": "title"},
                    "description": {"$": "subtitle"},
                }
            ],
            "body": [
                {
                    "kind": "panel",
                    "title": {"$": "panelTitle"},
                    "blocks": [{"kind": "text", "content": {"$": "greetingText"}}],
                }
            ],
        },
        "data": {
            "title": "Hello plugin",
            "subtitle": "Greeting view",
            "panelTitle": "Greeting",
            "greetingText": f"{greeting} from Ether",
        },
    }


def _action(_req: Dict[str, Any], ctx: PluginContext) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    greeting = str(ctx.settings.get("greeting") or "Hello")
    return {"toast": f"{greeting} from Ether", "refresh": True}


hello_plugin = plugin(
    manifest=HELLO_MANIFEST,
    default_settings={"greeting": "Hello"},
    routes={
        "test": lambda _ctx: {"ok": True, "message": "Hello plugin is healthy."},
        "catalog": _catalog,
        "meta": _meta,
        "subtitles": _subtitles,
        "view": _view,
        "action": _action,
        "rank_key": lambda cand, _cfg: 1000 if cand.get("cached") else 100,
        "cond_match": lambda cand, _op, val: bool(cand.get("cached"))
        is (val if isinstance(val, bool) else True),
    },
)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    serve(hello_plugin, background=False)

``````

import { plugin, type Manifest } from "../../../typescript/src/index.ts";

export interface HelloSettings {
  greeting: string;
}

export const helloManifest: Manifest = {
  id: "org.ether.examples.hello",
  version: "0.1.0",
  name: "Hello plugin",
  description: "Minimal greeting plugin for Ether.",
  types: ["movie"],
  idPrefixes: ["tt"],
  catalogs: [
    {
      type: "movie",
      id: "hello",
      name: "Hello movies",
      extra: [{ name: "search", isRequired: false }],
    },
  ],
  resources: ["catalog", "meta", "subtitles"],
  ether: {
    protocol: 1,
    kind: "extension",
    capabilities: ["list_source", "subtitles", "ui", "ranking_step", "rule_condition"],
    summary: "Minimal greeting plugin for Ether.",
    runtime: {
      kind: "hosted",
      entry: "plugin.ts",
    },
    permissions: {
      catalog: "none",
    },
    settings: {
      fields: [
        {
          key: "greeting",
          kind: "text",
          label: "Greeting word",
          hint: "Word used to greet viewers in the catalog and view",
          default: "Hello",
        },
      ],
    },
    contributes: {
      listSources: [
        {
          key: "hello",
          label: "Hello movies",
          hint: "Sample movie list from the hello plugin",
          catalog: "hello",
          refresh: "1h",
        },
      ],
      subtitles: {
        languages: ["en"],
        formats: ["vtt"],
      },
      pages: [
        {
          key: "home",
          label: "Hello overview",
          route: "/ether/view/home",
        },
      ],
      rankingSteps: [
        {
          key: "cached_boost",
          label: "Boost cached releases",
          hint: "Adds a score bonus when a release is cached",
        },
      ],
      ruleConditions: [
        {
          key: "is_cached",
          label: "Release is cached",
          operators: ["eq"],
        },
      ],
    },
  },
};

export const helloPlugin = plugin<HelloSettings>({
  manifest: helloManifest,
  defaultSettings: {
    greeting: "Hello",
  },
  routes: {
    test() {
      return {
        ok: true,
        message: "Hello plugin is healthy.",
      };
    },
    catalog({ type, search }, ctx) {
      const greeting = ctx.settings.greeting || "Hello";
      const target = search || "from Ether";
      return {
        metas: [
          {
            id: "tt0133093",
            type,
            name: `${greeting} ${target}`,
            releaseInfo: "1999",
            description: "A computer hacker learns about the true nature of reality.",
          },
        ],
      };
    },
    meta({ type, id }) {
      return {
        meta: {
          id,
          type,
          name: "The Matrix",
          releaseInfo: "1999",
          description: "A computer hacker learns about the true nature of reality.",
        },
      };
    },
    subtitles({ id }) {
      return {
        subtitles: [
          {
            id: `${id}:en`,
            url: `https://subtitles.example.invalid/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/en.vtt`,
            lang: "en",
            label: "English",
            format: "vtt",
          },
        ],
      };
    },
    view(_req, ctx) {
      const greeting = ctx.settings.greeting || "Hello";
      return {
        spec: {
          specVersion: 1,
          layout: "list",
          header: [
            {
              kind: "page-header",
              title: { $: "title" },
              description: { $: "subtitle" },
            },
          ],
          body: [
            {
              kind: "panel",
              title: { $: "panelTitle" },
              blocks: [
                {
                  kind: "text",
                  content: { $: "greetingText" },
                },
              ],
            },
          ],
        },
        data: {
          title: "Hello plugin",
          subtitle: "Greeting view",
          panelTitle: "Greeting",
          greetingText: `${greeting} from Ether`,
        },
      };
    },
    action(_req, ctx) {
      const greeting = ctx.settings.greeting || "Hello";
      return {
        toast: `${greeting} from Ether`,
        refresh: true,
      };
    },
    rankKey(candidate) {
      return candidate.cached ? 1000 : 100;
    },
    condMatch(candidate, _op, value) {
      const want = typeof value === "boolean" ? value : true;
      return Boolean(candidate.cached) === want;
    },
  },
});

export const handle = helloPlugin.handle;
export const rank_key = helloPlugin.rank_key;
export const cond_match = helloPlugin.cond_match;
export default helloPlugin;

``````

## Source: sdk/examples/hello/typescript/sidecar.ts

``````
import { serve } from "../../../typescript/src/serve.ts";
import { helloPlugin } from "./plugin.ts";

// Hot-path contributions require the hosted runtime. A remote installation
// offers the same HTTP routes but does not advertise those contributions.
if (helloPlugin.manifest.ether) {
  const ether = helloPlugin.manifest.ether;
  ether.runtime = { kind: "remote" };
  ether.capabilities = ether.capabilities?.filter(
    (capability) => capability !== "ranking_step" && capability !== "rule_condition",
  );
  if (ether.contributes) {
    delete ether.contributes.rankingSteps;
    delete ether.contributes.ruleConditions;
  }
}

const server = await serve(helloPlugin);
if (server.mode === "http") {
  console.log(`Hello plugin listening at ${server.url}`);
}

``````

## Source: sdk/examples/home-assistant/README.md

# Home Assistant

Use playback events to call a Home Assistant service, read entity states, or propose a scene from Ask Ether. Ether asks for approval before running the scene tool.

## Setup

Install the package as a remote plugin in Ether. Configure the Home Assistant URL and a long-lived access token in its settings. Enter mappings such as `scene.turn_on scene.movie` for each event you want to handle. Start this script on a machine that can reach Home Assistant with Python 3.9 or later and the bundled Ether Python SDK:

```sh
ETHER_URL=https://ether.example python3 sdk/examples/home-assistant/plugin.py
```

Create a pairing code in the plugin drawer and enter it at the prompt. A fresh code is needed after restarting unless you securely supply a previously obtained tunnel credential through `ETHER_PLUGIN_CREDENTIAL`. Keep both the tunnel credential and Home Assistant token private; use TLS across untrusted networks.

Screenshots to add: plugin settings with playback mappings; Ask Ether approval card for a scene.

## Limits

Home Assistant must be reachable from the sidecar. Each event maps to one service and entity. Delivery is at least once; a service may run more than once after a retry. State results are capped at 100 entities. Home Assistant controls its own service permissions and availability. Ether does not ship a Home Assistant account or token.


## Source: sdk/examples/home-assistant/ether_plugin.py

``````
"""Ether Plugin SDK for Python 3.9+ (stdlib-only, zero external dependencies).

Implements Ether Plugin Protocol v1 (EPP/1) for sidecar and remote plugins:
- Declarative router (`plugin(manifest=..., routes=...)`) with identical route
  semantics to `@ether/plugin-sdk` and `sdk/go`.
- Settings schema decoding, validation, and copy-rule linting (SPEC §5.5).
- Localization helper (`create_i18n`, `t_ref`).
- Remote host client (`RemoteHostClient`) for `/ether/plugin-host/*` authenticated
  with `X-Ether-Plugin-Credential` (SPEC §5.1.5, WS8b).
- HTTP sidecar server (`serve(..., mode="http")`) and WebSocket tunnel client
  (`serve(..., mode="tunnel")`, `dispatch_over_tunnel_frame`).
- Local test harness, mock host client, fixtures, and capability starter templates.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import hashlib
import http.server
import json
import logging
import os
import re
import socket
import socketserver
import ssl
import struct
import threading
import urllib.error
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Callable, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple, Union

TUNNEL_PROTOCOL = "ether-tunnel-v1"
DEFAULT_MAX_CHUNK_BYTES = 64 * 1024

ALLOWED_SETTING_KINDS = frozenset(
    {
        "group",
        "text",
        "secret",
        "duration",
        "readonly",
        "number",
        "bool",
        "select",
        "list",
        "bytes",
        "hidden",
        "multiSelect",
        "orderedList",
        "language",
        "viewer",
        "collection",
        "folder",
        "url",
        "title",
    }
)

_BANNED_COPY_RE = re.compile(r"\b(simply|easily|just)\b", re.IGNORECASE)
_INTERP_RE = re.compile(r"\{([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\}")


class PluginHttpError(Exception):
    """Structured HTTP error raised by a plugin route handler."""

    def __init__(self, status: int, code: str, message: str) -> None:
        super().__init__(message)
        self.status = int(status)
        self.code = str(code)
        self.message = str(message)


PluginRouteError = PluginHttpError


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Copy rules & i18n helpers (SPEC §2.7, §2.8, §5.1.1, §5.6)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def t_ref(key: str) -> str:
    """Returns a `$t:<key>` reference for manifest and ViewSpec fields."""
    return f"$t:{key}"


def lint_copy(raw: str, max_len: int = 0) -> str:
    """Validates a user-visible string against Ether's copy rules."""
    s = raw.strip()
    if max_len > 0 and len(s) > max_len:
        return f"is longer than {max_len} characters"
    if "—" in s or "–" in s:
        return "must not contain em or en dashes"
    if "!" in s:
        return "must not contain exclamation marks"
    if _BANNED_COPY_RE.search(s):
        return "must not use the words simply, just or easily"
    for ch in s:
        if ch.isalpha():
            if ch.islower():
                return "must use sentence case"
            break
    words = [w for w in s.split() if w]
    if len(words) >= 3:
        caps = sum(1 for w in words if w[0].isalpha() and w[0].isupper())
        if caps * 3 > len(words) * 2:
            return "must use sentence case"
    return ""


class I18nHelper:
    """Resolves localized strings with fallback to base language and 'en'."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        strings: Optional[Dict[str, Dict[str, str]]] = None,
        default_locale: str = "en",
    ) -> None:
        self._strings: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]] = strings or {}
        self._default_locale = default_locale or "en"

    def t(
        self,
        raw_key: str,
        params: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
        locale: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> str:
        key = raw_key[3:] if raw_key.startswith("$t:") else raw_key
        loc = locale or self._default_locale
        base = loc.split("-")[0] if loc else ""
        template: Optional[str] = None
        for candidate in (loc, base, "en"):
            if not candidate:
                continue
            table = self._strings.get(candidate)
            if table and key in table:
                template = table[key]
                break
        if template is None:
            template = key
        if not params:
            return template

        def _replace(match: re.Match[str]) -> str:
            name = match.group(1)
            return str(params[name]) if name in params else match.group(0)

        return _INTERP_RE.sub(_replace, template)

    def ref(self, key: str) -> str:
        return t_ref(key)

    def catalog(self) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, str]]:
        return self._strings


def create_i18n(
    strings: Optional[Dict[str, Dict[str, str]]] = None,
    default_locale: str = "en",
) -> I18nHelper:
    return I18nHelper(strings=strings, default_locale=default_locale)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Settings schema decoding and linting (SPEC §5.5)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def collect_setting_fields(schema: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    if not isinstance(schema, dict):
        return []
    out: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []

    def _walk(node: Any) -> None:
        if isinstance(node, list):
            for item in node:
                _walk(item)
            return
        if not isinstance(node, dict):
            return
        key = (
            node.get("key")
            or node.get("name")
            or node.get("id")
            or node.get("field")
            or ""
        )
        kind = node.get("kind", "")
        if isinstance(key, str) and key and isinstance(kind, str) and kind and kind != "group":
            out.append(
                {
                    "key": key,
                    "kind": kind,
                    "label": node.get("label"),
                    "hint": node.get("hint"),
                    "required": node.get("required") is True,
                    "default": node.get("default"),
                    "min": node.get("min"),
                    "max": node.get("max"),
                }
            )
        for v in node.values():
            if isinstance(v, (dict, list)):
                _walk(v)

    _walk(schema)
    return out


def lint_settings_schema(schema: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]) -> List[Dict[str, str]]:
    if not isinstance(schema, dict):
        return []
    problems: List[Dict[str, str]] = []

    def _walk(node: Any, path: str) -> None:
        if isinstance(node, list):
            for idx, item in enumerate(node):
                _walk(item, f"{path}[{idx}]")
            return
        if not isinstance(node, dict):
            return
        kind = node.get("kind")
        if isinstance(kind, str):
            if kind == "json":
                problems.append(
                    {
                        "field": f"{path}.kind",
                        "message": "the json field kind is not allowed in plugin settings",
                    }
                )
            elif kind not in ALLOWED_SETTING_KINDS:
                problems.append(
                    {
                        "field": f"{path}.kind",
                        "message": f'unknown field kind "{kind}"',
                    }
                )
        label = node.get("label")
        if isinstance(label, str) and not label.startswith("$t:"):
            msg = lint_copy(label, 40)
            if msg:
                problems.append({"field": f"{path}.label", "message": msg})
        hint = node.get("hint")
        if isinstance(hint, str) and not hint.startswith("$t:"):
            msg = lint_copy(hint, 120)
            if msg:
                problems.append({"field": f"{path}.hint", "message": msg})
            trimmed = hint.rstrip(".")
            if "." in trimmed:
                problems.append({"field": f"{path}.hint", "message": "must be one sentence"})
        for k, v in node.items():
            if isinstance(v, (dict, list)):
                _walk(v, f"{path}.{k}")

    _walk(schema, "ether.settings")
    return problems


def decode_settings(
    schema: Optional[Dict[str, Any]],
    incoming: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    defaults: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
) -> Tuple[Dict[str, Any], Dict[str, str]]:
    fields = collect_setting_fields(schema)
    result: Dict[str, Any] = dict(defaults or {})
    errors: Dict[str, str] = {}

    for f in fields:
        if f.get("default") is not None and f["key"] not in result:
            result[f["key"]] = f["default"]

    if isinstance(incoming, dict):
        for k, v in incoming.items():
            result[k] = v

    for f in fields:
        key = f["key"]
        kind = f["kind"]
        val = result.get(key)
        ptr = f"/{key}"
        if f.get("required") and (val is None or val == ""):
            errors[ptr] = "is required"
            continue
        if val is None or val == "":
            continue
        if kind in ("number", "bytes", "viewer"):
            if isinstance(val, bool):
                errors[ptr] = "must be a number"
                continue
            try:
                num = float(val) if isinstance(val, str) and "." in val else int(val) if isinstance(val, (int, str)) else float(val)
            except (ValueError, TypeError):
                errors[ptr] = "must be a number"
                continue
            if f.get("min") is not None and num < f["min"]:
                errors[ptr] = f"must be at least {f['min']}"
            if f.get("max") is not None and num > f["max"]:
                errors[ptr] = f"must be at most {f['max']}"
            result[key] = num
        elif kind == "bool":
            if not isinstance(val, bool):
                errors[ptr] = "must be true or false"
        elif kind in ("list", "multiSelect", "orderedList"):
            if not isinstance(val, list):
                errors[ptr] = "must be a list"
        elif kind == "url":
            if not isinstance(val, str) or not (
                val.startswith("http://") or val.startswith("https://")
            ):
                errors[ptr] = "must be an http or https URL"

    return result, errors


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Host client for sidecar plugins (`/ether/plugin-host/*`)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


class _KVClient:
    def __init__(self, call_json: Callable[..., Any]) -> None:
        self._call = call_json

    def get(self, key: str) -> Optional[str]:
        encoded = urllib.parse.quote(key, safe="")
        res = self._call("GET", f"/ether/plugin-host/kv/{encoded}", allow_404=True)
        return res.get("value") if isinstance(res, dict) else None

    def put(self, key: str, value: str) -> None:
        encoded = urllib.parse.quote(key, safe="")
        self._call("PUT", f"/ether/plugin-host/kv/{encoded}", {"value": str(value)})

    def delete(self, key: str) -> None:
        encoded = urllib.parse.quote(key, safe="")
        self._call("DELETE", f"/ether/plugin-host/kv/{encoded}")

    def list(self, prefix: str = "") -> List[str]:
        q = f"?prefix={urllib.parse.quote(prefix, safe='')}" if prefix else ""
        res = self._call("GET", f"/ether/plugin-host/kv{q}")
        return list(res.get("keys", [])) if isinstance(res, dict) else []


class _HttpClient:
    def fetch(self, req: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        method = str(req.get("method") or "GET").upper()
        url = str(req["url"])
        headers = dict(req.get("headers") or {})
        body_str = req.get("body")
        data = body_str.encode("utf-8") if isinstance(body_str, str) else None
        request = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, headers=headers, method=method)
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=15) as resp:
                raw = resp.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
                out_headers = {k.lower(): v for k, v in resp.headers.items()}
                return {"status": resp.status, "headers": out_headers, "body": raw}
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
            raw = exc.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
            out_headers = {k.lower(): v for k, v in exc.headers.items()} if exc.headers else {}
            return {"status": exc.code, "headers": out_headers, "body": raw}


class _CatalogClient:
    def __init__(self, call_json: Callable[..., Any]) -> None:
        self._call = call_json

    def search(self, query: str, limit: int = 50, offset: int = 0) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        qs = urllib.parse.urlencode({"q": query, "limit": str(limit), "offset": str(offset)})
        res = self._call("GET", f"/ether/plugin-host/catalog/search?{qs}")
        return res if isinstance(res, dict) else {"titles": []}

    def get(self, title_id: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
        encoded = urllib.parse.quote(title_id, safe="")
        res = self._call("GET", f"/ether/plugin-host/catalog/{encoded}", allow_404=True)
        return res if isinstance(res, dict) else None


class _ViewersClient:
    def __init__(self, call_json: Callable[..., Any]) -> None:
        self._call = call_json

    def history(self, viewer_id: int, limit: int = 50, offset: int = 0) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        qs = urllib.parse.urlencode({"limit": str(limit), "offset": str(offset)})
        res = self._call("GET", f"/ether/plugin-host/viewers/{int(viewer_id)}/history?{qs}")
        return list(res) if isinstance(res, list) else []

    def set_watch_state(self, viewer_id: int, title_id: str, watched: bool) -> None:
        self._call(
            "POST",
            "/ether/plugin-host/viewers/watch-state",
            {"viewerId": int(viewer_id), "titleId": str(title_id), "watched": bool(watched)},
        )

    setWatchState = set_watch_state


class _CollectionsClient:
    def __init__(self, call_json: Callable[..., Any]) -> None:
        self._call = call_json

    def upsert(self, collection: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        self._call("POST", "/ether/plugin-host/collections/upsert", collection)


class _NotifyClient:
    def __init__(self, call_json: Callable[..., Any]) -> None:
        self._call = call_json

    def owner(self, text: str) -> None:
        self._call("POST", "/ether/plugin-host/notify", {"text": str(text)})


class _FrontendClient:
    def __init__(self, call_json: Callable[..., Any]) -> None:
        self._call = call_json

    def stream_url(self, viewer_id: int, item_ref: str) -> str:
        result = self._call(
            "POST",
            "/ether/plugin-host/frontend/stream-url",
            {"viewerId": int(viewer_id), "itemRef": str(item_ref)},
        )
        return str((result or {}).get("url") or "")


class RemoteHostClient:
    """Host client for remote/sidecar plugins talking to `/ether/plugin-host/*`."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        base_url: Optional[str] = None,
        credential: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> None:
        raw_base = base_url or os.environ.get("ETHER_HOST_URL") or "http://127.0.0.1:32450"
        self.base_url = raw_base.rstrip("/")
        self.credential = (
            credential if credential is not None else os.environ.get("ETHER_PLUGIN_CREDENTIAL", "")
        )
        self.kv = _KVClient(self._call_json)
        self.http = _HttpClient()
        self.catalog = _CatalogClient(self._call_json)
        self.viewers = _ViewersClient(self._call_json)
        self.collections = _CollectionsClient(self._call_json)
        self.notify = _NotifyClient(self._call_json)
        self.kinds = _KindsClient(self._call_json)
        self.cache = self._Cache(self)
        self.frontend = _FrontendClient(self._call_json)

    class _Cache:
        def __init__(self, parent: "RemoteHostClient") -> None:
            self._p = parent

        def _request(self, method: str, path: str, data: Optional[bytes] = None) -> bytes:
            req = urllib.request.Request(
                f"{self._p.base_url}{path}", data=data, method=method,
                headers={"X-Ether-Plugin-Credential": self._p.credential},
            )
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:
                return resp.read()

        def put(self, library_key: str, name: str, data: bytes) -> str:
            q = urllib.parse.urlencode({"name": name})
            raw = self._request("POST", f"/ether/plugin-host/cache/{urllib.parse.quote(library_key)}?{q}", data)
            return str(json.loads(raw or b"{}").get("blob") or "")

        def open(self, blob_ref: str) -> bytes:  # noqa: A002 - mirrors host naming
            return self._request("GET", "/ether/plugin-host/cache/" + str(blob_ref).lstrip("/"))

    def _call_json(
        self,
        method: str,
        path: str,
        body: Optional[Any] = None,
        allow_404: bool = False,
    ) -> Any:
        headers: Dict[str, str] = {
            "X-Ether-Plugin-Credential": self.credential,
            "Accept": "application/json",
        }
        data: Optional[bytes] = None
        if body is not None:
            headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
            data = json.dumps(body).encode("utf-8")
        req = urllib.request.Request(
            f"{self.base_url}{path}",
            data=data,
            headers=headers,
            method=method,
        )
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15) as resp:
                raw = resp.read().decode("utf-8")
                return json.loads(raw) if raw else None
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
            if allow_404 and exc.code == 404:
                return None
            raw = exc.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
            try:
                parsed = json.loads(raw)
                msg = parsed.get("error", {}).get("message")
            except Exception:
                msg = None
            raise RuntimeError(
                msg or f"Host call {method} {path} failed with HTTP {exc.code}"
            ) from exc

    def settings_get(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        result = self._call_json("GET", "/ether/plugin-host/settings")
        return result.get("settings", {})

    def log(
        self,
        level: str,
        message: str,
        attrs: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> None:
        payload: Dict[str, Any] = {"level": str(level), "message": str(message)}
        if attrs is not None:
            payload["attrs"] = attrs
        self._call_json("POST", "/ether/plugin-host/log", payload)

    def abort(self, message: str = "aborted") -> None:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def create_remote_host_client(
    base_url: Optional[str] = None,
    credential: Optional[str] = None,
) -> RemoteHostClient:
    return RemoteHostClient(base_url=base_url, credential=credential)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Plugin context & router
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass
class PluginContext:
    manifest: Dict[str, Any]
    settings: Dict[str, Any]
    locale: str
    pick_token: Optional[str]
    request_id: Optional[str]
    headers: Dict[str, Any]
    query: Dict[str, str]
    ether: Any
    i18n: I18nHelper

    @property
    def pickToken(self) -> Optional[str]:
        return self.pick_token

    @property
    def requestId(self) -> Optional[str]:
        return self.request_id

    def t(self, key: str, params: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> str:
        return self.i18n.t(key, params=params, locale=self.locale)

    def stream_url(self, item_ref: str) -> str:
        """Mint a scoped Ether stream URL for one of this plugin's own kind
        items (spec §6.5). The viewer is the one Ether authenticated on this
        request (X-Ether-Viewer); bytes are served by Ether, not the plugin."""
        if self.ether is None:
            raise RuntimeError("stream url: no host service available")
        raw = _get_header(self.headers, "X-Ether-Viewer")
        try:
            viewer_id = int(str(raw).strip()) if raw is not None else 0
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            viewer_id = 0
        if viewer_id <= 0:
            raise RuntimeError("stream url: no authenticated viewer on this request")
        return self.ether.frontend.stream_url(viewer_id, str(item_ref))


def _get_header(headers: Optional[Dict[str, Any]], name: str) -> Optional[str]:
    if not headers:
        return None
    target = name.lower()
    for k, v in headers.items():
        if k.lower() == target:
            if isinstance(v, list):
                return str(v[0]) if v else None
            if v is not None:
                return str(v)
    return None


def _parse_url_path_and_query(
    raw_path: str,
    raw_query: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
) -> Tuple[str, Dict[str, str]]:
    path_only = raw_path or "/"
    query: Dict[str, str] = {}
    if isinstance(raw_query, dict):
        for k, v in raw_query.items():
            if isinstance(v, list):
                if v:
                    query[str(k)] = str(v[0])
            elif v is not None:
                query[str(k)] = str(v)
    if "?" in path_only:
        path_only, qs = path_only.split("?", 1)
        path_only = path_only or "/"
        for k, vals in urllib.parse.parse_qs(qs, keep_blank_values=True).items():
            if k not in query and vals:
                query[k] = vals[0]
    if not path_only.startswith("/"):
        path_only = "/" + path_only
    return path_only, query


def _parse_json_body(body: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    if body is None or body == "" or body == b"":
        return {}
    if isinstance(body, (bytes, bytearray)):
        body = body.decode("utf-8")
    if isinstance(body, str):
        trimmed = body.strip()
        if not trimmed:
            return {}
        parsed = json.loads(trimmed)
        return parsed if isinstance(parsed, dict) else {}
    if isinstance(body, dict):
        return body
    return {}


def _ok_response(
    body: Any,
    headers: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
    status: int = 200,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    merged = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
    if headers:
        merged.update(headers)
    return {"status": status, "headers": merged, "body": body}


def _error_response(status: int, code: str, message: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "status": status,
        "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
        "body": {"error": {"code": code, "message": message}},
    }


def _match_stremio_route(path: str, query: Dict[str, str]) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    if not path.endswith(".json"):
        return None
    trimmed = path[1:-5]
    parts = trimmed.split("/")
    if len(parts) < 3 or len(parts) > 4:
        return None
    resource = parts[0]
    if resource not in ("catalog", "meta", "stream", "subtitles"):
        return None
    media_type = urllib.parse.unquote(parts[1])
    item_id = urllib.parse.unquote(parts[2])
    extra: Dict[str, str] = {}
    if len(parts) == 4 and parts[3]:
        raw_extra = parts[3]
        for k, vals in urllib.parse.parse_qs(raw_extra, keep_blank_values=True).items():
            if vals:
                extra[k] = vals[0]
    for k, v in query.items():
        if k not in extra:
            extra[k] = v
    return {
        "resource": resource,
        "type": media_type,
        "id": item_id,
        "extra": extra,
    }


class PluginInstance:
    """Runnable Ether plugin instance returned by `plugin(...)`."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        manifest: Dict[str, Any],
        routes: Optional[Dict[str, Callable[..., Any]]] = None,
        default_settings: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
        strings: Optional[Dict[str, Dict[str, str]]] = None,
        default_locale: str = "en",
        host: Optional[Any] = None,
    ) -> None:
        if not isinstance(manifest, dict):
            raise ValueError("Plugin manifest is required.")
        if not manifest.get("id") or not manifest.get("name") or not manifest.get("version"):
            raise ValueError("Plugin manifest requires id, name, and version.")

        self.manifest = manifest
        self.routes: Dict[str, Callable[..., Any]] = dict(routes or {})
        self._default_settings = dict(default_settings or {})
        self._default_locale = default_locale or "en"
        self._host = host
        self._settings_failure_logged = False

        inline_strings: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]] = {}
        ether_block = manifest.get("ether")
        if isinstance(ether_block, dict) and isinstance(ether_block.get("strings"), dict):
            for loc, val in ether_block["strings"].items():
                if isinstance(val, dict):
                    inline_strings[loc] = dict(val)
        if strings:
            for loc, table in strings.items():
                inline_strings.setdefault(loc, {}).update(table)
        self.i18n = create_i18n(inline_strings, self._default_locale)

        self._settings_schema = (
            ether_block.get("settings") if isinstance(ether_block, dict) else None
        )
        self._current_settings, _ = decode_settings(
            self._settings_schema,
            None,
            self._default_settings,
        )

        self._page_routes: Dict[str, str] = {}
        if isinstance(ether_block, dict):
            contributes = ether_block.get("contributes")
            if isinstance(contributes, dict):
                for p in contributes.get("pages") or []:
                    if isinstance(p, dict) and p.get("route") and p.get("key"):
                        self._page_routes[str(p["route"])] = str(p["key"])
                for s in contributes.get("slots") or []:
                    if isinstance(s, dict) and s.get("route") and s.get("key"):
