## Source: sdk/examples/kind-library/src/plugin.ts

``````
// Field Recordings — the content-kind proof example (spec §13).
// Deliberately generic fixture content, not a shipped feature.
//
// One kind, three levels (collection → album → track). Albums are
// containers: each track is one member of the album's zip, so resolve
// returns the container pattern first and a {pageNumber} URL template
// second. Pull sync with /changes, live search, a title matcher, one
// setup step, and a tiny OPDS-ish frontend adapter.
type Request = {
  method: string;
  path: string;
  query?: Record<string, string[] | string>;
  headers?: Record<string, string>;
  body?: unknown;
  settings?: Record<string, unknown>;
};
type Item = Record<string, any>;

function baseUrl(req: Request): string {
  let v = req.settings?.sourceUrl;
  if (v === undefined && typeof ether !== "undefined") {
    try { v = ether.settings.get().sourceUrl; } catch { v = undefined; }
  }
  return (typeof v === "string" && v.trim() ? v.trim().replace(/\/+$/, "") : "https://media.example");
}

function loadItems(req: Request): Item[] {
  const base = baseUrl(req);
  return [
    { id: "coast", level: "collection", title: "Coastal", childCount: 1, leafCount: 2 },
    {
      id: "harbour", level: "album", parentId: "coast", index: 0, title: "Harbour at Dawn",
      year: 2024, childCount: 2, leafCount: 2, fields: { genre: "ambient" },
      hints: { zipUrl: base + "/harbour.zip", zipSize: 4096 }, etag: "a1",
    },
    {
      id: "harbour-1", level: "track", parentId: "harbour", index: 0, title: "Gulls",
      playable: true, fields: { genre: "ambient", durationSec: 61 },
      hints: { member: "01-gulls.flac" }, etag: "t1",
    },
    {
      id: "harbour-2", level: "track", parentId: "harbour", index: 1, title: "Fog Horn",
      playable: true, fields: { genre: "ambient", durationSec: 84 },
      hints: { member: "02-fog-horn.flac", pageUrl: base + "/tracks/{pageNumber}.flac" }, etag: "t2",
    },
  ];
}

function bodyOf(req: Request): any {
  if (typeof req.body === "string") {
    try { return JSON.parse(req.body || "{}"); } catch { return {}; }
  }
  return req.body || {};
}

function pageOf(items: Item[], body: any) {
  const limit = Number(body.limit || 200);
  const off = Number(body.cursor || 0);
  const sorted = [...items].sort((a, b) => (a.index || 0) - (b.index || 0));
  const page: any = { items: sorted.slice(off, off + limit) };
  if (off + limit < sorted.length) page.nextCursor = String(off + limit);
  return { status: 200, body: page };
}

const byId = (items: Item[], id: string) => items.find((i) => i.id === id);

function candidateRef(c: any): string {
  if (c.infoHash) return "infohash:" + String(c.infoHash).toLowerCase();
  if (c.magnet) return "magnet:" + c.magnet;
  if (c.nzbUrl) return "nzb:" + c.nzbUrl;
  return String(c.title || "");
}

export function handle(req: Request) {
  const body = bodyOf(req);
  const items = loadItems(req);
  if (req.path === "/ether/configure") return { status: 200, body: { errors: {} } };
  if (req.path === "/ether/health") return { status: 200, body: { status: "ok", reason: "" } };

  if (req.path === "/ether/v1/setup/account/test") {
    const fields = body.fields || {};
    if (!fields.sourceUrl && !fields.apiKey) {
      return { status: 200, body: { ok: true, detail: "$t:missing_url" } };
    }
    return { status: 200, body: { ok: true, detail: "$t:connected" } };
  }

  if (req.path.startsWith("/ether/v1/frontend/feed")) {
    const entries = items
      .filter((i) => i.playable)
      .map((i) =>
        `<entry><id>${i.id}</id><title>${i.title}</title>` +
        `<link rel="http://opds-spec.org/acquisition" href="/ether/v1/kind-media/${encodeURIComponent(i.id)}" type="audio/flac"/></entry>`)
      .join("");
    return {
      status: 200,
      body: `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><feed xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom"><title>Field Recordings</title>${entries}</feed>`,
    };
  }

  if (req.path === "/ether/v1/kinds/recordings/browse") {
    return pageOf(items.filter((i) => i.level === body.level && (i.parentId || "") === (body.parentId || "")), body);
  }
  if (req.path === "/ether/v1/kinds/recordings/search") {
    const q = String(body.query || "").toLowerCase();
    return pageOf(items.filter((i) => String(i.title).toLowerCase().includes(q)), body);
  }
  if (req.path === "/ether/v1/kinds/recordings/changes") {
    return { status: 200, body: { upserts: items, complete: true } };
  }
  if (req.path.startsWith("/ether/v1/kinds/recordings/items/")) {
    const item = byId(items, decodeURIComponent(req.path.split("/").pop() || ""));
    if (!item) return { status: 404, body: { error: { code: "not_found", message: "Item not found." } } };
    return { status: 200, body: item };
  }
  if (req.path === "/ether/v1/kinds/recordings/resolve") {
    const item = body.item || {};
    const hints = item.hints || {};
    const parent = byId(items, item.parentId || "");
    const sources: any[] = [];
    if (parent && hints.member) {
      sources.push({
        id: "zip", pattern: "container", mime: "audio/flac",
        container: { format: "zip", volumes: [{ url: parent.hints.zipUrl, size: parent.hints.zipSize }], member: hints.member },
      });
    }
    if (hints.pageUrl) sources.push({ id: "direct", pattern: "range", mime: "audio/flac", url: hints.pageUrl });
    return { status: 200, body: { sources } };
  }
  if (req.path === "/ether/v1/kinds/recordings/match") {
    const title = String(body.item?.title || "").toLowerCase();
    const matches = (body.candidates || []).map((c: any) => {
      const hit = String(c.title || "").toLowerCase().includes(title);
      return { candidateRef: candidateRef(c), score: hit ? 0.95 : 0.1, reasons: [hit ? "Title matches" : "Title does not match"] };
    }).sort((a: any, b: any) => b.score - a.score);
    return { status: 200, body: { matches } };
  }
  if (req.path === "/ether/view/library") {
    return {
      status: 200,
      body: {
        title: "$t:page_label",
        spec: {
          specVersion: 1,
          layout: "detail",
          header: [{ kind: "page-header", title: "$t:page_label", description: "$t:summary" }],
          body: [
            { kind: "stat-tile", iconKey: "play", accent: "primary", label: "$t:items_synced", value: { $: "count" } },
          ],
        },
        data: { count: String(items.length) },
      },
    };
  }
  return { status: 404, body: { error: { code: "not_found", message: "Route not found." } } };
}

(globalThis as any).handle = handle;

``````

## Source: sdk/examples/local-folders/README.md

# Local folders

This hosted source scans a folder you grant to the plugin, matches movies and shows against Ether's catalogue, and returns local files as direct releases. Movie folders use `Title (Year)`; shows use `Show/Season 1/S01E02` filenames. Files remain in the selected folder.

## Setup

Run `go run ./cmd/ether plugin check sdk/examples/local-folders` and `go run ./cmd/ether plugin pack -o /tmp/local-folders.etherpkg sdk/examples/local-folders`. Install the package in Server > Plugins, grant a folder and select the same folder in settings. Open the Local folders plugin page and choose Scan folder. Use the title picker on unmatched folders to assign a catalogue title. The scheduled scan repeats hourly. Run offline tests with `node --test sdk/examples/local-folders/tests/plugin.test.ts` and `go test ./sdk/examples`.

Screenshot placeholder: the Local folders page with a scan button and an unmatched folder card containing a title search picker. A second screenshot shows the folder grant and setting in the plugin drawer.

## Limits

Only files under one granted root are indexed. The scanner recognizes MKV, MP4, M4V, AVI, MOV, TS and WebM, and series episodes named with `S01E02`. Automatic matching requires an exact catalogue title and, when present, year. The folder API returns at most 1,000 entries per directory; the scan rejects a directory at that limit, so split large directories. Scans are subject to Ether’s host-call and time budgets; very large trees can exceed them. Scans stop at ten directory levels. Changes are reflected after the next scan, and removing a manual match currently requires removing the plugin's stored data. Ether's existing player support determines which files can be played.

## Source: sdk/examples/local-folders/plugin.ts

``````
import {
  plugin,
  type Manifest,
  type PluginContext,
  type FolderEntry,
  type CatalogTitleSummary,
  type EtherHost,
} from "../../typescript/src/index.ts";
import manifest from "./manifest.json" with { type: "json" };
import en from "./i18n/en.json" with { type: "json" };
import fr from "./i18n/fr.json" with { type: "json" };

type Settings = { folder: string };
type Match = { tmdbId: number; type: string };
type Item = { path: string; season?: number; episode?: number };
const read = <T>(v: unknown): T => v as T;
const parse = (value: string | null, fallback: any) => {
  try {
    return value ? JSON.parse(value) : fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};
const video = /\.(mkv|mp4|m4v|avi|mov|ts|webm)$/i;
function identity(name: string) {
  const clean = name
    .replace(/\.(mkv|mp4|m4v|avi|mov|ts|webm)$/i, "")
    .replace(/[._]/g, " ")
    .trim();
  const year = clean.match(/\((\d{4})\)/);
  return {
    title: (year ? clean.slice(0, year.index) : clean).trim(),
    year: year ? Number(year[1]) : undefined,
  };
}
function scan(ctx: PluginContext<Settings>) {
  const root = ctx.settings.folder;
  if (!root) return;
  const grouped: Record<string, Item[]> = {};
  const pending: { path: string; top: string; depth: number }[] = [
    { path: "", top: "", depth: 0 },
  ];
  while (pending.length) {
    const cur = pending.shift()!;
    const entries = read<FolderEntry[]>(ctx.ether.folders.list(root, cur.path));
    if (entries.length >= 1000)
      throw new Error("Folder has too many entries to scan safely");
    for (const e of entries) {
      if (e.dir && cur.depth < 10)
        pending.push({
          path: e.path,
          top: cur.top || e.name,
          depth: cur.depth + 1,
        });
      else if (!e.dir && video.test(e.name)) {
        read(ctx.ether.folders.stat(root, e.path));
        const top = cur.top || e.name;
        const ep = e.path.match(/s(\d{1,2})e(\d{1,3})/i);
        (grouped[top] ||= []).push({
          path: e.path,
          ...(ep ? { season: Number(ep[1]), episode: Number(ep[2]) } : {}),
        });
      }
    }
  }
  const byId: Record<string, Item[]> = {},
    unmatched: string[] = [];
  for (const top of Object.keys(grouped)) {
    const manual = parse(
      read<string | null>(ctx.ether.kv.get("match:" + root + ":" + top)),
      null,
    ) as Match | null;
    const isSeries = grouped[top].some((i) => i.episode !== undefined);
    const guess = identity(top);
    const found = manual
      ? []
      : read<{ titles: CatalogTitleSummary[] }>(
          ctx.ether.catalog.search(guess.title, 20, 0),
        ).titles || [];
    const candidates = found
      .filter(
        (t) =>
          t.tmdbId &&
          (isSeries
            ? ["show", "series"].includes(t.type)
            : t.type === "movie") &&
          t.title.toLocaleLowerCase() === guess.title.toLocaleLowerCase() &&
          (!guess.year || t.year === guess.year),
      )
      .map((t) => ({ tmdbId: t.tmdbId!, type: isSeries ? "series" : "movie" }));
    const match =
      manual || (candidates.length === 1 ? candidates[0] : undefined);
    if (!match) {
      unmatched.push(top);
      continue;
    }
    const key = `index:${match.type}:${match.tmdbId}`;
    (byId[key] ||= []).push(...grouped[top]);
  }
  const old = read<string[]>(ctx.ether.kv.list("index:"));
  for (const key of Object.keys(byId))
    ctx.ether.kv.put(key, JSON.stringify(byId[key]));
  for (const key of old) if (!byId[key]) ctx.ether.kv.delete(key);
  ctx.ether.kv.put("unmatched", JSON.stringify(unmatched));
  ctx.ether.kv.put("scanned", root);
}
export function createPlugin(host?: EtherHost) {
  return plugin<Settings>({
    manifest: manifest as Manifest,
    host,
    strings: { en, fr },
    defaultSettings: { folder: "" },
    routes: {
      job(_req, ctx) {
        scan(ctx);
        return { ok: true };
      },
      stream(req, ctx) {
        if (
          read<string | null>(ctx.ether.kv.get("scanned")) !==
            ctx.settings.folder ||
          !ctx.settings.folder
        )
          return { streams: [] };
        const parts = req.id.match(/^tmdb:(\d+)(?::(\d+):(\d+))?$/);
        if (!parts) return { streams: [] };
        const items = parse(
          read<string | null>(
            ctx.ether.kv.get(`index:${req.type}:${parts[1]}`),
          ),
          [],
        ) as Item[];
        return {
          streams: items
            .filter(
              (i) =>
                req.type !== "series" ||
                (i.season === Number(parts[2]) &&
                  i.episode === Number(parts[3])),
            )
            .map((i) => ({
              name: "Local",
              title: i.path.split(/[\\/]/).pop(),
              ether: { file: i.path, releaseName: i.path.split(/[\\/]/).pop() },
            })),
        };
      },
      view(_req, ctx) {
        const unmatched = (
          read<string | null>(ctx.ether.kv.get("scanned")) ===
          ctx.settings.folder
            ? parse(read<string | null>(ctx.ether.kv.get("unmatched")), [])
            : []
        ) as string[];
        const body: any[] = [
          {
            kind: "widget",
            widget: "ether.actionButton",
            props: { action: "scan", label: "$t:scan" },
          },
          ...unmatched.map((name, i) => ({
            kind: "panel",
            title: { $: `folder${i}` },
            blocks: [
              {
                kind: "widget",
                widget: "ether.titleMatch",
                props: {
                  action: "match",
                  label: "$t:search",
                  params: { folder: name },
                },
              },
            ],
          })),
        ];
        if (!unmatched.length)
          body.push({
            kind: "text",
            content: ctx.settings.folder
              ? read<string | null>(ctx.ether.kv.get("scanned")) ===
                ctx.settings.folder
                ? "$t:empty"
                : "$t:notScanned"
              : "$t:noFolder",
          });
        return {
          spec: {
            specVersion: 1,
            layout: "list",
            header: [
              {
                kind: "page-header",
                title: "$t:page",
                description: "$t:description",
              },
            ],
            body,
          },
          data: Object.fromEntries(
            unmatched.map((name, i) => [`folder${i}`, name]),
          ),
        };
      },
      action(req, ctx) {
        if (req.action === "scan") {
          if (!ctx.settings.folder) throw new Error(ctx.t("noFolder"));
          scan(ctx);
          return { toast: ctx.t("scanned"), refresh: true };
        }
        const input = req.input as {
          folder?: string;
          tmdbId?: number;
          mediaType?: string;
        };
        const unmatched = parse(
          read<string | null>(ctx.ether.kv.get("unmatched")),
          [],
        ) as string[];
        if (
          req.action !== "match" ||
          !input.folder ||
          !unmatched.includes(input.folder) ||
          !input.tmdbId ||
          !["movie", "show", "series"].includes(input.mediaType || "")
        )
          throw new Error("Invalid match");
        ctx.ether.kv.put(
          "match:" + ctx.settings.folder + ":" + input.folder,
          JSON.stringify({
            tmdbId: input.tmdbId,
            type: input.mediaType === "movie" ? "movie" : "series",
          }),
        );
        scan(ctx);
        return { toast: ctx.t("saved"), refresh: true };
      },
    },
  });
}
export const handle = createPlugin().handle;

``````

``````
function ok(body:any){return {status:200,body};}
function search(query:string,count:number,offset:number=0){
 const found=ether.catalog.search(query,60,0).titles.filter((x:any)=>x.type==='movie');
 const chosen=[];for(let i=0;i<Math.min(count,found.length);i++){const x=found[(offset+i)%found.length];const detail=ether.catalog.get(String(x.id));chosen.push({id:String(x.id),title:detail.title||x.title,year:x.year,summary:detail.summary||'No synopsis available.',genres:(detail.genres||[]).join(', ')});}return {query,total:found.length,movies:chosen};
}
function count(v:any){return Math.max(1,Math.min(5,Math.floor(Number(v)||3)));}
export function handle(req:any){
 if(req.path==='/ether/configure')return ok({errors:{}});
 if(req.path==='/ether/health')return ok({status:'ok'});
 if(req.path==='/ether/tool/pick_movie_night')return ok(search(String(req.body?.query||'star').slice(0,120),count(req.body?.count)));
 if(req.path==='/ether/action/pick'){
  const settings=ether.settings.get(),query=String(settings.query||'star'),n=count(settings.count),offset=Number(ether.kv.get('offset')||0);
  const result=search(query,n,offset);ether.kv.put('shortlist',JSON.stringify(result));ether.kv.put('offset',String(offset+n));return ok({toast:result.movies.length?'Saved '+result.movies.length+' movies for tonight.':'No movie matches. Try another title search in Setup.',refresh:true});
 }
 if(req.path==='/ether/view/tonight'){
 const saved=JSON.parse(ether.kv.get('shortlist')||'{"movies":[]}');
 return ok({title:'Movie Night',spec:{specVersion:1,layout:'detail',header:[{kind:'page-header',title:{$:'title'},description:{$:'subtitle'}}],body:[{kind:'panel',title:'$t:controls',blocks:[{kind:'text',content:'$t:empty'},{kind:'widget',widget:'ether.actionButton',props:{label:'$t:pick',action:'pick'}}]},{kind:'panel',title:'$t:shortlist',blocks:[{kind:'repeat',items:{$:'movies'},itemKey:{$:'id'},blocks:[{kind:'stat-tile',iconKey:'film',accent:'primary',label:{$:'label'},value:{$:'year'}},{kind:'text',content:{$:'summary'}}]}]}]},data:{title:'Movie Night',subtitle:saved.query?'Saved matches for “'+saved.query+'”.  }
 return {status:404,body:{error:{code:'not_found',message:'Route not found.'}}};
}
``````

## Source: sdk/examples/pluto-tv/README.md

# Pluto TV

A hosted Live TV source that reads Pluto TV's public channel lineup and guide and requests an anonymous session when a channel is played. Channel numbers, categories and logos appear in Ether's Live TV guide. Ether ships no channels or account credentials with this example.

## Setup

Run `go run ./cmd/ether plugin check sdk/examples/pluto-tv` and `go run ./cmd/ether plugin pack -o /tmp/pluto.etherpkg sdk/examples/pluto-tv`. Install the package in Server > Plugins, select the region that matches the server's location (or Automatic), and add Pluto TV as a Live TV source. The package is built with the TypeScript SDK. Run the offline tests with `node --test sdk/examples/pluto-tv/tests/plugin.test.ts` and `go test ./sdk/examples`.

Screenshot placeholder: the Live TV grid with channel numbers, category names, logos and a programme detail card. A second screenshot shows the region setting in the plugin drawer.

## Limits

Pluto determines the actual lineup from the server's public IP; the region setting checks the returned region and does not bypass geographic restrictions. Channel refreshes fetch the lineup without timelines first, then load roughly 26 hours of guide data (2 hours back to 24 hours ahead) in 4-hour windows, halving oversized windows down to 1 hour to stay within Ether's 10 MiB per-fetch response limit and keeping the lineup if an individual guide slice fails. The example uses Pluto's public, undocumented endpoints and may break when they change. Availability, advertising, stream formats and rights vary by location. A session is requested at tune time, so playback requires Pluto's service to be reachable. Fixtures are trimmed recordings; the boot fixture has a synthetic session token.


## Source: sdk/examples/pluto-tv/manifest.json

``````
{
  "id": "tv.ether.examples.pluto", "version": "1.0.2", "name": "Pluto TV", "description": "Live channels and guide from Pluto TV.",
  "types": ["tv"], "resources": ["stream"],

    "protocol": 1, "kind": "livetv_source", "capabilities": ["livetv_channels"],
    "summary": "$t:summary", "icon": "assets/icon.svg", "runtime": {"kind":"hosted", "entry":"plugin.ts"},
    "permissions": {"network":["api.pluto.tv","boot.pluto.tv"]},
    "strings": {"en":"i18n/en.json", "fr":"i18n/fr.json"},
    "settings": {"fields":[{"key":"region", "kind":"select", "label":"$t:region", "hint":"$t:regionHint", "default":"auto", "options":[{"value":"auto","label":"$t:auto"},{"value":"us","label":"United States"},{"value":"ca","label":"Canada"},{"value":"gb","label":"United Kingdom"}]}]},
    "contributes": {"channels":{"refresh":"1h","test":true}}
``````

## Source: sdk/examples/pluto-tv/plugin.ts

``````
import {
  plugin,
  type Manifest,
  type HostFetchResponse,
  type PluginContext,
  type EtherHost,
} from "../../typescript/src/index.ts";
import manifest from "./manifest.json" with { type: "json" };

type Settings = { region: string };
type Timeline = {
  _id?: string;
  start: string;
  stop: string;
  title: string;
  episode?: { description?: string };
};
type Programme = {
  id?: string;
  channelId: string;
  title: string;
  start: string;
  stop: string;
  description?: string;
};
type Channel = {
  _id: string;
  name: string;
  number?: number;
  category?: string;
  colorLogoPNG?: { path?: string };
  stitched?: { urls?: { type: string; url: string }[] };
  timelines?: Timeline[];
};

const HOUR_MS = 3600000;
const GUIDE_BACK_MS = 2 * HOUR_MS;
const GUIDE_AHEAD_MS = 24 * HOUR_MS;
const GUIDE_SLICE_MS = 4 * HOUR_MS;
const MIN_GUIDE_SLICE_MS = HOUR_MS;

function fetchJSON(ctx: PluginContext<Settings>, path: string): unknown {
  const region = ctx.settings.region || "auto";
  const sep = path.includes("?") ? "&" : "?";
  const result = ctx.ether.http.fetch({
    url: `https://api.pluto.tv${path}${sep}marketingRegion=${encodeURIComponent(region)}`,
  }) as HostFetchResponse;
  if (result.status !== 200)
    throw new Error(`Pluto TV returned HTTP ${result.status}`);
  return JSON.parse(result.body);
}

function mapTimelines(channelId: string, timelines?: Timeline[]): Programme[] {
  return (timelines || [])
    .filter((t) => t.start && t.stop && t.title)
    .map((t) => ({
      id: t._id,
      channelId,
      title: t.title,
      start: t.start,
      stop: t.stop,
      description: t.episode?.description,
    }));
}

function addTimelines(
  progMap: Map<string, Programme>,
  channelId: string,
  timelines?: Timeline[],
) {
  for (const p of mapTimelines(channelId, timelines)) {
    const key = p.id || `${p.start}\0${p.stop}\0${p.title}`;
    if (!progMap.has(key)) {
      progMap.set(key, p);
    }
  }
}

function compareProgrammeStart(a: Programme, b: Programme): number {
  const ta = Date.parse(a.start);
  const tb = Date.parse(b.start);
  if (!Number.isNaN(ta) && !Number.isNaN(tb) && ta !== tb) return ta - tb;
  return a.start < b.start ? -1 : a.start > b.start ? 1 : 0;
}

function isTooLargeError(err: unknown): boolean {
  const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
  return /response larger than|exceeds size cap|too large/i.test(msg);
}

function getChannels(ctx: PluginContext<Settings>): Channel[] {
  const data = fetchJSON(ctx, "/v2/channels.json");
  if (!Array.isArray(data)) return [];
  const configured = ctx.settings.region || "auto";
  const url = data[0]?.stitched?.urls?.[0]?.url || "";
  const detected = /[?&]marketingRegion=([^&]+)/i.exec(url)?.[1]?.toLowerCase();
  if (configured !== "auto" && detected && configured !== detected)
    throw new Error(
      "Pluto TV returned a different region; check server location",
    );
  return data;
}

function fetchGuideSlice(
  ctx: PluginContext<Settings>,
  fromMs: number,
  toMs: number,
  byChannel: Map<string, Map<string, Programme>>,
) {
  const start = new Date(fromMs).toISOString();
  const stop = new Date(toMs).toISOString();
  const path = `/v2/channels.json?start=${encodeURIComponent(start)}&stop=${encodeURIComponent(stop)}`;
  let data: unknown;
  try {
    data = fetchJSON(ctx, path);
  } catch (err) {
    const code = (err as { code?: string } | null)?.code;
    if (code === "governance" || code === "forbidden" || code === "aborted") {
      throw err;
    }
    if (isTooLargeError(err)) {
      const half = Math.floor((toMs - fromMs) / 2);
      if (half >= MIN_GUIDE_SLICE_MS) {
        fetchGuideSlice(ctx, fromMs, fromMs + half, byChannel);
        fetchGuideSlice(ctx, fromMs + half, toMs, byChannel);
      }
    }
    return;
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(data)) return;
  for (const ch of data as Channel[]) {
    const progMap = ch?._id ? byChannel.get(ch._id) : undefined;
    if (progMap && ch.timelines?.length) {
      addTimelines(progMap, ch._id, ch.timelines);
    }
  }
}

function streamURL(ctx: PluginContext<Settings>, id: string): string {
  const client = "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx".replace(
    /[xy]/g,
    (c) => {
      const r = Math.floor(Math.random() * 16);
      return (c === "x" ? r : (r & 3) | 8).toString(16);
    },
  );
  const params = `appName=web&appVersion=8.0.0&deviceVersion=122.0.0&deviceModel=web&deviceMake=chrome&deviceType=web&clientID=${client}&clientModelNumber=1.0.0&serverSideAds=false&drmCapabilities=widevine%3AL3`;
  const result = ctx.ether.http.fetch({
    url: `https://boot.pluto.tv/v4/start?${params}`,
    headers: { Origin: "https://pluto.tv", Referer: "https://pluto.tv/" },
  }) as HostFetchResponse;
  if (result.status !== 200)
    throw new Error(`Pluto TV session returned HTTP ${result.status}`);
  const boot = JSON.parse(result.body) as {
    sessionToken?: string;
    stitcherParams?: string;
    servers?: { stitcher?: string };
  };
  const base = boot.servers?.stitcher || "";
  if (!boot.sessionToken || !/^https:\/\/[a-z0-9.-]+\.pluto\.tv$/i.test(base))
    throw new Error("Pluto TV session response is invalid");
  return `${base}/v2/stitch/hls/channel/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/master.m3u8?jwt=${encodeURIComponent(boot.sessionToken)}&masterJWTPassthrough=true${boot.stitcherParams ? "&" + boot.stitcherParams : ""}`;
}

export function createPlugin(host?: EtherHost) {
  return plugin<Settings>({
    manifest: manifest as Manifest,
    host,
    defaultSettings: { region: "auto" },
    routes: {
      channels(ctx) {
        const lineup = getChannels(ctx).filter(
          (c) =>
            c._id &&
            c.name &&
            c.category?.toLowerCase() !== "testing" &&
            c.stitched?.urls?.some((u) => u.type === "hls" && u.url),
        );
        const byChannel = new Map<string, Map<string, Programme>>();
        for (const c of lineup) {
          const progMap = new Map<string, Programme>();
          if (c.timelines?.length) {
            addTimelines(progMap, c._id, c.timelines);
            c.timelines = undefined;
          }
          byChannel.set(c._id, progMap);
        }
        if (lineup.length > 0) {
          const now = Date.now();
          const windowStart = now - GUIDE_BACK_MS;
          const windowEnd = now + GUIDE_AHEAD_MS;
          for (
            let from = windowStart;
            from < windowEnd;
            from += GUIDE_SLICE_MS
          ) {
            fetchGuideSlice(
              ctx,
              from,
              Math.min(from + GUIDE_SLICE_MS, windowEnd),
              byChannel,
            );
          }
        }
        return {
          channels: lineup.map((c) => {
            const programmes = Array.from(
              byChannel.get(c._id)?.values() ?? [],
            ).sort(compareProgrammeStart);
            return {
              id: c._id,
              name: c.name,
              number: c.number,
              group: c.category,
              logo: c.colorLogoPNG?.path,
              guideId: c._id,
              inputs: [
                {
                  url: `plugin://tv.ether.examples.pluto/stream/tv/${encodeURIComponent(c._id)}`,
                },
              ],
              ...(programmes.length > 0 ? { programmes } : {}),
            };
          }),
        };
      },
      guide(req, ctx) {
        const query = `?start=${encodeURIComponent(req.from || new Date().toISOString())}&stop=${encodeURIComponent(req.to || new Date(Date.now() + 86400000).toISOString())}`;
        const channel = fetchJSON(
          ctx,
          `/v2/channels/${encodeURIComponent(req.channelId)}${query}`,
        ) as Channel;
        return {
          programmes: mapTimelines(req.channelId, channel.timelines),
        };
      },
      stream(req, ctx) {
        const channel = getChannels(ctx).find((c) => c._id === req.id);
        const url = channel ? streamURL(ctx, channel._id) : undefined;
        return { streams: url ? [{ name: channel!.name, url }] : [] };
      },
      test(ctx) {
        return { ok: getChannels(ctx).length > 0 };
      },
    },
  });
}
export const handle = createPlugin().handle;

``````

## Source: sdk/examples/smart-lights/README.md

# Smart lights (Ether Flows example plugin)

A minimal hosted TypeScript plugin demonstrating Ether Flows integration:

- **Published event (`contributes.events.publish`):** emits `plugin:org.ether.smart-lights/scene.changed` with typed, filterable fields (`room`, `scene`, `brightness`, `previousScene`) via `ether.events.publish(...)`.
- **Canonical event subscription (`contributes.events.subscribe`):** listens to `playback.session.started` and `playback.session.stopped`.
- **Flow action (`contributes.flowActions`):** contributes `plugin:org.ether.smart-lights/set_scene` at `POST /ether/v1/flow-actions/set_scene`, honoring `X-Ether-Idempotency-Key` deduplication and `dryRun`.

## Example Flow

1. **Trigger:** `playback.session.started` (or `plugin:org.ether.smart-lights/scene.changed`)
2. **Action:** `plugin:org.ether.smart-lights/set_scene` with `room: "Living room"`, `scene: "cinema"`, `brightness: 20`
3. **Downstream:** Any subsequent flow subscribed to `plugin:org.ether.smart-lights/scene.changed` receives the validated payload.

## Source: sdk/examples/smart-lights/src/plugin.ts

``````
// Smart lights example plugin for Ether Flows.
//
// Demonstrates:
//   - Subscribing to canonical Ether events (playback.session.started / stopped)
//   - Publishing schema-validated custom events (scene.changed) via ether.events.publish
//   - Contributing an idempotent Flow action (set_scene) that respects X-Ether-Idempotency-Key and dryRun

interface PluginRequest {
  method?: string;
  path: string;
  headers?: Record<string, string>;
  body?: unknown;
}

interface PluginResponse {
  status: number;
  headers?: Record<string, string>;
  body: unknown;
}

interface FlowActionBody {
  flowId?: string;
  runId?: string;
  nodeId?: string;
  idempotencyKey?: string;
  dryRun?: boolean;
  params?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

interface RoomState {
  room: string;
  scene: string;
  brightness: number;
}

interface HostedEther {
  kv: {
    get(key: string): string | null;
    put(key: string, value: string): void;
  };
  settings: {
    get(): Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined;
  };
  events: {
    publish(
      key: string,
      payload?: Record<string, unknown>,
      correlation?: Record<string, unknown>,
    ): void;
  };
}

declare const ether: HostedEther;

const VALID_SCENES: Record<string, boolean> = {
  cinema: true,
  warm: true,
  bright: true,
  off: true,
};

function parseBody(raw: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {
  if (!raw) return {};
  if (typeof raw === "string") {
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      return parsed && typeof parsed === "object" ? (parsed as Record<string, unknown>) : {};
    } catch {
      return {};
    }
  }
  return typeof raw === "object" ? (raw as Record<string, unknown>) : {};
}

function getHeader(headers: Record<string, string> | undefined, name: string): string {
  if (!headers) return "";
  const target = name.toLowerCase();
  for (const key of Object.keys(headers)) {
    if (key.toLowerCase() === target) {
      return String(headers[key] ?? "");
    }
  }
  return "";
}

function readSettings(): { defaultRoom: string; defaultBrightness: number } {
  const s = ether.settings.get() ?? {};
  const room = typeof s.defaultRoom === "string" && s.defaultRoom.trim() ? s.defaultRoom.trim() : "Living room";
  const rawBrightness = Number(s.defaultBrightness);
  const brightness = Number.isFinite(rawBrightness) ? Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round(rawBrightness))) : 25;
  return { defaultRoom: room, defaultBrightness: brightness };
}

function readRoomState(room: string): RoomState {
  const saved = ether.kv.get("room:" + room.toLowerCase());
  if (saved) {
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(saved) as Partial<RoomState>;
      if (parsed && typeof parsed.scene === "string") {
        return {
          room,
          scene: parsed.scene,
          brightness: typeof parsed.brightness === "number" ? parsed.brightness : 100,
        };
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore corrupt KV value and fall back to default.
    }
  }
  return { room, scene: "bright", brightness: 100 };
}

function applyScene(
  room: string,
  scene: string,
  brightness: number,
  dryRun: boolean,
  emitEvent: boolean,
  correlation?: Record<string, unknown>,
): Record<string, unknown> {
  const prev = readRoomState(room);
  const clamped = scene === "off" ? 0 : Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round(brightness)));
  if (!dryRun) {
    ether.kv.put(
      "room:" + room.toLowerCase(),
      JSON.stringify({ room, scene, brightness: clamped }),
    );
    if (emitEvent) {
      ether.events.publish(
        "scene.changed",
        {
          room,
          scene,
          brightness: clamped,
          previousScene: prev.scene,
        },
        correlation,
      );
    }
  }
  return {
    room,
    scene,
    previousScene: prev.scene,
    brightness: clamped,
    applied: !dryRun,
    deduplicated: false,
  };
}

function handleSetScene(req: PluginRequest): PluginResponse {
  const body = parseBody(req.body) as FlowActionBody;
  const params = body.params && typeof body.params === "object" ? body.params : {};
  const defaults = readSettings();

  const room =
    typeof params.room === "string" && params.room.trim()
      ? params.room.trim()
      : defaults.defaultRoom;
  const scene = typeof params.scene === "string" ? params.scene.trim().toLowerCase() : "";
  if (!VALID_SCENES[scene]) {
    return {
      status: 400,
      body: { error: { code: "invalid_scene", message: "Scene must be cinema, warm, bright, or off." } },
    };
  }
  const brightness =
    params.brightness !== undefined && Number.isFinite(Number(params.brightness))
      ? Number(params.brightness)
      : defaults.defaultBrightness;
  const dryRun = Boolean(body.dryRun);
  const idemKey = (getHeader(req.headers, "X-Ether-Idempotency-Key") || String(body.idempotencyKey ?? "")).trim();

  if (!dryRun && idemKey) {
    const cached = ether.kv.get("idem:" + idemKey);
    if (cached) {
      try {
        const prevOutput = JSON.parse(cached) as Record<string, unknown>;
        return {
          status: 200,
          body: { output: { ...prevOutput, deduplicated: true } },
        };
      } catch {
        // Re-execute if cached value cannot be parsed.
      }
    }
  }

  const output = applyScene(room, scene, brightness, dryRun, true, { key: "room:" + room.toLowerCase() });
  if (!dryRun && idemKey) {
    ether.kv.put("idem:" + idemKey, JSON.stringify(output));
  }
  return {
    status: 200,
    body: { output },
  };
}

function handleEventBatch(req: PluginRequest): PluginResponse {
  const body = parseBody(req.body);
  const events = Array.isArray(body.events) ? (body.events as Array<Record<string, unknown>>) : [];
  const defaults = readSettings();
  const ack: string[] = [];

  for (const ev of events) {
    const id = typeof ev.id === "string" ? ev.id : "";
    if (id) ack.push(id);
    const name = typeof ev.name === "string" ? ev.name : "";
    if (name === "playback.session.started") {
      applyScene(defaults.defaultRoom, "cinema", defaults.defaultBrightness, false, true);
    } else if (name === "playback.session.stopped") {
      applyScene(defaults.defaultRoom, "warm", 70, false, true);
    }
  }

  return { status: 200, body: { ack } };
}

function handle(req: PluginRequest): PluginResponse {
  const method = (req.method ?? "GET").toUpperCase();
  if (method === "GET" && req.path === "/ether/health") {
    return { status: 200, body: { status: "ok" } };
  }
  if (method === "POST" && req.path === "/ether/configure") {
    return { status: 200, body: { errors: {} } };
  }
  if (method === "POST" && req.path === "/ether/event") {
    return handleEventBatch(req);
  }
  if (method === "POST" && req.path === "/ether/v1/flow-actions/set_scene") {
    return handleSetScene(req);
  }
  return {
    status: 404,
    body: { error: { code: "not_found", message: "Route not found." } },
  };
}

(globalThis as unknown as { handle: typeof handle }).handle = handle;

``````

## Source: sdk/examples/subdl/README.md

# SubDL subtitles

Searches SubDL by IMDb ID and downloads an SRT only after a viewer selects it. The owner supplies their own SubDL API key; no credentials are included. The plugin connects to `api.subdl.com` for search and `dl.subdl.com` for downloads.

## Setup

Create your own API key in your SubDL account, install the package in Ether, and enter the key in its settings. Enable SubDL under Playback > Audio and subtitles. Select a subtitle in your player to download it.

Screenshots to add: the SubDL integration settings drawer; a subtitle selection in a player.

## Limits

Search requires an IMDb ID. Only single-SRT ZIP archives and the first 30 results are supported; season packs and other formats are skipped at download. SubDL controls availability, rate limits and file contents. Its terms and API limits apply to your account. Third-party subtitles may have their own rights. The bundled fflate 0.8.2 is MIT licensed; see `vendor/LICENSE`.

To rebuild the bundled entry from the repository root, run `go run ./sdk/examples/subdl/build`.

``````
	if len(r.Errors) > 0 {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "bundle failed")
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}
``````

## Source: sdk/examples/subdl/plugin.ts

``````
import { plugin, PluginRouteError } from '../../typescript/src/router.ts';
import { unzipSync, strFromU8 } from './vendor/fflate.js';
import manifest from './manifest.json';
import schema from './settings.schema.json';

const MAX = 2 * 1024 * 1024;
const fail = (message: string): never => { throw new PluginRouteError(502, 'subdl_error', message); };
function readApiKey(ctx: { ether: { secret: { get(name: string): unknown } } }): string {
  try {
    return ((ctx.ether.secret.get('apiKey') as string) || '').trim();
  } catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof Error && /is not saved/i.test(err.message)) return '';
    throw err;
  }
}
function bytes64(s: string): Uint8Array {
  const alphabet = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/';
  if (!/^(?:[A-Za-z0-9+/]{4})*(?:[A-Za-z0-9+/]{2}==|[A-Za-z0-9+/]{3}=)?$/.test(s) || s.length > 4 * Math.ceil(MAX / 3)) return fail('Invalid subtitle archive.');
  const out: number[] = []; let bits = 0, value = 0;
  for (const c of s.replace(/=+$/, '')) { value = (value << 6) | alphabet.indexOf(c); bits += 6; if (bits >= 8) { bits -= 8; out.push((value >> bits) & 255); } }
  return new Uint8Array(out);
}
function archive(data: string): string {
  const bytes = bytes64(data);
  // Validate the central directory and its declared sizes before inflating.
  let end = -1;
  for (let i = bytes.length - 22; i >= Math.max(0, bytes.length - 65557); i--) if (bytes[i]===80 && bytes[i+1]===75 && bytes[i+2]===5 && bytes[i+3]===6) { end=i; break; }
  if (end < 0) return fail('Invalid subtitle archive.');
  const view = new DataView(bytes.buffer); const count=view.getUint16(end+10,true); let offset=view.getUint32(end+16,true); let total=0;
  if (!count || count > 100 || offset >= end || view.getUint16(end+8,true)!==count || view.getUint16(end+4,true)!==0 || view.getUint16(end+6,true)!==0 || end+22+view.getUint16(end+20,true)!==bytes.length) return fail('Invalid subtitle archive.');
  for (let i=0;i<count;i++) {
    if (offset+46>end || view.getUint32(offset,true)!==0x02014b50) return fail('Invalid subtitle archive.');
    const size=view.getUint32(offset+24,true); total+=size;
    if (total>MAX || (view.getUint16(offset+8,true)&1)) return fail('Subtitle archive is too large or encrypted.');
    offset+=46+view.getUint16(offset+28,true)+view.getUint16(offset+30,true)+view.getUint16(offset+32,true);
  }
  if (offset>end) return fail('Invalid subtitle archive.');
  try {
    const files=unzipSync(bytes); const names=Object.keys(files).filter(n=>/\.srt$/i.test(n) && !n.startsWith('__MACOSX/')).sort();
    if (names.length!==1 || files[names[0]].length>MAX) return fail('The archive must contain one SRT subtitle.');
    return strFromU8(files[names[0]]);
  } catch { return fail('Could not read the subtitle archive.'); }
}
const settingsManifest = {...manifest, ether:{...manifest.ether, settings:schema}} as any;
export const subdl = plugin<{apiKey:string}>({manifest:settingsManifest, routes:{
  subtitles(req, ctx) {
    const id = req.id.split(':');
    const apiKey = readApiKey(ctx);
    if (!/^tt\d+$/.test(id[0]) || !apiKey) return {subtitles:[]};
    let url='https://api.subdl.com/api/v1/subtitles?api_key='+encodeURIComponent(apiKey)+'&imdb_id='+encodeURIComponent(id[0])+'&subs_per_page=30&client=custom_integration';
    if (req.type==='series' && /^\d+$/.test(id[1] || '') && /^\d+$/.test(id[2] || '')) url+='&type=tv&season_number='+id[1]+'&episode_number='+id[2];
    const response=ctx.ether.http.fetch({url}) as any;
    if (response.status!==200) return fail('Subtitle search failed.');
    const body=JSON.parse(response.body); if (!body.status || !Array.isArray(body.subtitles)) return fail('Subtitle search failed.');
    return {subtitles:body.subtitles.slice(0,30).filter((s:any)=>/^\/subtitle\/[0-9]+-[0-9]+\.zip$/.test(s.url || '') && /^[a-z]{2,3}$/i.test(s.language || s.lang || '')).map((s:any)=>({id:s.url,lang:(s.language || s.lang).toLowerCase(),format:'srt',name:String(s.release_name || s.name || 'SubDL').slice(0,200)}))};
  },
  subtitlesDownload(req,ctx) {
    if (!/^\/subtitle\/[0-9]+-[0-9]+\.zip$/.test(req.id) || req.format !== 'srt') return fail('Invalid subtitle selection.');
    const apiKey = readApiKey(ctx);
    if (!apiKey) return fail('Enter an API key.');
    const response=ctx.ether.http.fetch({url:'https://dl.subdl.com'+req.id,headers:{'x-api-key':apiKey}}) as any;
    if (response.status!==200 || !response.bodyBase64) return fail('Subtitle download failed.');
    return {format:'srt',encoding:'utf8',data:archive(response.bodyBase64)};
  },
  test(ctx) { const key = readApiKey(ctx); return {ok:!!key, message:key ? 'API key saved.' : 'Enter an API key.'}; }
}});
export const handle = subdl.handle;

``````

# Travel Mode

A native ranking step with a 1, 2, 4 or 8 GB target. Add it near the top of a quality profile’s ranking order; the default target is 4 GB. Its scorecard uses the same rank_key function with example releases. It favours cached, device-compatible files at 1080p or below, within the selected size target.

## Use

Created and verified through Studio in the 0.3.3 lab. These examples do not auto-install or change server configuration on upgrade.

From the repository root:

```sh
go run ./cmd/ether plugin check sdk/examples/travel-mode
go run ./cmd/ether plugin pack -o /tmp/travel-mode.etherpkg sdk/examples/travel-mode
```

Install the package in Server → Plugins, or copy these three files into a Studio draft. Review permissions and configure the installed plugin in Setup. The source and English strings are editable in Studio.

## Source: sdk/examples/travel-mode/src/plugin.ts

``````
export function rank_key(c:any,cfg:any={}):number{
 const ceiling=Math.max(480,Math.min(2160,Number(cfg.maxHeight)||1080));
 const budget=Math.max(1,Number(cfg.value??cfg.maxGB)||4)*1073741824;
 const height=parseInt(String(c.resolution||'0').replace(/[^0-9]/g,''),10)||0;
 const clientMax=Number(c.clientCaps?.maxHeight)||ceiling;
 let score=c.cached?300:0;
 if(height>Math.min(ceiling,clientMax))score-=10000;else if(height>0)score+=Math.min(height,1080);
 if(c.size>budget)score-=2000+Math.min(10000,Math.floor((c.size-budget)/1073741824)*100);else if(c.size>0)score+=Math.max(0,500-Math.floor(c.size/1073741824)*100);
 const codec=String(c.videoCodec||'').toLowerCase();const supports=(c.clientCaps?.codecs||[]).map((x:string)=>x.toLowerCase());
 if(codec&&supports.length&&!supports.includes(codec))score-=20000;
 if((c.languages||[]).some((x:string)=>x.toLowerCase()===(cfg.language||'en').toLowerCase()))score+=100;
 return Math.round(score);
}
const SAMPLES=[{name:'1080p cached · 2 GB',resolution:'1080p',size:2*1073741824,cached:true,languages:['en'],videoCodec:'h264'},{name:'720p cached · 1 GB',resolution:'720p',size:1073741824,cached:true,languages:['en'],videoCodec:'h264'},{name:'4K remux · 55 GB',resolution:'2160p',size:55*1073741824,cached:true,languages:['en'],videoCodec:'hevc'}];
export function handle(req:any){
 if(req.path==='/ether/configure')return {status:200,body:{errors:{}}};
 if(req.path==='/ether/health')return {status:200,body:{status:'ok'}};
 if(req.path==='/ether/view/scorecard')return {status:200,body:{title:'Travel Mode',spec:{specVersion:1,layout:'detail',header:[{kind:'page-header',title:{$:'title'},description:{$:'subtitle'}}],body:[{kind:'panel',title:'$t:samples',blocks:[{kind:'text',content:'$t:sample_hint'},{kind:'repeat',items:{$:'scores'},itemKey:{$:'name'},blocks:[{kind:'stat-tile',iconKey:'gauge',accent:'primary',label:{$:'name'},value:{$:'score'}}]}]}]},data:{title:'Travel Mode',subtitle:'Adds a ranking step in Quality with a selectable file-size target. Defaults: 1080p, 4 GB and English audio. This scorecard shows the default settings.',scores:SAMPLES.map(c=>({name:c.name,score:String(rank_key(c))}))}}};
 return {status:404,body:{error:{code:'not_found',message:'Route not found.'}}};
}
(globalThis as any).handle=handle;(globalThis as any).rank_key=rank_key;
``````

## Source: sdk/examples/tvmaze/README.md

# TVmaze Native Catalog

Independent TVmaze show metadata, an acclaimed-series list and a Canadian-airing list. The page publishes a 30-show collection by default. Data is attributed to TVmaze under CC BY-SA; Ether matches external IDs to its canonical catalogue.

## Use

Created and verified through Studio in the 0.3.3 lab. These examples do not auto-install or change server configuration on upgrade.

From the repository root:

```sh
go run ./cmd/ether plugin check sdk/examples/tvmaze
go run ./cmd/ether plugin pack -o /tmp/tvmaze.etherpkg sdk/examples/tvmaze
```

Install the package in Server → Plugins, or copy these three files into a Studio draft. Review permissions and configure the installed plugin in Setup. The source and English strings are editable in Studio.

``````
const API='https://api.tvmaze.com';
function ok(body:any){return {status:200,body};}
function fetchJSON(path:string){const r=ether.http.fetch({url:API+path});if(r.status!==200)throw new Error('TVmaze returned HTTP '+r.status);return typeof r.body==='string'?JSON.parse(r.body):r.body;}
function remember(s:any){ether.kv.put('show:'+s.id,JSON.stringify({at:Date.now(),show:s}));return s;}
function shows(kind:string){let stage='settings';try{
 const max=Math.max(10,Math.min(100,Number(ether.settings.get().maxItems||30)));
 stage='date';const date=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10), key='list:'+kind+':'+(kind==='canada'?date:max);
 stage='cache';const raw=ether.kv.get(key);if(raw){const v=JSON.parse(raw);if(Date.now()-v.at<3600000)return v.shows;}
 stage='fetch';let list:any[];
 if(kind==='canada') {const seen:any={};list=fetchJSON('/schedule?country=CA&date='+date).map((x:any)=>x.show).filter((s:any)=>s&&!seen[s.id]&&(seen[s.id]=true));}
 else {const fetched=fetchJSON('/shows?page=0');if(!Array.isArray(fetched))throw new Error('Expected array: '+JSON.stringify(fetched).slice(0,140));stage='filter';list=fetched.filter((s:any)=>s.externals?.imdb&&(s.rating?.average||0)>=7.5).sort((a:any,b:any)=>(b.rating?.average||0)-(a.rating?.average||0));}
 stage='remember';list=list.slice(0,max).map(remember);ether.kv.put(key,JSON.stringify({at:Date.now(),shows:list}));return list;
}catch(e){throw new Error(stage+': '+e.message);}
}
function resolve(id:string){if(!/^tvmaze:[0-9]+$/.test(id))throw new Error('Expected a TVmaze show identity');const n=id.slice(7),raw=ether.kv.get('show:'+n);if(raw){const c=JSON.parse(raw);if(Date.now()-c.at<86400000)return c.show;}return remember(fetchJSON('/shows/'+n));}
export function handle(req:any){
 if(req.path==='/ether/configure'){const n=Number(req.body?.maxItems??30);return ok({errors:Number.isInteger(n)&&n>=10&&n<=100?{}:{maxItems:'Choose a whole number from 10 to 100.'}});}
 if(req.path==='/ether/health')return ok({status:'ok'});
 if(req.path==='/ether/test'){const s=fetchJSON('/shows/1');return ok({ok:!!s.id,message:'TVmaze public API connected: '+s.name});}
 if(req.path.startsWith('/catalog/')){const list=shows(req.path.includes('/canada')?'canada':'acclaimed');return ok({metas:list.map((s:any)=>({id:'tvmaze:'+s.id,type:'series',name:s.name,poster:s.image?.medium,description:(s.summary||'').replace(/<[^>]*>/g,''),year:Number((s.premiered||'').slice(0,4)),imdb_id:s.externals?.imdb,tvdb_id:s.externals?.thetvdb}))});}

 if(req.path==='/ether/action/publish'){ether.collections.upsert({id:'tvmaze-acclaimed',name:'TVmaze acclaimed series',description:'A TVmaze-powered shelf. Show data: TVmaze, CC BY-SA. https://www.tvmaze.com',mediaType:'show',sources:[{kind:'plugin:community.tvmaze.catalog/acclaimed',maxItems:Number(ether.settings.get().maxItems||30)}],match:'all',rules:[],exclude:[],sort:'source',limit:100,refresh:'daily',enabled:true,targets:{collectionsTab:true,homeRow:true,users:'all'}});return ok({toast:'TVmaze acclaimed series published.',refresh:true});}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/README.md

# `etherplugin` (Go SDK)

Go authoring package (`github.com/braedonsaunders/ether/sdk/go`) for Ether Plugin Protocol v1 (EPP/1).

## Execution modes

1. **Native HTTP or WebSocket tunnel sidecar (`ether.runtime.kind: "remote"`)**:
   Compile a standard Go binary and call `p.Serve(ctx, etherplugin.ServeOptions{})` (or mount `p` as an `http.Handler`). Host calls go over HTTP to `/ether/plugin-host/*` authenticated with `X-Ether-Plugin-Credential`.
2. **Hosted WebAssembly guest**: not yet supported. Go 1.27.3 `GOOS=wasip1 GOARCH=wasm` emits `wasi_snapshot_preview1` imports (including `proc_exit`, `clock_time_get`, and `fd_write`), which the runtime forbids. TinyGo is not installed here, so a compatible TinyGo build has not been verified. Use a sidecar until a guest is built and tested against Ether's raw WASM ABI.

## Usage

```go
package main

import (
	"context"
	"os/signal"
	"syscall"

	etherplugin "github.com/braedonsaunders/ether/sdk/go"
)

func main() {
	p := etherplugin.New(etherplugin.Definition{
		Manifest: etherplugin.Manifest{
			ID:      "org.ether.examples.hello",
			Name:    "Hello plugin",
			Version: "0.1.0",
			Ether: &etherplugin.EtherManifestBlock{
				Protocol:     1,
				Kind:         etherplugin.KindExtension,
				Capabilities: []etherplugin.Capability{etherplugin.CapListSource, etherplugin.CapUI},
				Summary:      "Minimal greeting plugin for Ether.",
				Runtime:      etherplugin.RuntimeDecl{Kind: "remote"},
			},
		},
		Routes: etherplugin.Routes{
			Catalog: func(ctx *etherplugin.Context, req etherplugin.CatalogRequest) (etherplugin.CatalogResponse, error) {
				return etherplugin.CatalogResponse{
					Metas: []etherplugin.CatalogItem{{
						ID:          "tt0133093",
						Type:        req.Type,
						Name:        "Hello from " + req.ID,
						ReleaseInfo: "1999",
					}},
				}, nil
			},
		},
	})

	ctx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), syscall.SIGINT, syscall.SIGTERM)
	defer stop()
	_ = p.Serve(ctx, etherplugin.ServeOptions{})
}
```

## Flows: events and actions

Declare `CapEvents` with `Contributes.Events.Publish` to emit schema-validated custom events to Ether Flows via `ctx.PublishEvent(key, payload, correlation)` (remote `POST /ether/plugin-host/events/publish`, rate-limited to 30/min). Declare `CapFlowActions` with `Contributes.FlowActions` and implement `Routes.FlowAction` to handle `POST /ether/v1/flow-actions/{key}` (or a custom declared `/ether/...` route); `FlowActionRequest.IdempotencyKey` carries `X-Ether-Idempotency-Key` for safe deduplication and `FlowActionRequest.DryRun` indicates a test/dry run.

## WS8b interoperability test

Once `internal/plugins/remote` is present, run
`go test -tags ws8b ./sdk/examples/hello/go -run TestWS8bSDKInterop`.
It starts Ether's tunnel server and exercises the Go, Python, and TypeScript
hello sidecars. It requires Python 3 and a Node version with TypeScript support
and WebSocket. The Go SDK reconnects automatically after a dropped tunnel.

## Tunnel recovery

`Start(ctx, ServeOptions{Mode: "tunnel", ...})` returns after the initial
credential authentication and hello/welcome handshake; initial failures are
returned to the caller. After that, dropped connections retry serially with
jittered exponential backoff (50–100 ms initially, capped at 5–10 seconds).
Every attempt re-authenticates and repeats the handshake, with a 10-second
connection/handshake timeout. A connection stable for a minute resets backoff.

In-flight calls fail on disconnect and are not replayed. Ether runtimes resolve
the current connection for subsequent calls. `handle.Done` stays open during
recovery; cancelling `ctx` or calling `handle.Close()` stops active I/O and any
retry, closes the socket, and closes `Done`. `Close` is safe to call repeatedly.
Request cancellation stops that handler without closing the shared tunnel.

## Sidecars

A sidecar is a remote plugin whose program runs on a machine you choose and
dials out to Ether over the `ether-tunnel-v1` WebSocket. It needs no inbound
port. Use one when the program must reach a local network, a USB device, or an
installed tool that Ether's sandbox cannot.

Set `ETHER_URL` and pair once:

```sh
ETHER_URL=https://ether.example.com \
ETHER_PLUGIN_STATE_DIR=/data \
ETHER_PAIRING_CODE=PAIR-1234 \
./my-sidecar
```

The SDK exchanges the code once, saves the credential, and derives the tunnel
URL from `ETHER_URL`. Create the code in Ether under Plugins › your plugin ›
Connect a sidecar; it is valid for 5 minutes and single use. On later restarts
the saved credential is reused, so no new code is needed.

- `ETHER_URL` — the server's `http(s)` base. The pair URL and the `ws(s)` tunnel
  URL are derived from it.
- `ETHER_PLUGIN_CREDENTIAL` — an explicit credential; always wins.
- `ETHER_PLUGIN_STATE_DIR` — where the credential is saved, else `/data` when it
  exists and is writable (a Docker volume), else the OS user config directory
  `…/ether-plugins/<plugin id>/`.
- `ETHER_PAIRING_CODE` — a one-time code.

The credential is saved at `<state dir>/credential` (mode `0600`, directory
`0700`) as JSON with the Ether URL it belongs to. If the tunnel rejects a saved
credential, the file is deleted and startup fails with one line instead of
reconnecting forever.

A Dockerfile that keeps the credential across restarts:

```dockerfile
FROM golang:1.27 AS build
WORKDIR /src
COPY . .
RUN go build -o /out/sidecar ./cmd/sidecar

FROM gcr.io/distroless/static
COPY --from=build /out/sidecar /sidecar
VOLUME /data
ENV ETHER_PLUGIN_STATE_DIR=/data
ENTRYPOINT ["/sidecar"]
```

Declare how the console runs it with an `ether.sidecar` manifest block:

```json
"ether": {
  "runtime": { "kind": "remote" },
  "sidecar": {
    "docker": "ghcr.io/you/my-sidecar:1.0.0",
    "docs": "https://example.com/my-sidecar"
  }
}
```

`docker` is an image reference; `download` (an https URL) with `command` (a
single line) is the alternative; `docs` adds a setup link. With a Docker image
the console shows a ready `docker run` command, mounting `-v ether-<id>:/data`
so the saved credential survives a restart.

## Source: sdk/go/data_host.go#checkDataRange

``````
func checkDataRange(r DataRange) error {
	if r.Offset < 0 || r.Offset > 1<<60 || r.Length <= 0 || r.Length > MaxDataReadBytes {
		return fmt.Errorf("data range needs nonnegative offset and length 1..%d", MaxDataReadBytes)
	}
	return nil
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/data_host.go#*RemoteHostClient.CacheRead

``````
	}

}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/data_host.go#*RemoteHostClient.ArchiveOpen

``````
// ArchiveOpen reads a bounded uncompressed ZIP, 7z or RAR member range.
// Compressed reads restart at the member or solid block beginning per call.
// Prefer large sequential chunks; decoder work and memory obey host grants.
func (c *RemoteHostClient) ArchiveOpen(ctx context.Context, blob string, member int, r DataRange) ([]byte, error) {
	if err := checkDataRange(r); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return c.dataRead(ctx, "archive.open", []any{blob, member, r})
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/data_host.go#*RemoteHostClient.ArchiveRead

``````
// ArchiveRead reads 1..4096 bounded archive member ranges in one host call
// while keeping the sum of requested lengths within the plugin's readBytes grant.
func (c *RemoteHostClient) ArchiveRead(ctx context.Context, blob string, reads []ArchiveReadItem) ([]ArchiveReadResult, error) {
	if len(reads) == 0 || len(reads) > MaxArchiveReadItems {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("archive.read takes 1..%d reads", MaxArchiveReadItems)
	}
	var total int64
	for _, item := range reads {
		if item.Member < 0 {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("archive.read member index must be nonnegative")
		}
		if err := checkDataRange(DataRange{Offset: item.Offset, Length: item.Length}); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if item.Length > MaxDataReadBytes-total {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("archive.read requested bytes exceed maximum readBytes ceiling (%d)", MaxDataReadBytes)
		}
		total += item.Length
	}
	var wire []struct {
		Index      int    `json:"index"`
		Member     int    `json:"member"`
		Size       int    `json:"size"`
		BodyBase64 string `json:"bodyBase64"`
	}
	if err := c.dataCall(ctx, "archive.read", []any{blob, reads}, &wire); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	out := make([]ArchiveReadResult, len(wire))
	for i, w := range wire {
		body, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(w.BodyBase64)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		out[i] = ArchiveReadResult{Index: w.Index, Member: w.Member, Size: w.Size, Body: body}
	}
	return out, nil
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/data_host.go#*RemoteHostClient.CacheRasterize

``````
// CacheRasterize rasterises an SVG already in the plugin's blob cache into
// a new cached bitmap blob under libraryKey/name, using Ether's bounded SVG
// rasteriser (source and output sizes are host-bounded, unsafe documents
// are refused, and rendered variants are cached host-side).
func (c *RemoteHostClient) CacheRasterize(ctx context.Context, libraryKey, name, blob string, opts RasterizeOptions) (RasterizeResult, error) {
	if opts.Width < 0 || opts.Width > 2048 || opts.Height < 0 || opts.Height > 2048 {
		return RasterizeResult{}, fmt.Errorf("cache.rasterize width and height must be within 0..2048")
	}
	if opts.Format != "" && opts.Format != "png" && opts.Format != "jpeg" {
		return RasterizeResult{}, fmt.Errorf("cache.rasterize format must be png or jpeg")
	}
	args := []any{libraryKey, name, blob}
	if opts != (RasterizeOptions{}) {
		args = append(args, opts)
	}
	var out RasterizeResult
	err := c.dataCall(ctx, "cache.rasterize", args, &out)
	return out, err
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/data_host.go#*RemoteHostClient.ArchiveExtract

``````
// ArchiveExtract streams an uncompressed ZIP, 7z or RAR member straight into
// the plugin's own library blob cache in one pass and returns its blob ref and
// SHA-1/MD5/CRC32 digests without buffering the member in plugin memory.
func (c *RemoteHostClient) ArchiveExtract(ctx context.Context, blob string, member int, opts ...ArchiveExtractOptions) (ArchiveExtractResult, error) {
	args := []any{blob, member}

		args = append(args, opts[0])
	}
	var out ArchiveExtractResult
	err := c.dataCall(ctx, "archive.extract", args, &out)
	return out, err
}
``````

``````
// Host provides access to Ether host services (KV, secrets, HTTP, catalog,

type Host interface {

	// frontend adapter response (spec §6.5). viewerID is the viewer the
	// adapter authenticated.
``````

## Source: sdk/go/host.go#WithViewerToken

``````
// WithViewerToken attaches the host-minted X-Ether-Viewer-Token from an
// incoming frontend adapter request onto ctx so KindVisible and KindBrowse
// authenticate as that request's viewer without passing a viewer ID (#615).
func WithViewerToken(ctx context.Context, token string) context.Context {
	token = strings.TrimSpace(token)
	if token == "" {
		return ctx
	}
	return context.WithValue(ctx, viewerTokenContextKey{}, token)
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/host.go#ViewerTokenFromContext

``````
// ViewerTokenFromContext returns the adapter viewer token attached by
// WithViewerToken (or automatically during FrontendAdapter dispatch).
func ViewerTokenFromContext(ctx context.Context) (string, bool) {
	if ctx == nil {
		return "", false
	}
	tok, ok := ctx.Value(viewerTokenContextKey{}).(string)
	return tok, ok && tok != ""
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/host.go#NewRemoteHostClient

``````
// NewRemoteHostClient creates a RemoteHostClient.
func NewRemoteHostClient(opts RemoteHostOptions) *RemoteHostClient {
	base := opts.BaseURL
	if base == "" {
		base = os.Getenv("ETHER_HOST_URL")
	}
	if base == "" {
		base = "http://127.0.0.1:32450"
	}
	base = strings.TrimRight(base, "/")

	cred := opts.Credential
	if cred == "" {
		cred = os.Getenv("ETHER_PLUGIN_CREDENTIAL")
	}

	hc := opts.HTTPClient
	if hc == nil {
		hc = http.DefaultClient
	}
	return &RemoteHostClient{
		baseURL:    base,
		credential: cred,
		client:     hc,
	}
}
``````

``````
func (c *RemoteHostClient) callJSON(
	ctx context.Context,
	method, path string,
	in any,
	out any,

}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/host.go#*RemoteHostClient.callJSONWithHeaders

``````
func (c *RemoteHostClient) callJSONWithHeaders(
	ctx context.Context,
	method, path string,
	extraHeaders map[string]string,
	in any,
	out any,
	allow404 bool,
) (bool, error) {
	var bodyReader io.Reader
	if in != nil {
		b, err := json.Marshal(in)
		if err != nil {
			return false, err
		}
		bodyReader = bytes.NewReader(b)
	}
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, method, c.baseURL+path, bodyReader)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	req.Header.Set("X-Ether-Plugin-Credential", c.credential)
	req.Header.Set("Accept", "application/json")
	if in != nil {
		req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	}
	for k, v := range extraHeaders {
		if v != "" {
			req.Header.Set(k, v)
		}
	}
	resp, err := c.client.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close() //nolint:errcheck

	raw, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(resp.Body, (MaxDataReadBytes+2)/3*4+(4<<20)))
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	if allow404 && resp.StatusCode == http.StatusNotFound {
		return false, nil
	}
	if resp.StatusCode < 200 || resp.StatusCode >= 300 {
		var errDoc struct {
			Error struct {
				Message string `json:"message"`
			} `json:"error"`
		}
		if json.Unmarshal(raw, &errDoc) == nil && errDoc.Error.Message != "" {
			return false, fmt.Errorf("%s", errDoc.Error.Message)
		}
		return false, fmt.Errorf("host call %s %s failed with status %d", method, path, resp.StatusCode)
	}
	if out != nil && len(raw) > 0 {
		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, out); err != nil {
			return false, err
		}
	}
	return true, nil
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/host.go#*RemoteHostClient.Fetch

``````
// Fetch performs an outbound HTTP request.
func (c *RemoteHostClient) Fetch(ctx context.Context, r HostFetchRequest) (HostFetchResponse, error) {
	if r.TimeoutMS > 0 {
		var cancel context.CancelFunc
		ctx, cancel = context.WithTimeout(ctx, time.Duration(min(r.TimeoutMS, int64(86400000)))*time.Millisecond)
		defer cancel()
	}
	method := r.Method
	if method == "" {
		method = http.MethodGet
	}
	var bodyReader io.Reader
	if r.Body != "" {
		bodyReader = strings.NewReader(r.Body)
	}
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, method, r.URL, bodyReader)
	if err != nil {
		return HostFetchResponse{}, err
	}
	for k, v := range r.Headers {
		req.Header.Set(k, v)
	}
	resp, err := c.client.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return HostFetchResponse{}, err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close() //nolint:errcheck
	raw, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(resp.Body, 8<<20))
	if err != nil {
		return HostFetchResponse{}, err
	}
	hdrs := map[string]string{}
	for k, vals := range resp.Header {
		if len(vals) > 0 {
			hdrs[strings.ToLower(k)] = vals[0]
		}
	}
	return HostFetchResponse{
		Status:  resp.StatusCode,
		Headers: hdrs,
		Body:    string(raw),
	}, nil
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/host.go#*RemoteHostClient.KindVisible

``````
// KindVisible evaluates the library's Rules and viewer access policy for a
// bounded batch (at most MaxKindVisibleIDs) of external IDs in kindKey (#615).
// ctx must carry the incoming frontend adapter's X-Ether-Viewer-Token (via
// WithViewerToken, attached automatically by FrontendAdapter dispatch).
func (c *RemoteHostClient) KindVisible(ctx context.Context, kindKey string, ids []string) ([]string, error) {
	tok, ok := ViewerTokenFromContext(ctx)
	if !ok {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("kinds.visible: no authenticated frontend adapter viewer token on context")
	}
	if len(ids) > MaxKindVisibleIDs {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("kinds.visible: batch larger than %d ids", MaxKindVisibleIDs)
	}
	var out struct {
		IDs []string `json:"ids"`
	}
	_, err := c.callJSONWithHeaders(
		ctx,
		http.MethodPost,
		"/ether/plugin-host/kinds/"+url.PathEscape(kindKey)+"/visible",
		map[string]string{HeaderViewerToken: tok},
		map[string]any{"ids": ids},
		&out,
		false,
	)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if out.IDs == nil {
		out.IDs = []string{}
	}
	return out.IDs, nil
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/host.go#*RemoteHostClient.CachePut

``````
// CachePut stores one blob in a kind library's cache; the ref is content-addressed.
func (c *RemoteHostClient) CachePut(ctx context.Context, libraryKey, name string, data []byte) (string, error) {
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost,
		c.baseURL+"/ether/plugin-host/cache/"+url.PathEscape(libraryKey)+"?name="+url.QueryEscape(name),
		bytes.NewReader(data))
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if c.credential != "" {
		req.Header.Set("X-Ether-Plugin-Credential", c.credential)
	}
	resp, err := c.client.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	body, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(resp.Body, 1<<20))
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if resp.StatusCode >= 300 {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("plugin-host cache put: status %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, strings.TrimSpace(string(body)))
	}
	var out struct {
		Blob string `json:"blob"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &out); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return out.Blob, nil
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/host.go#*RemoteHostClient.CacheOpen

``````
// CacheOpen reads one cached blob back.
func (c *RemoteHostClient) CacheOpen(ctx context.Context, blobRef string) ([]byte, error) {
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet,
		c.baseURL+"/ether/plugin-host/cache/"+strings.TrimPrefix(blobRef, "/"), nil)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if c.credential != "" {
		req.Header.Set("X-Ether-Plugin-Credential", c.credential)
	}
	resp, err := c.client.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	if resp.StatusCode >= 300 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugin-host cache open: status %d", resp.StatusCode)
	}
	return io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/i18n.go#LintCopy

``````
// LintCopy validates a user-visible string against Ether's copy rules.
// It returns an empty string when valid, or the plain reason when invalid.
func LintCopy(raw string, maxRunes int) string {
	s := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
	if maxRunes > 0 && utf8.RuneCountInString(s) > maxRunes {
		return fmt.Sprintf("is longer than %d characters", maxRunes)
	}
	if strings.ContainsAny(s, "—–") {
		return "must not contain em or en dashes"
	}
	if strings.Contains(s, "!") {
		return "must not contain exclamation marks"
	}
	if bannedCopyRE.MatchString(s) {
		return "must not use the words simply, just or easily"
	}
	for _, r := range s {
		if unicode.IsLetter(r) {
			if unicode.IsLower(r) {
				return "must use sentence case"
			}
			break
		}
	}
	words := strings.Fields(s)
	if len(words) >= 3 {
		caps := 0
		for _, w := range words {
			first, _ := utf8.DecodeRuneInString(w)
			if unicode.IsLetter(first) && unicode.IsUpper(first) {
				caps++
			}
		}
		if caps*3 > len(words)*2 {
			return "must use sentence case"
		}
	}
	return ""
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/i18n.go#*I18n.T

``````
// T resolves a key for the given locale and interpolates {param} placeholders.
func (i *I18n) T(rawKey string, params map[string]any, locale string) string {
	key := strings.TrimPrefix(rawKey, "$t:")
	if locale == "" {
		locale = i.defaultLocale
	}
	base := locale
	if idx := strings.IndexByte(locale, '-'); idx > 0 {
		base = locale[:idx]
	}
	var tmpl string
	found := false
	for _, cand := range []string{locale, base, "en"} {
		if cand == "" {
			continue
		}
		if tbl, ok := i.catalog[cand]; ok {
			if v, ok := tbl[key]; ok {
				tmpl = v
				found = true
				break
			}
		}
	}
	if !found {
		tmpl = key
	}
	if len(params) == 0 {
		return tmpl
	}
	return interpRE.ReplaceAllStringFunc(tmpl, func(match string) string {
		name := match[1 : len(match)-1]
		if v, ok := params[name]; ok && v != nil {
			return fmt.Sprint(v)
		}
		return match
	})
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/kinds.go#SourceCandidate

``````
// SourceCandidate is one Ether-found release for a resolver to rank.
type SourceCandidate struct {
	InfoHash string `json:"infoHash,omitempty"`
	Magnet   string `json:"magnet,omitempty"`
	NZBURL   string `json:"nzbUrl,omitempty"`
	// FileIndex selects a zero-based entry in the torrent provider file list; nil uses video selection.
	FileIndex *int   `json:"fileIndex,omitempty"`
	Title     string `json:"title,omitempty"`
	Size      int64  `json:"size,omitempty"`
	Seeders   int    `json:"seeders,omitempty"`
	Cached    bool   `json:"cached,omitempty"`
	Indexer   string `json:"indexer,omitempty"`
	IndexerID string `json:"indexerId,omitempty"`
	// Score, Resolution, Source and Codec are populated on indexer_search
	// candidates whose release name identifies video; non-video candidates
	// leave them empty.
	Score      *int   `json:"score,omitempty"`
	Resolution int    `json:"resolution,omitempty"`
	Source     string `json:"source,omitempty"`
	Codec      string `json:"codec,omitempty"`
	// Files is populated only by a release_files query.
	Files []ReleaseFile `json:"files,omitempty"`

	// Ref names this candidate in match scores. Ether derives it from the
	// infohash/NZB when empty; matchers echo it verbatim.
	Ref string `json:"-"`
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/kinds.go#SourceCandidate.CandidateRef

``````
// CandidateRef returns the stable ref matchers report for a candidate.
func (c SourceCandidate) CandidateRef() string {
	switch {
	case c.Ref != "":
		return c.Ref
	case c.InfoHash != "":
		return "infohash:" + strings.ToLower(c.InfoHash)
	case c.Magnet != "":
		return "magnet:" + c.Magnet
	case c.NZBURL != "":
		return "nzb:" + c.NZBURL
	default:
		return c.Title
	}
}
``````
